from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from hashlib import sha1
from typing import Iterable

from lxml import etree


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ArticleMetadata:
    domain_key: str
    journal_title: str = ''
    issn_ppub: str = ''
    issn_epub: str = ''
    xml_version: str = ''
    article_type: str = ''
    doi: str = ''
    title: str = ''
    abstract: str = ''
    publication_year: int | None = None
    volume: str = ''
    number: str = ''


class XMLParseError(ValueError):
    pass


def _text(element: etree._Element | None) -> str:
    if element is None:
        return ''
    return ' '.join(''.join(element.itertext()).split())


def _first(root: etree._Element, expressions: Iterable[str]) -> etree._Element | None:
    for expression in expressions:
        found = root.xpath(expression)
        if found:
            return found[0]
    return None


def parse_article_xml(xml: str | bytes) -> ArticleMetadata:
    try:
        root = etree.fromstring(xml.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(xml, str) else xml)
    except etree.XMLSyntaxError as exc:
        raise XMLParseError(str(exc)) from exc

    article_type = root.get('article-type', '')
    xml_version = root.get('specific-use') or root.get('dtd-version') or ''
    journal_title = _text(_first(root, ['.//journal-title', './/journal-title-group/journal-title']))

    ppub = _text(_first(root, ['.//issn[@pub-type="ppub"]', './/issn[@publication-format="print"]']))
    epub = _text(_first(root, ['.//issn[@pub-type="epub"]', './/issn[@publication-format="electronic"]']))
    if not ppub:
        ppub = _text(_first(root, ['.//issn[1]']))

    doi = _text(_first(root, ['.//article-id[@pub-id-type="doi"]']))
    title = _text(_first(root, ['.//article-title']))
    abstract = _text(_first(root, ['.//abstract']))
    year_text = _text(_first(root, ['.//pub-date[@pub-type="ppub"]/year', './/pub-date/year']))
    volume = _text(_first(root, ['.//volume']))
    number = _text(_first(root, ['.//issue']))

    try:
        publication_year = int(year_text) if year_text else None
    except ValueError:
        publication_year = None

    seed = '|'.join([journal_title, ppub, epub, doi, title, str(publication_year)])
    domain_key = sha1(seed.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

    return ArticleMetadata(
        domain_key=domain_key,
        journal_title=journal_title,
        issn_ppub=ppub,
        issn_epub=epub,
        xml_version=xml_version,
        article_type=article_type,
        doi=doi,
        title=title,
        abstract=abstract,
        publication_year=publication_year,
        volume=volume,
        number=number,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from django.conf import settings
from django.db import transaction

from journalmanager.models import Article, Issue, Journal
from journalmanager.services.xml_parser import ArticleMetadata, parse_article_xml


class ImportErrorWithContext(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ImportResult:
    article: Article
    metadata: ArticleMetadata
    created: bool


class ArticleImporter:
    def import_xml(self, xml: str, *, journal: Journal | None = None, issue: Issue | None = None, is_aop: bool = False) -> ImportResult:
        if len(xml.encode('utf-8')) > settings.JOURNALMANAGER_XML_MAX_BYTES:
            raise ImportErrorWithContext('XML file exceeds configured maximum size.')

        metadata = parse_article_xml(xml)
        resolved_journal = journal or self._resolve_journal(metadata)
        resolved_issue = issue or self._resolve_issue(resolved_journal, metadata)

        defaults = {
            'xml': xml,
            'journal': resolved_journal,
            'issue': resolved_issue,
            'is_aop': is_aop,
            'journal_title': metadata.journal_title,
            'issn_ppub': metadata.issn_ppub,
            'issn_epub': metadata.issn_epub,
            'xml_version': metadata.xml_version,
            'article_type': metadata.article_type,
            'doi': metadata.doi,
            'title': metadata.title,
            'abstract': metadata.abstract,
            'publication_year': metadata.publication_year,
        }

        with transaction.atomic():
            article, created = Article.objects.update_or_create(domain_key=metadata.domain_key, defaults=defaults)
        return ImportResult(article=article, metadata=metadata, created=created)

    def _resolve_journal(self, metadata: ArticleMetadata) -> Journal | None:
        candidates = Journal.objects.all()
        if metadata.issn_ppub:
            found = candidates.filter(print_issn=metadata.issn_ppub).first()
            if found:
                return found
        if metadata.issn_epub:
            found = candidates.filter(eletronic_issn=metadata.issn_epub).first()
            if found:
                return found
        if metadata.journal_title:
            return candidates.filter(title__iexact=metadata.journal_title).first()
        return None

    def _resolve_issue(self, journal: Journal | None, metadata: ArticleMetadata) -> Issue | None:
        if not journal or not metadata.volume or not metadata.number or not metadata.publication_year:
            return None
        return Issue.objects.filter(journal=journal, volume=metadata.volume, number=metadata.number, publication_year=metadata.publication_year).first()

# "SciELO_Journal_Manager/journalmanager/services/integrity.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from journalmanager.models import Issue, Journal


@dataclass
class IntegrityReport:
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return not self.warnings


def validate_journal(journal: Journal) -> IntegrityReport:
    report = IntegrityReport()
    if not journal.print_issn and not journal.eletronic_issn:
        report.warnings.append(f'{journal.acronym} has no ISSN registered.')
    for issue in Issue.objects.filter(journal=journal):
        actual = issue.articles.count()
        if issue.total_documents and actual and issue.total_documents != actual:
            report.warnings.append(f'{issue} declares {issue.total_documents} documents but has {actual} imported articles.')
        if not issue.section.exists():
            report.warnings.append(f'{issue} has no sections assigned.')
    return report

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponseBadRequest, JsonResponse
from django.views.decorators.csrf import csrf_exempt
from django.views.decorators.http import require_GET, require_POST

from journalmanager.models import Article, Issue, Journal
from journalmanager.serializers import article_to_dict, issue_to_dict, journal_to_dict
from journalmanager.services.importer import ArticleImporter, ImportErrorWithContext
from journalmanager.services.xml_parser import XMLParseError


@require_GET
def journal_list(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse:
    journals = Journal.objects.select_related('collection').order_by('acronym')
    return JsonResponse({'results': [journal_to_dict(journal) for journal in journals]})


@require_GET
def issue_list(request: HttpRequest, journal_acronym: str) -> JsonResponse:
    issues = Issue.objects.select_related('journal').filter(journal__acronym=journal_acronym)
    return JsonResponse({'results': [issue_to_dict(issue) for issue in issues]})


@require_GET
def article_detail(request: HttpRequest, article_id: int) -> JsonResponse:
    article = Article.objects.prefetch_related('assets').get(pk=article_id)
    return JsonResponse(article_to_dict(article))


@csrf_exempt
@require_POST
def import_article(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse | HttpResponseBadRequest:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(request.body.decode('utf-8'))
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return HttpResponseBadRequest('Request body must be JSON.')

    xml = payload.get('xml')
    if not isinstance(xml, str) or not xml.strip():
        return HttpResponseBadRequest('Payload must include non-empty xml.')

    journal = None
    if payload.get('journal_acronym'):
        journal = Journal.objects.filter(acronym=payload['journal_acronym']).first()
        if journal is None:
            return HttpResponseBadRequest('Unknown journal_acronym.')

    try:
        result = ArticleImporter().import_xml(xml, journal=journal, is_aop=bool(payload.get('is_aop')))
    except (XMLParseError, ImportErrorWithContext) as exc:
        return HttpResponseBadRequest(str(exc))

    return JsonResponse({'created': result.created, 'article': article_to_dict(result.article)}, status=201 if result.created else 200)

# "SciELO_Journal_Manager/journalmanager/management/commands/import_article_xml.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from journalmanager.models import Journal
from journalmanager.services.importer import ArticleImporter


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'Import one JATS or SciELO XML article file.'

    def add_arguments(self, parser) -> None:
        parser.add_argument('xml_path')
        parser.add_argument('--journal-acronym')
        parser.add_argument('--aop', action='store_true')

    def handle(self, *args, **options) -> None:
        path = Path(options['xml_path'])
        if not path.exists():
            raise CommandError(f'File not found: {path}')

        journal = None
        if options.get('journal_acronym'):
            try:
                journal = Journal.objects.get(acronym=options['journal_acronym'])
            except Journal.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError('Unknown journal acronym.') from exc

        result = ArticleImporter().import_xml(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), journal=journal, is_aop=options['aop'])
        verb = 'created' if result.created else 'updated'
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(f'Article {result.article.pk} {verb}: {result.article.doi or result.article.domain_key}'))

from __future__ import annotations

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from journalmanager.models import Journal
from journalmanager.services.integrity import validate_journal


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'Validate high-level consistency for one journal.'

    def add_arguments(self, parser) -> None:
        parser.add_argument('journal_acronym')

    def handle(self, *args, **options) -> None:
        try:
            journal = Journal.objects.get(acronym=options['journal_acronym'])
        except Journal.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise CommandError('Unknown journal acronym.') from exc

        report = validate_journal(journal)
        if report.ok:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS('No integrity warnings found.'))
            return
        for warning in report.warnings:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(warning))

# "SearchOps/README.md"
# SearchOps

SearchOps is a Django project for operating a global search experience. It provides content indexing, configurable ranking boost rules, query logging, an administrative explore page, and management commands for rebuilding and pruning the index.

The project was expanded from a Django migration that introduced an unmanaged SearchSettings model with permissions for editing search boosts and viewing the explore page.

## Features

- Relational search index model suitable for PostgreSQL or SQLite development.
- Search boost rules controlled through Django admin permissions.
- Query analytics and click logging.
- Explore endpoint for staff and authorized users.
- Management commands for rebuilding the index and printing index health.
- Typed service layer for indexing, ranking, query normalization, and analytics.
- Tests covering ranking, services, views, and permissions.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py rebuild_search_index --sample
python manage.py runserver
```

Open `/search/` for the public search page and `/search/explore/` for staff exploration.

## Configuration

Configuration is read from environment variables in `searchops/settings.py`.

- `SECRET_KEY`: Django secret key.
- `DEBUG`: true or false.
- `DATABASE_URL`: optional database URL. SQLite is used by default.
- `ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma separated hosts.
- `SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT`: default number of results.
- `SEARCH_MAX_LIMIT`: maximum number of results.

    class Meta:
        permissions = (

            ('view_explore', 'View the global search explore page'),
        )
        managed = False
        default_permissions = ()


class SearchDocument(models.Model):
    class Kind(models.TextChoices):
        ARTICLE = 'article', 'Article'
        USER = 'user', 'User'
        PROJECT = 'project', 'Project'
        PAGE = 'page', 'Page'
        SAMPLE = 'sample', 'Sample'

    external_id = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=Kind.choices)
    title = models.CharField(max_length=300)
    subtitle = models.CharField(max_length=300, blank=True)
    body = models.TextField(blank=True)
    url = models.CharField(max_length=500)
    language = models.CharField(max_length=16, default='en')
    tags = models.JSONField(default=list, blank=True)
    metadata = models.JSONField(default=dict, blank=True)
    is_public = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    base_score = models.FloatField(default=1.0)
    indexed_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = [('kind', 'external_id')]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['kind', 'is_public']),
            models.Index(fields=['title']),
            models.Index(fields=['indexed_at']),

        ordering = ['title']

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.kind}:{self.external_id} {self.title}'

        KIND = 'kind', 'Kind'
        TAG = 'tag', 'Tag'
        LANGUAGE = 'language', 'Language'
        TITLE_PREFIX = 'title_prefix', 'Title prefix'

    name = models.CharField(max_length=120, unique=True)
    field = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=MatchField.choices)
    value = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    multiplier = models.FloatField(default=1.0)
    enabled = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['name']

    def __str__(self) -> str:

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata

_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r'[\w-]+', re.UNICODE)


def normalize_query(query: str) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', query or '').strip().lower()
    tokens = _TOKEN_RE.findall(normalized)
    return ' '.join(tokens)


def tokenize(query: str) -> list[str]:
    return normalize_query(query).split()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from time import perf_counter

from django.db.models import Q, QuerySet

from search.models import BoostRule, SearchDocument
from search.services.query import normalize_query, tokenize


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RankedResult:
    document: SearchDocument
    score: float
    rank: int
    matched_terms: tuple[str, ...]
    snippet: str


class SearchEngine:
    def __init__(self, boost_rules: list[BoostRule] | None = None) -> None:
        self.boost_rules = boost_rules

    def search(self, query: str, *, kind: str = '', limit: int = 10, public_only: bool = True) -> tuple[list[RankedResult], int]:
        started = perf_counter()
        normalized = normalize_query(query)
        terms = tokenize(normalized)
        queryset = SearchDocument.objects.all()
        if public_only:
            queryset = queryset.filter(is_public=True)
        if kind:
            queryset = queryset.filter(kind=kind)
        if terms:
            condition = Q()
            for term in terms:
                condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(subtitle__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
            queryset = queryset.filter(condition).distinct()
        documents = list(queryset[: max(limit * 8, limit)])
        rules = self.boost_rules if self.boost_rules is not None else list(BoostRule.objects.filter(enabled=True))
        ranked = [self._rank_document(doc, terms, rules) for doc in documents]
        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
        elapsed_ms = int((perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        return [self._with_rank(item, rank) for rank, item in enumerate(ranked[:limit], start=1)], elapsed_ms

    def candidates(self, query: str) -> QuerySet[SearchDocument]:
        terms = tokenize(query)
        qs = SearchDocument.objects.filter(is_public=True)
        if not terms:
            return qs
        condition = Q()
        for term in terms:
            condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
        return qs.filter(condition).distinct()

    def _rank_document(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str], rules: list[BoostRule]) -> RankedResult:
        matched_terms = tuple(term for term in terms if self._matches_term(document, term))
        score = float(document.base_score)
        score += len(matched_terms) * 2.0
        lowered_title = document.title.lower()
        for term in matched_terms:
            if lowered_title.startswith(term):
                score += 4.0
            elif term in lowered_title:
                score += 2.0
        for rule in rules:
            if self._rule_matches(rule, document):
                score *= max(rule.multiplier, 0.0)
        return RankedResult(document=document, score=score, rank=0, matched_terms=matched_terms, snippet=self._snippet(document, terms))

    def _with_rank(self, result: RankedResult, rank: int) -> RankedResult:
        return RankedResult(result.document, result.score, rank, result.matched_terms, result.snippet)

    def _matches_term(self, document: SearchDocument, term: str) -> bool:
        haystack = f'{document.title} {document.subtitle} {document.body}'.lower()
        return term in haystack

    def _rule_matches(self, rule: BoostRule, document: SearchDocument) -> bool:
        value = rule.value.lower()
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.KIND:
            return document.kind == rule.value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TAG:
            return value in [str(tag).lower() for tag in document.tags]
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.LANGUAGE:
            return document.language.lower() == value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TITLE_PREFIX:
            return document.title.lower().startswith(value)
        return False

    def _snippet(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str]) -> str:
        text = document.body or document.subtitle or document.title
        if not terms:
            return text[:220]
        lowered = text.lower()
        positions = [lowered.find(term) for term in terms if lowered.find(term) >= 0]
        if not positions:
            return text[:220]
        start = max(min(positions) - 60, 0)
        end = min(start + 220, len(text))
        prefix = '...' if start else ''
        suffix = '...' if end < len(text) else ''
        return f'{prefix}{text[start:end]}{suffix}'

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from search.models import SearchDocument


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentPayload:
    external_id: str
    kind: str
    title: str
    url: str
    subtitle: str = ''
    body: str = ''
    language: str = 'en'
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    is_public: bool = True
    base_score: float = 1.0


class Indexer:
    def upsert(self, payload: DocumentPayload) -> SearchDocument:
        if not payload.external_id or not payload.kind or not payload.title or not payload.url:
            raise ValueError('external_id, kind, title, and url are required')
        with transaction.atomic():
            document, _created = SearchDocument.objects.update_or_create(
                kind=payload.kind,
                external_id=payload.external_id,
                defaults={
                    'title': payload.title,
                    'subtitle': payload.subtitle,
                    'body': payload.body,
                    'url': payload.url,
                    'language': payload.language,
                    'tags': payload.tags,
                    'metadata': payload.metadata,
                    'is_public': payload.is_public,
                    'base_score': payload.base_score,
                    'indexed_at': timezone.now(),
                },
            )
        return document

    def delete(self, *, kind: str, external_id: str) -> int:
        deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.filter(kind=kind, external_id=external_id).delete()
        return deleted

    def bulk_upsert(self, payloads: list[DocumentPayload]) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        return [self.upsert(payload) for payload in payloads]

    def index_sample_documents(self) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        samples = [
            DocumentPayload('getting-started', 'article', 'Getting started with SearchOps', '/docs/getting-started/', body='SearchOps indexes documents, applies boost rules, and records query analytics.', tags=['docs', 'search'], base_score=1.5),
            DocumentPayload('boosts', 'article', 'Tuning search boost rules', '/docs/boosts/', body='Boost rules let authorized users change ranking without redeploying code.', tags=['docs', 'ranking'], base_score=1.3),
            DocumentPayload('explore', 'page', 'Search explore console', '/search/explore/', body='The explore console helps staff inspect ranking behavior and query logs.', tags=['ops'], base_score=1.1),
        ]
        return self.bulk_upsert(samples)

class AnalyticsService:
    def log_query(self, request: HttpRequest | None, query: str, result_count: int, latency_ms: int, source: str = 'web') -> SearchQueryLog:
        user = None
        session_key = ''
        if request is not None:
            request_user = getattr(request, 'user', None)
            if request_user is not None and not isinstance(request_user, AnonymousUser) and request_user.is_authenticated:
                user = request_user
            session = getattr(request, 'session', None)
            if session is not None:
                session_key = session.session_key or ''
        return SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
            query=query,
            normalized_query=normalize_query(query),
            result_count=result_count,
            latency_ms=latency_ms,
            user=user,
            session_key=session_key,
            source=source,
        )

    def log_click(self, query_log: SearchQueryLog, document: SearchDocument, rank: int, request: HttpRequest | None = None) -> SearchClick:
        user = None
        if request is not None and getattr(request, 'user', None) is not None and request.user.is_authenticated:
            user = request.user
        return SearchClick.objects.create(query_log=query_log, document=document, rank=rank, user=user)

    def top_queries(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[QueryStats]:
        rows = (
            SearchQueryLog.objects.values('normalized_query')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'))
            .order_by('-count', 'normalized_query')[:limit]
        )
        return [QueryStats(query=row['normalized_query'], count=row['count']) for row in rows]

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required, permission_required
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseBadRequest, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST

from search.forms import ClickForm, SearchForm
from search.models import SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog
from search.services.analytics import AnalyticsService
from search.services.ranking import SearchEngine


def search_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    query_log = None
    if form.is_valid():
        query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
        kind = form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or ''
        limit = form.cleaned_data['limit']
        if query:
            results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(query, kind=kind, limit=limit, public_only=True)
            query_log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms)
    return render(request, 'search/search.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'query_log': query_log})


@login_required
@permission_required('search.view_explore', raise_exception=True)
def explore_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    if form.is_valid() and form.cleaned_data.get('q'):
        results, _latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
            form.cleaned_data['q'],
            kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
            limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
            public_only=False,
        )
    stats = AnalyticsService().top_queries(limit=10)
    return render(request, 'search/explore.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'stats': stats})


@require_POST
def click_redirect(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = ClickForm(request.POST)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return HttpResponseBadRequest('Invalid click payload')
    query_log = get_object_or_404(SearchQueryLog, pk=form.cleaned_data['query_log_id'])
    document = get_object_or_404(SearchDocument, pk=form.cleaned_data['document_id'])
    AnalyticsService().log_click(query_log, document, form.cleaned_data['rank'], request)
    return redirect(document.url)


def api_search(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return JsonResponse({'errors': form.errors}, status=400)
    query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
    results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
        query,
        kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
        limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
        public_only=True,
    )
    log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms, source='api')
    return JsonResponse(
        {
            'query_log_id': log.id,
            'latency_ms': latency_ms,
            'results': [
                {
                    'id': item.document.id,
                    'title': item.document.title,
                    'url': item.document.url,
                    'kind': item.document.kind,
                    'score': item.score,
                    'rank': item.rank,
                    'snippet': item.snippet,
                }
                for item in results
            ],
        }
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from search.models import SearchDocument
from search.services.indexer import Indexer


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'Rebuild or seed the search index.'

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true', help='Index built-in sample documents')
        parser.add_argument('--clear', action='store_true', help='Clear existing indexed documents first')

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        if options['clear']:
            deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.all().delete()
            self.stdout.write(f'Deleted {deleted} indexed rows')
        if not options['sample']:
            raise CommandError('No source configured. Use --sample for local seed data.')
        documents = Indexer().index_sample_documents()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(f'Indexed {len(documents)} sample documents'))

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand

from search.models import BoostRule, SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog


class Command(BaseCommand):

# "SearchOps/README.md"
# SearchOps

SearchOps is a Django project for operating a global search experience. It provides content indexing, configurable ranking boost rules, query logging, an administrative explore page, and management commands for rebuilding and pruning the index.

The project was expanded from a Django migration that introduced an unmanaged SearchSettings model with permissions for editing search boosts and viewing the explore page.

## Features

- Relational search index model suitable for PostgreSQL or SQLite development.
- Search boost rules controlled through Django admin permissions.
- Query analytics and click logging.
- Explore endpoint for staff and authorized users.
- Management commands for rebuilding the index and printing index health.
- Typed service layer for indexing, ranking, query normalization, and analytics.
- Tests covering ranking, services, views, and permissions.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py rebuild_search_index --sample
python manage.py runserver
```

Open `/search/` for the public search page and `/search/explore/` for staff exploration.

## Configuration

Configuration is read from environment variables in `searchops/settings.py`.

- `SECRET_KEY`: Django secret key.
- `DEBUG`: true or false.
- `DATABASE_URL`: optional database URL. SQLite is used by default.
- `ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma separated hosts.
- `SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT`: default number of results.
- `SEARCH_MAX_LIMIT`: maximum number of results.

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata

_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r'[\w-]+', re.UNICODE)


def normalize_query(query: str) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', query or '').strip().lower()
    tokens = _TOKEN_RE.findall(normalized)
    return ' '.join(tokens)


def tokenize(query: str) -> list[str]:
    return normalize_query(query).split()

# "SearchOps/search/services/ranking.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from time import perf_counter

from django.db.models import Q, QuerySet

from search.models import BoostRule, SearchDocument
from search.services.query import normalize_query, tokenize


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RankedResult:
    document: SearchDocument
    score: float
    rank: int
    matched_terms: tuple[str, ...]
    snippet: str


class SearchEngine:
    def __init__(self, boost_rules: list[BoostRule] | None = None) -> None:
        self.boost_rules = boost_rules

    def search(self, query: str, *, kind: str = '', limit: int = 10, public_only: bool = True) -> tuple[list[RankedResult], int]:
        started = perf_counter()
        normalized = normalize_query(query)
        terms = tokenize(normalized)
        queryset = SearchDocument.objects.all()
        if public_only:
            queryset = queryset.filter(is_public=True)
        if kind:
            queryset = queryset.filter(kind=kind)
        if terms:
            condition = Q()
            for term in terms:
                condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(subtitle__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
            queryset = queryset.filter(condition).distinct()
        documents = list(queryset[: max(limit * 8, limit)])
        rules = self.boost_rules if self.boost_rules is not None else list(BoostRule.objects.filter(enabled=True))
        ranked = [self._rank_document(doc, terms, rules) for doc in documents]
        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
        elapsed_ms = int((perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        return [self._with_rank(item, rank) for rank, item in enumerate(ranked[:limit], start=1)], elapsed_ms

    def candidates(self, query: str) -> QuerySet[SearchDocument]:
        terms = tokenize(query)
        qs = SearchDocument.objects.filter(is_public=True)
        if not terms:
            return qs
        condition = Q()
        for term in terms:
            condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
        return qs.filter(condition).distinct()

    def _rank_document(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str], rules: list[BoostRule]) -> RankedResult:
        matched_terms = tuple(term for term in terms if self._matches_term(document, term))
        score = float(document.base_score)
        score += len(matched_terms) * 2.0
        lowered_title = document.title.lower()
        for term in matched_terms:
            if lowered_title.startswith(term):
                score += 4.0
            elif term in lowered_title:
                score += 2.0
        for rule in rules:
            if self._rule_matches(rule, document):
                score *= max(rule.multiplier, 0.0)
        return RankedResult(document=document, score=score, rank=0, matched_terms=matched_terms, snippet=self._snippet(document, terms))

    def _with_rank(self, result: RankedResult, rank: int) -> RankedResult:
        return RankedResult(result.document, result.score, rank, result.matched_terms, result.snippet)

    def _matches_term(self, document: SearchDocument, term: str) -> bool:
        haystack = f'{document.title} {document.subtitle} {document.body}'.lower()
        return term in haystack

    def _rule_matches(self, rule: BoostRule, document: SearchDocument) -> bool:
        value = rule.value.lower()
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.KIND:
            return document.kind == rule.value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TAG:
            return value in [str(tag).lower() for tag in document.tags]
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.LANGUAGE:
            return document.language.lower() == value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TITLE_PREFIX:
            return document.title.lower().startswith(value)
        return False

    def _snippet(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str]) -> str:
        text = document.body or document.subtitle or document.title
        if not terms:
            return text[:220]
        lowered = text.lower()
        positions = [lowered.find(term) for term in terms if lowered.find(term) >= 0]
        if not positions:
            return text[:220]
        start = max(min(positions) - 60, 0)
        end = min(start + 220, len(text))
        prefix = '...' if start else ''
        suffix = '...' if end < len(text) else ''
        return f'{prefix}{text[start:end]}{suffix}'

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from search.models import SearchDocument


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentPayload:
    external_id: str
    kind: str
    title: str
    url: str
    subtitle: str = ''
    body: str = ''
    language: str = 'en'
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    is_public: bool = True
    base_score: float = 1.0


class Indexer:
    def upsert(self, payload: DocumentPayload) -> SearchDocument:
        if not payload.external_id or not payload.kind or not payload.title or not payload.url:
            raise ValueError('external_id, kind, title, and url are required')
        with transaction.atomic():
            document, _created = SearchDocument.objects.update_or_create(
                kind=payload.kind,
                external_id=payload.external_id,
                defaults={
                    'title': payload.title,
                    'subtitle': payload.subtitle,
                    'body': payload.body,
                    'url': payload.url,
                    'language': payload.language,
                    'tags': payload.tags,
                    'metadata': payload.metadata,
                    'is_public': payload.is_public,
                    'base_score': payload.base_score,
                    'indexed_at': timezone.now(),
                },
            )
        return document

    def delete(self, *, kind: str, external_id: str) -> int:
        deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.filter(kind=kind, external_id=external_id).delete()
        return deleted

    def bulk_upsert(self, payloads: list[DocumentPayload]) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        return [self.upsert(payload) for payload in payloads]

    def index_sample_documents(self) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        samples = [
            DocumentPayload('getting-started', 'article', 'Getting started with SearchOps', '/docs/getting-started/', body='SearchOps indexes documents, applies boost rules, and records query analytics.', tags=['docs', 'search'], base_score=1.5),
            DocumentPayload('boosts', 'article', 'Tuning search boost rules', '/docs/boosts/', body='Boost rules let authorized users change ranking without redeploying code.', tags=['docs', 'ranking'], base_score=1.3),
            DocumentPayload('explore', 'page', 'Search explore console', '/search/explore/', body='The explore console helps staff inspect ranking behavior and query logs.', tags=['ops'], base_score=1.1),
        ]
        return self.bulk_upsert(samples)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from django.contrib.auth.models import AnonymousUser
from django.db.models import Count
from django.http import HttpRequest

from search.models import SearchClick, SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog
from search.services.query import normalize_query


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class QueryStats:
    query: str
    count: int


class AnalyticsService:
    def log_query(self, request: HttpRequest | None, query: str, result_count: int, latency_ms: int, source: str = 'web') -> SearchQueryLog:
        user = None
        session_key = ''
        if request is not None:
            request_user = getattr(request, 'user', None)
            if request_user is not None and not isinstance(request_user, AnonymousUser) and request_user.is_authenticated:
                user = request_user
            session = getattr(request, 'session', None)
            if session is not None:
                session_key = session.session_key or ''
        return SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
            query=query,
            normalized_query=normalize_query(query),
            result_count=result_count,
            latency_ms=latency_ms,
            user=user,
            session_key=session_key,
            source=source,
        )

    def log_click(self, query_log: SearchQueryLog, document: SearchDocument, rank: int, request: HttpRequest | None = None) -> SearchClick:
        user = None
        if request is not None and getattr(request, 'user', None) is not None and request.user.is_authenticated:
            user = request.user
        return SearchClick.objects.create(query_log=query_log, document=document, rank=rank, user=user)

    def top_queries(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[QueryStats]:
        rows = (
            SearchQueryLog.objects.values('normalized_query')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'))
            .order_by('-count', 'normalized_query')[:limit]
        )
        return [QueryStats(query=row['normalized_query'], count=row['count']) for row in rows]

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required, permission_required
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseBadRequest, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST

from search.forms import ClickForm, SearchForm
from search.models import SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog
from search.services.analytics import AnalyticsService
from search.services.ranking import SearchEngine


def search_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    query_log = None
    if form.is_valid():
        query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
        kind = form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or ''
        limit = form.cleaned_data['limit']
        if query:
            results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(query, kind=kind, limit=limit, public_only=True)
            query_log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms)
    return render(request, 'search/search.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'query_log': query_log})


@login_required
@permission_required('search.view_explore', raise_exception=True)
def explore_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    if form.is_valid() and form.cleaned_data.get('q'):
        results, _latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
            form.cleaned_data['q'],
            kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
            limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
            public_only=False,
        )
    stats = AnalyticsService().top_queries(limit=10)
    return render(request, 'search/explore.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'stats': stats})


@require_POST
def click_redirect(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = ClickForm(request.POST)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return HttpResponseBadRequest('Invalid click payload')
    query_log = get_object_or_404(SearchQueryLog, pk=form.cleaned_data['query_log_id'])
    document = get_object_or_404(SearchDocument, pk=form.cleaned_data['document_id'])
    AnalyticsService().log_click(query_log, document, form.cleaned_data['rank'], request)
    return redirect(document.url)


def api_search(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return JsonResponse({'errors': form.errors}, status=400)
    query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
    results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
        query,
        kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
        limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
        public_only=True,
    )
    log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms, source='api')
    return JsonResponse(
        {
            'query_log_id': log.id,
            'latency_ms': latency_ms,
            'results': [
                {
                    'id': item.document.id,
                    'title': item.document.title,
                    'url': item.document.url,
                    'kind': item.document.kind,
                    'score': item.score,
                    'rank': item.rank,
                    'snippet': item.snippet,
                }
                for item in results
            ],
        }
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from search.models import SearchDocument
from search.services.indexer import Indexer


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'Rebuild or seed the search index.'

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true', help='Index built-in sample documents')
        parser.add_argument('--clear', action='store_true', help='Clear existing indexed documents first')

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        if options['clear']:
            deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.all().delete()
            self.stdout.write(f'Deleted {deleted} indexed rows')
        if not options['sample']:
            raise CommandError('No source configured. Use --sample for local seed data.')
        documents = Indexer().index_sample_documents()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(f'Indexed {len(documents)} sample documents'))

# "SearchOps/README.md"
# SearchOps

SearchOps is a Django project for operating a global search experience. It provides content indexing, configurable ranking boost rules, query logging, an administrative explore page, and management commands for rebuilding and pruning the index.

The project was expanded from a Django migration that introduced an unmanaged SearchSettings model with permissions for editing search boosts and viewing the explore page.

## Features

- Relational search index model suitable for PostgreSQL or SQLite development.
- Search boost rules controlled through Django admin permissions.
- Query analytics and click logging.
- Explore endpoint for staff and authorized users.
- Management commands for rebuilding the index and printing index health.
- Typed service layer for indexing, ranking, query normalization, and analytics.
- Tests covering ranking, services, views, and permissions.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py rebuild_search_index --sample
python manage.py runserver
```

Open `/search/` for the public search page and `/search/explore/` for staff exploration.

## Configuration

Configuration is read from environment variables in `searchops/settings.py`.

- `SECRET_KEY`: Django secret key.
- `DEBUG`: true or false.
- `DATABASE_URL`: optional database URL. SQLite is used by default.
- `ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma separated hosts.
- `SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT`: default number of results.
- `SEARCH_MAX_LIMIT`: maximum number of results.

class SearchSettings(models.Model):

            ('change_boost', 'Edit boost settings for search components'),

        )
        managed = False

class SearchDocument(models.Model):
    class Kind(models.TextChoices):
        ARTICLE = 'article', 'Article'
        USER = 'user', 'User'
        PROJECT = 'project', 'Project'
        PAGE = 'page', 'Page'
        SAMPLE = 'sample', 'Sample'

    external_id = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=Kind.choices)
    title = models.CharField(max_length=300)
    subtitle = models.CharField(max_length=300, blank=True)
    body = models.TextField(blank=True)
    url = models.CharField(max_length=500)
    language = models.CharField(max_length=16, default='en')
    tags = models.JSONField(default=list, blank=True)
    metadata = models.JSONField(default=dict, blank=True)
    is_public = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    base_score = models.FloatField(default=1.0)
    indexed_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        unique_together = [('kind', 'external_id')]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['kind', 'is_public']),
            models.Index(fields=['title']),
            models.Index(fields=['indexed_at']),
        ]
        ordering = ['title']

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.kind}:{self.external_id} {self.title}'


class BoostRule(models.Model):
    class MatchField(models.TextChoices):
        KIND = 'kind', 'Kind'
        TAG = 'tag', 'Tag'
        LANGUAGE = 'language', 'Language'
        TITLE_PREFIX = 'title_prefix', 'Title prefix'

    name = models.CharField(max_length=120, unique=True)
    field = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=MatchField.choices)
    value = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    multiplier = models.FloatField(default=1.0)
    enabled = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['name']

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.name} x{self.multiplier}'


class SearchQueryLog(models.Model):
    query = models.CharField(max_length=500)
    normalized_query = models.CharField(max_length=500)
    result_count = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    latency_ms = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    user = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL)
    session_key = models.CharField(max_length=80, blank=True)
    source = models.CharField(max_length=64, default='web')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['normalized_query', 'created_at']),
            models.Index(fields=['created_at']),
        ]
        ordering = ['-created_at']

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.normalized_query} ({self.result_count})'


class SearchClick(models.Model):
    query_log = models.ForeignKey(SearchQueryLog, related_name='clicks', on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    document = models.ForeignKey(SearchDocument, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    rank = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    user = models.ForeignKey(get_user_model(), null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=['created_at']), models.Index(fields=['document'])]

        return request.user.has_perm('search.change_boost') or super().has_add_permission(request)

    def has_delete_permission(self, request, obj=None):
        return request.user.has_perm('search.change_boost') or super().has_delete_permission(request, obj)

    def save_model(self, request, obj, form, change):
        if not request.user.has_perm('search.change_boost') and not request.user.is_superuser:
            codename = get_permission_codename('change', self.opts)
            if not request.user.has_perm(f'{self.opts.app_label}.{codename}'):
                raise PermissionDenied('Missing boost editing permission')
        super().save_model(request, obj, form, change)

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata

_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r'[\w-]+', re.UNICODE)


def normalize_query(query: str) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', query or '').strip().lower()
    tokens = _TOKEN_RE.findall(normalized)
    return ' '.join(tokens)


def tokenize(query: str) -> list[str]:
    return normalize_query(query).split()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from time import perf_counter

from django.db.models import Q, QuerySet

from search.models import BoostRule, SearchDocument
from search.services.query import normalize_query, tokenize


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RankedResult:
    document: SearchDocument
    score: float
    rank: int
    matched_terms: tuple[str, ...]
    snippet: str


class SearchEngine:
    def __init__(self, boost_rules: list[BoostRule] | None = None) -> None:
        self.boost_rules = boost_rules

    def search(self, query: str, *, kind: str = '', limit: int = 10, public_only: bool = True) -> tuple[list[RankedResult], int]:
        started = perf_counter()
        normalized = normalize_query(query)
        terms = tokenize(normalized)
        queryset = SearchDocument.objects.all()
        if public_only:
            queryset = queryset.filter(is_public=True)
        if kind:
            queryset = queryset.filter(kind=kind)
        if terms:
            condition = Q()
            for term in terms:
                condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(subtitle__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
            queryset = queryset.filter(condition).distinct()
        documents = list(queryset[: max(limit * 8, limit)])
        rules = self.boost_rules if self.boost_rules is not None else list(BoostRule.objects.filter(enabled=True))
        ranked = [self._rank_document(doc, terms, rules) for doc in documents]
        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
        elapsed_ms = int((perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        return [self._with_rank(item, rank) for rank, item in enumerate(ranked[:limit], start=1)], elapsed_ms

    def candidates(self, query: str) -> QuerySet[SearchDocument]:
        terms = tokenize(query)
        qs = SearchDocument.objects.filter(is_public=True)
        if not terms:
            return qs
        condition = Q()
        for term in terms:
            condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
        return qs.filter(condition).distinct()

    def _rank_document(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str], rules: list[BoostRule]) -> RankedResult:
        matched_terms = tuple(term for term in terms if self._matches_term(document, term))
        score = float(document.base_score)
        score += len(matched_terms) * 2.0
        lowered_title = document.title.lower()
        for term in matched_terms:
            if lowered_title.startswith(term):
                score += 4.0
            elif term in lowered_title:
                score += 2.0
        for rule in rules:
            if self._rule_matches(rule, document):
                score *= max(rule.multiplier, 0.0)
        return RankedResult(document=document, score=score, rank=0, matched_terms=matched_terms, snippet=self._snippet(document, terms))

    def _with_rank(self, result: RankedResult, rank: int) -> RankedResult:
        return RankedResult(result.document, result.score, rank, result.matched_terms, result.snippet)

    def _matches_term(self, document: SearchDocument, term: str) -> bool:
        haystack = f'{document.title} {document.subtitle} {document.body}'.lower()
        return term in haystack

    def _rule_matches(self, rule: BoostRule, document: SearchDocument) -> bool:
        value = rule.value.lower()
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.KIND:
            return document.kind == rule.value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TAG:
            return value in [str(tag).lower() for tag in document.tags]
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.LANGUAGE:
            return document.language.lower() == value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TITLE_PREFIX:
            return document.title.lower().startswith(value)
        return False

    def _snippet(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str]) -> str:
        text = document.body or document.subtitle or document.title
        if not terms:
            return text[:220]
        lowered = text.lower()
        positions = [lowered.find(term) for term in terms if lowered.find(term) >= 0]
        if not positions:
            return text[:220]
        start = max(min(positions) - 60, 0)
        end = min(start + 220, len(text))
        prefix = '...' if start else ''
        suffix = '...' if end < len(text) else ''
        return f'{prefix}{text[start:end]}{suffix}'

# "SearchOps/search/services/indexer.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from search.models import SearchDocument


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentPayload:
    external_id: str
    kind: str
    title: str
    url: str
    subtitle: str = ''
    body: str = ''
    language: str = 'en'
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    is_public: bool = True
    base_score: float = 1.0


class Indexer:
    def upsert(self, payload: DocumentPayload) -> SearchDocument:
        if not payload.external_id or not payload.kind or not payload.title or not payload.url:
            raise ValueError('external_id, kind, title, and url are required')
        with transaction.atomic():
            document, _created = SearchDocument.objects.update_or_create(
                kind=payload.kind,
                external_id=payload.external_id,
                defaults={
                    'title': payload.title,
                    'subtitle': payload.subtitle,
                    'body': payload.body,
                    'url': payload.url,
                    'language': payload.language,
                    'tags': payload.tags,
                    'metadata': payload.metadata,
                    'is_public': payload.is_public,
                    'base_score': payload.base_score,
                    'indexed_at': timezone.now(),
                },
            )
        return document

    def delete(self, *, kind: str, external_id: str) -> int:
        deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.filter(kind=kind, external_id=external_id).delete()
        return deleted

    def bulk_upsert(self, payloads: list[DocumentPayload]) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        return [self.upsert(payload) for payload in payloads]

    def index_sample_documents(self) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        samples = [
            DocumentPayload('getting-started', 'article', 'Getting started with SearchOps', '/docs/getting-started/', body='SearchOps indexes documents, applies boost rules, and records query analytics.', tags=['docs', 'search'], base_score=1.5),
            DocumentPayload('boosts', 'article', 'Tuning search boost rules', '/docs/boosts/', body='Boost rules let authorized users change ranking without redeploying code.', tags=['docs', 'ranking'], base_score=1.3),
            DocumentPayload('explore', 'page', 'Search explore console', '/search/explore/', body='The explore console helps staff inspect ranking behavior and query logs.', tags=['ops'], base_score=1.1),
        ]
        return self.bulk_upsert(samples)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from django.contrib.auth.models import AnonymousUser
from django.db.models import Count
from django.http import HttpRequest

from search.models import SearchClick, SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog
from search.services.query import normalize_query


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class QueryStats:
    query: str
    count: int


class AnalyticsService:
    def log_query(self, request: HttpRequest | None, query: str, result_count: int, latency_ms: int, source: str = 'web') -> SearchQueryLog:
        user = None
        session_key = ''
        if request is not None:
            request_user = getattr(request, 'user', None)
            if request_user is not None and not isinstance(request_user, AnonymousUser) and request_user.is_authenticated:
                user = request_user
            session = getattr(request, 'session', None)
            if session is not None:
                session_key = session.session_key or ''
        return SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
            query=query,
            normalized_query=normalize_query(query),
            result_count=result_count,
            latency_ms=latency_ms,
            user=user,
            session_key=session_key,
            source=source,
        )

    def log_click(self, query_log: SearchQueryLog, document: SearchDocument, rank: int, request: HttpRequest | None = None) -> SearchClick:
        user = None
        if request is not None and getattr(request, 'user', None) is not None and request.user.is_authenticated:
            user = request.user
        return SearchClick.objects.create(query_log=query_log, document=document, rank=rank, user=user)

    def top_queries(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[QueryStats]:
        rows = (
            SearchQueryLog.objects.values('normalized_query')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'))
            .order_by('-count', 'normalized_query')[:limit]
        )
        return [QueryStats(query=row['normalized_query'], count=row['count']) for row in rows]

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required, permission_required
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseBadRequest, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST

from search.forms import ClickForm, SearchForm
from search.models import SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog
from search.services.analytics import AnalyticsService
from search.services.ranking import SearchEngine


def search_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    query_log = None
    if form.is_valid():
        query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
        kind = form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or ''
        limit = form.cleaned_data['limit']
        if query:
            results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(query, kind=kind, limit=limit, public_only=True)
            query_log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms)
    return render(request, 'search/search.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'query_log': query_log})


@login_required
@permission_required('search.view_explore', raise_exception=True)
def explore_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    if form.is_valid() and form.cleaned_data.get('q'):
        results, _latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
            form.cleaned_data['q'],
            kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
            limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
            public_only=False,
        )
    stats = AnalyticsService().top_queries(limit=10)
    return render(request, 'search/explore.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'stats': stats})


@require_POST
def click_redirect(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = ClickForm(request.POST)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return HttpResponseBadRequest('Invalid click payload')
    query_log = get_object_or_404(SearchQueryLog, pk=form.cleaned_data['query_log_id'])
    document = get_object_or_404(SearchDocument, pk=form.cleaned_data['document_id'])
    AnalyticsService().log_click(query_log, document, form.cleaned_data['rank'], request)
    return redirect(document.url)


def api_search(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return JsonResponse({'errors': form.errors}, status=400)
    query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
    results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
        query,
        kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
        limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
        public_only=True,
    )
    log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms, source='api')
    return JsonResponse(
        {
            'query_log_id': log.id,
            'latency_ms': latency_ms,
            'results': [
                {
                    'id': item.document.id,
                    'title': item.document.title,
                    'url': item.document.url,
                    'kind': item.document.kind,
                    'score': item.score,
                    'rank': item.rank,
                    'snippet': item.snippet,
                }
                for item in results
            ],
        }
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from search.models import SearchDocument
from search.services.indexer import Indexer


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'Rebuild or seed the search index.'

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true', help='Index built-in sample documents')
        parser.add_argument('--clear', action='store_true', help='Clear existing indexed documents first')

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        if options['clear']:
            deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.all().delete()
            self.stdout.write(f'Deleted {deleted} indexed rows')
        if not options['sample']:
            raise CommandError('No source configured. Use --sample for local seed data.')
        documents = Indexer().index_sample_documents()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(f'Indexed {len(documents)} sample documents'))

# "SearchOps/README.md"
# SearchOps

SearchOps is a Django project for operating a global search experience. It provides content indexing, configurable ranking boost rules, query logging, an administrative explore page, and management commands for rebuilding and pruning the index.

The project was expanded from a Django migration that introduced an unmanaged SearchSettings model with permissions for editing search boosts and viewing the explore page.

## Features

- Relational search index model suitable for PostgreSQL or SQLite development.
- Search boost rules controlled through Django admin permissions.
- Query analytics and click logging.
- Explore endpoint for staff and authorized users.
- Management commands for rebuilding the index and printing index health.
- Typed service layer for indexing, ranking, query normalization, and analytics.
- Tests covering ranking, services, views, and permissions.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py rebuild_search_index --sample
python manage.py runserver
```

Open `/search/` for the public search page and `/search/explore/` for staff exploration.

## Configuration

Configuration is read from environment variables in `searchops/settings.py`.

- `SECRET_KEY`: Django secret key.
- `DEBUG`: true or false.
- `DATABASE_URL`: optional database URL. SQLite is used by default.
- `ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma separated hosts.
- `SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT`: default number of results.
- `SEARCH_MAX_LIMIT`: maximum number of results.

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata

_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r'[\w-]+', re.UNICODE)


def normalize_query(query: str) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', query or '').strip().lower()
    tokens = _TOKEN_RE.findall(normalized)
    return ' '.join(tokens)


def tokenize(query: str) -> list[str]:
    return normalize_query(query).split()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from time import perf_counter

from django.db.models import Q, QuerySet

from search.models import BoostRule, SearchDocument
from search.services.query import normalize_query, tokenize


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RankedResult:
    document: SearchDocument
    score: float
    rank: int
    matched_terms: tuple[str, ...]
    snippet: str


class SearchEngine:
    def __init__(self, boost_rules: list[BoostRule] | None = None) -> None:
        self.boost_rules = boost_rules

    def search(self, query: str, *, kind: str = '', limit: int = 10, public_only: bool = True) -> tuple[list[RankedResult], int]:
        started = perf_counter()
        normalized = normalize_query(query)
        terms = tokenize(normalized)
        queryset = SearchDocument.objects.all()
        if public_only:
            queryset = queryset.filter(is_public=True)
        if kind:
            queryset = queryset.filter(kind=kind)
        if terms:
            condition = Q()
            for term in terms:
                condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(subtitle__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
            queryset = queryset.filter(condition).distinct()
        documents = list(queryset[: max(limit * 8, limit)])
        rules = self.boost_rules if self.boost_rules is not None else list(BoostRule.objects.filter(enabled=True))
        ranked = [self._rank_document(doc, terms, rules) for doc in documents]
        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item.score, reverse=True)
        elapsed_ms = int((perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        return [self._with_rank(item, rank) for rank, item in enumerate(ranked[:limit], start=1)], elapsed_ms

    def candidates(self, query: str) -> QuerySet[SearchDocument]:
        terms = tokenize(query)
        qs = SearchDocument.objects.filter(is_public=True)
        if not terms:
            return qs
        condition = Q()
        for term in terms:
            condition |= Q(title__icontains=term) | Q(body__icontains=term)
        return qs.filter(condition).distinct()

    def _rank_document(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str], rules: list[BoostRule]) -> RankedResult:
        matched_terms = tuple(term for term in terms if self._matches_term(document, term))
        score = float(document.base_score)
        score += len(matched_terms) * 2.0
        lowered_title = document.title.lower()
        for term in matched_terms:
            if lowered_title.startswith(term):
                score += 4.0
            elif term in lowered_title:
                score += 2.0
        for rule in rules:
            if self._rule_matches(rule, document):
                score *= max(rule.multiplier, 0.0)
        return RankedResult(document=document, score=score, rank=0, matched_terms=matched_terms, snippet=self._snippet(document, terms))

    def _with_rank(self, result: RankedResult, rank: int) -> RankedResult:
        return RankedResult(result.document, result.score, rank, result.matched_terms, result.snippet)

    def _matches_term(self, document: SearchDocument, term: str) -> bool:
        haystack = f'{document.title} {document.subtitle} {document.body}'.lower()
        return term in haystack

    def _rule_matches(self, rule: BoostRule, document: SearchDocument) -> bool:
        value = rule.value.lower()
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.KIND:
            return document.kind == rule.value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TAG:
            return value in [str(tag).lower() for tag in document.tags]
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.LANGUAGE:
            return document.language.lower() == value
        if rule.field == BoostRule.MatchField.TITLE_PREFIX:
            return document.title.lower().startswith(value)
        return False

    def _snippet(self, document: SearchDocument, terms: list[str]) -> str:
        text = document.body or document.subtitle or document.title
        if not terms:
            return text[:220]
        lowered = text.lower()
        positions = [lowered.find(term) for term in terms if lowered.find(term) >= 0]
        if not positions:
            return text[:220]
        start = max(min(positions) - 60, 0)
        end = min(start + 220, len(text))
        prefix = '...' if start else ''
        suffix = '...' if end < len(text) else ''
        return f'{prefix}{text[start:end]}{suffix}'

    base_score: float = 1.0


class Indexer:
    def upsert(self, payload: DocumentPayload) -> SearchDocument:
        if not payload.external_id or not payload.kind or not payload.title or not payload.url:
            raise ValueError('external_id, kind, title, and url are required')
        with transaction.atomic():
            document, _created = SearchDocument.objects.update_or_create(
                kind=payload.kind,
                external_id=payload.external_id,
                defaults={
                    'title': payload.title,
                    'subtitle': payload.subtitle,
                    'body': payload.body,
                    'url': payload.url,
                    'language': payload.language,
                    'tags': payload.tags,
                    'metadata': payload.metadata,
                    'is_public': payload.is_public,
                    'base_score': payload.base_score,
                    'indexed_at': timezone.now(),
                },
            )
        return document

    def delete(self, *, kind: str, external_id: str) -> int:
        deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.filter(kind=kind, external_id=external_id).delete()
        return deleted

    def bulk_upsert(self, payloads: list[DocumentPayload]) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        return [self.upsert(payload) for payload in payloads]

    def index_sample_documents(self) -> list[SearchDocument]:
        samples = [
            DocumentPayload('getting-started', 'article', 'Getting started with SearchOps', '/docs/getting-started/', body='SearchOps indexes documents, applies boost rules, and records query analytics.', tags=['docs', 'search'], base_score=1.5),
            DocumentPayload('boosts', 'article', 'Tuning search boost rules', '/docs/boosts/', body='Boost rules let authorized users change ranking without redeploying code.', tags=['docs', 'ranking'], base_score=1.3),
            DocumentPayload('explore', 'page', 'Search explore console', '/search/explore/', body='The explore console helps staff inspect ranking behavior and query logs.', tags=['ops'], base_score=1.1),
        ]
        return self.bulk_upsert(samples)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from django.contrib.auth.models import AnonymousUser
from django.db.models import Count
from django.http import HttpRequest

from search.models import SearchClick, SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog
from search.services.query import normalize_query


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class QueryStats:
    query: str
    count: int


class AnalyticsService:
    def log_query(self, request: HttpRequest | None, query: str, result_count: int, latency_ms: int, source: str = 'web') -> SearchQueryLog:
        user = None
        session_key = ''
        if request is not None:
            request_user = getattr(request, 'user', None)
            if request_user is not None and not isinstance(request_user, AnonymousUser) and request_user.is_authenticated:
                user = request_user
            session = getattr(request, 'session', None)
            if session is not None:
                session_key = session.session_key or ''
        return SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
            query=query,
            normalized_query=normalize_query(query),
            result_count=result_count,
            latency_ms=latency_ms,
            user=user,
            session_key=session_key,
            source=source,
        )

    def log_click(self, query_log: SearchQueryLog, document: SearchDocument, rank: int, request: HttpRequest | None = None) -> SearchClick:
        user = None
        if request is not None and getattr(request, 'user', None) is not None and request.user.is_authenticated:
            user = request.user
        return SearchClick.objects.create(query_log=query_log, document=document, rank=rank, user=user)

    def top_queries(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[QueryStats]:
        rows = (
            SearchQueryLog.objects.values('normalized_query')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'))
            .order_by('-count', 'normalized_query')[:limit]
        )
        return [QueryStats(query=row['normalized_query'], count=row['count']) for row in rows]

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required, permission_required
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseBadRequest, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST

from search.forms import ClickForm, SearchForm
from search.models import SearchDocument, SearchQueryLog
from search.services.analytics import AnalyticsService
from search.services.ranking import SearchEngine


def search_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    query_log = None
    if form.is_valid():
        query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
        kind = form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or ''
        limit = form.cleaned_data['limit']
        if query:
            results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(query, kind=kind, limit=limit, public_only=True)
            query_log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms)
    return render(request, 'search/search.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'query_log': query_log})


@login_required
@permission_required('search.view_explore', raise_exception=True)
def explore_page(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    results = []
    if form.is_valid() and form.cleaned_data.get('q'):
        results, _latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
            form.cleaned_data['q'],
            kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
            limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
            public_only=False,
        )
    stats = AnalyticsService().top_queries(limit=10)
    return render(request, 'search/explore.html', {'form': form, 'results': results, 'stats': stats})


@require_POST
def click_redirect(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    form = ClickForm(request.POST)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return HttpResponseBadRequest('Invalid click payload')
    query_log = get_object_or_404(SearchQueryLog, pk=form.cleaned_data['query_log_id'])
    document = get_object_or_404(SearchDocument, pk=form.cleaned_data['document_id'])
    AnalyticsService().log_click(query_log, document, form.cleaned_data['rank'], request)
    return redirect(document.url)


def api_search(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse:
    form = SearchForm(request.GET or None)
    if not form.is_valid():
        return JsonResponse({'errors': form.errors}, status=400)
    query = form.cleaned_data.get('q') or ''
    results, latency_ms = SearchEngine().search(
        query,
        kind=form.cleaned_data.get('kind') or '',
        limit=form.cleaned_data['limit'],
        public_only=True,
    )
    log = AnalyticsService().log_query(request, query, len(results), latency_ms, source='api')
    return JsonResponse(
        {
            'query_log_id': log.id,
            'latency_ms': latency_ms,
            'results': [
                {
                    'id': item.document.id,
                    'title': item.document.title,
                    'url': item.document.url,
                    'kind': item.document.kind,
                    'score': item.score,
                    'rank': item.rank,
                    'snippet': item.snippet,
                }
                for item in results
            ],
        }
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from search.models import SearchDocument
from search.services.indexer import Indexer


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'Rebuild or seed the search index.'

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true', help='Index built-in sample documents')
        parser.add_argument('--clear', action='store_true', help='Clear existing indexed documents first')

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        if options['clear']:
            deleted, _ = SearchDocument.objects.all().delete()
            self.stdout.write(f'Deleted {deleted} indexed rows')
        if not options['sample']:
            raise CommandError('No source configured. Use --sample for local seed data.')
        documents = Indexer().index_sample_documents()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(f'Indexed {len(documents)} sample documents'))
