from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum

import pandas as pd


class ColumnKind(StrEnum):
    NUMERIC = 'numeric'
    CATEGORICAL = 'categorical'
    DATETIME = 'datetime'
    BOOLEAN = 'boolean'
    TEXT = 'text'


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ColumnProfile:
    name: str
    kind: ColumnKind
    missing: int
    unique: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetProfile:
    rows: int
    columns: int
    profiles: tuple[ColumnProfile, ...]

    @property
    def numeric_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind == ColumnKind.NUMERIC]

    @property
    def categorical_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind in {ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL, ColumnKind.BOOLEAN}]


def infer_column_kind(series: pd.Series) -> ColumnKind:
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.BOOLEAN
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.NUMERIC
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.DATETIME
    unique_ratio = series.nunique(dropna=True) / max(len(series), 1)
    if unique_ratio <= 0.2 or series.nunique(dropna=True) <= 30:
        return ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL
    return ColumnKind.TEXT

# "DashDataExplorer/src/dash_data_explorer/data/loader.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import ColumnProfile, DatasetProfile, infer_column_kind


class DataLoadError(ValueError):
    pass


class DataframeStore:
    def __init__(self, frame: pd.DataFrame):
        if frame.empty:
            raise DataLoadError('Dataset is empty')
        self._frame = self._normalise(frame)
        self.profile = self.describe(self._frame)

    @property
    def frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._frame.copy()

    @staticmethod
    def _normalise(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = frame.copy()
        df.columns = [str(c).strip().replace(' ', '_') for c in df.columns]
        for column in df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns:
            converted = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors='ignore')
            df[column] = converted
        df.insert(0, '_row_id', range(len(df)))
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def describe(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> DatasetProfile:
        profiles = tuple(
            ColumnProfile(
                name=column,
                kind=infer_column_kind(frame[column]),
                missing=int(frame[column].isna().sum()),
                unique=int(frame[column].nunique(dropna=True)),
            )
            for column in frame.columns
            if column != '_row_id'
        )
        return DatasetProfile(rows=len(frame), columns=len(profiles), profiles=profiles)


def load_csv(path: str | Path, sample_rows: int | None = None) -> DataframeStore:
    csv_path = Path(path)
    if not csv_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Dataset not found: {csv_path}')
    try:
        frame = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not read CSV file {csv_path}: {exc}') from exc
    if sample_rows and len(frame) > sample_rows:
        frame = frame.sample(sample_rows, random_state=42).sort_index()
    return DataframeStore(frame)


def load_dash_upload(contents: str, filename: str) -> DataframeStore:
    if not filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
        raise DataLoadError('Only CSV uploads are supported')
    try:
        _, content_string = contents.split(',', 1)
        decoded = base64.b64decode(content_string)
        frame = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(decoded))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not parse uploaded CSV: {exc}') from exc
    return DataframeStore(frame)

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import DatasetProfile


class VisualFactories:
    def __init__(self, template: str = 'plotly_white'):
        self.template = template

    def scatter(self, df: pd.DataFrame, x: str, y: str, color: str | None = None) -> go.Figure:
        if x not in df or y not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select valid x and y columns')
        color_arg = color if color in df.columns else None
        figure = px.scatter(df, x=x, y=y, color=color_arg, custom_data=['_row_id'], template=self.template)
        figure.update_traces(marker={'size': 10, 'opacity': 0.75})
        figure.update_layout(dragmode='select', margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def histogram(self, df: pd.DataFrame, column: str | None) -> go.Figure:
        if not column or column not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select a column')
        figure = px.histogram(df, x=column, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def profile_bar(self, profile: DatasetProfile) -> go.Figure:
        names = [p.name for p in profile.profiles]
        missing = [p.missing for p in profile.profiles]
        figure = px.bar(x=names, y=missing, labels={'x': 'column', 'y': 'missing'}, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(title='Missing values by column')
        return figure

    @staticmethod
    def empty_figure(message: str) -> go.Figure:
        figure = go.Figure()
        figure.add_annotation(text=message, showarrow=False, x=0.5, y=0.5, xref='paper', yref='paper')
        figure.update_layout(template='plotly_white')
        return figure

        super().__init__(title=title)
        self.plot_factory = plot_factory
        self.store = store

    def layout(self, params: dict[str, Any] | None = None):

        return dbc.Card(
            dbc.CardBody([
                html.H5('Selected and filtered records'),
                dcc.Loading(

                        columns=[{'name': column, 'id': column} for column in df.columns],
                        data=df.to_dict('records'),

                        sort_action='native',
                        filter_action='native',
                        row_selectable='multi',
                        selected_rows=[],
                        style_table={'overflowX': 'auto'},
                        style_cell={'fontFamily': 'Arial', 'fontSize': 13, 'padding': '6px'},
                    )],
                    type='dot',
                ),
            ]),
            className='mb-3',
        )

        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'selected_rows'),
            Input('main-scatter', 'selectedData'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def display_selected_data(graph_points, records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            if graph_points is None:
                return []
            row_ids = [point['customdata'][0] for point in graph_points.get('points', []) if point.get('customdata')]
            if not row_ids:
                return []
            id_to_position = {row_id: position for position, row_id in enumerate(df['_row_id'].tolist())}
            return [id_to_position[row_id] for row_id in row_ids if row_id in id_to_position]

        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'data'),
            Output('main-table', 'columns'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def refresh_table(records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            columns = [{'name': column, 'id': column} for column in df.columns]
            return df.to_dict('records'), columns

    def set_data(self, store: DataframeStore) -> None:
        self.store = store

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from dash import Dash, Input, Output, State, dcc, html
import dash_bootstrap_components as dbc

from dash_data_explorer.components.controls import Controls
from dash_data_explorer.components.plots import PlotPanel
from dash_data_explorer.components.table import Table
from dash_data_explorer.config import AppSettings
from dash_data_explorer.data.loader import DataLoadError, DataframeStore, load_csv, load_dash_upload
from dash_data_explorer.figures.factories import VisualFactories


def create_dash_app(settings: AppSettings | None = None, data_path: str | Path | None = None) -> Dash:
    settings = settings or AppSettings()
    store = load_csv(data_path or settings.data.default_path, sample_rows=settings.data.sample_rows)
    factory = VisualFactories()

    app = Dash(
        __name__,
        external_stylesheets=[dbc.themes.BOOTSTRAP],
        title=settings.title,
        suppress_callback_exceptions=False,
    )
    app.layout = _layout(settings, store, factory)

    components = [PlotPanel(factory, store), Table(factory, store)]
    for component in components:
        component.component_callbacks(app)
    _register_dataset_callbacks(app, store)
    return app


def _layout(settings: AppSettings, store: DataframeStore, factory: VisualFactories):
    controls = Controls(store.profile)
    plots = PlotPanel(factory, store)
    table = Table(factory, store)
    profile = store.profile
    return dbc.Container([
        dcc.Store(id='dataset-store', data=store.frame.to_dict('records')),
        dbc.NavbarSimple(brand=settings.title, color='primary', dark=True, className='mb-3'),
        dbc.Row([
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.rows), html.P('Rows')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.columns), html.P('Columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.numeric_columns)), html.P('Numeric columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.categorical_columns)), html.P('Categorical columns')])), md=3),
        ], className='mb-3'),
        controls.layout(),
        plots.layout(),
        table.layout(),
        dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([dcc.Graph(id='missing-profile', figure=factory.profile_bar(profile))])),
    ], fluid=True)


def _register_dataset_callbacks(app: Dash, default_store: DataframeStore) -> None:
    @app.callback(
        Output('dataset-store', 'data'),
        Output('upload-status', 'children'),
        Input('upload-data', 'contents'),
        State('upload-data', 'filename'),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def update_dataset(contents, filename):
        if not contents:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), 'Using default dataset.'
        try:
            uploaded = load_dash_upload(contents, filename or 'upload.csv')
        except DataLoadError as exc:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Upload failed: {exc}'
        return uploaded.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Loaded {filename} with {uploaded.profile.rows} rows.'

# "DashDataExplorer/README.md"
# DashDataExplorer

DashDataExplorer is a production-ready Dash application for interactive exploration of tabular datasets. It provides CSV loading, configurable profiling, linked scatter plots, histograms, summary cards, and a selectable data table that stays synchronized with graph selections.

## Features

- Dash application factory for local development and WSGI deployment
- Object-oriented reusable dashboard components
- CSV ingestion with validation and safe type inference
- Linked Plotly visualizations and Dash DataTable selections
- YAML or environment based settings
- Typer CLI for running the app and profiling datasets
- Unit tests for loading, plotting, and callbacks

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

    python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

Run with the included sample dataset:

    dde serve --data data/sample/iris.csv --debug

Generate a profile summary:

    dde profile data/sample/iris.csv

## Project layout

- src/dash_data_explorer/app.py: Dash app factory
- src/dash_data_explorer/components: reusable Dash components
- src/dash_data_explorer/data: dataframe loading and profiling
- src/dash_data_explorer/figures: Plotly figure factories
- tests: unit tests

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class DataSettings(BaseModel):
    default_path: Path = Path('data/sample/iris.csv')
    max_upload_mb: int = Field(default=50, ge=1)
    sample_rows: int = Field(default=5000, ge=100)


class AppSettings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix='DDE_', env_nested_delimiter='__')

    title: str = 'DashDataExplorer'
    host: str = '127.0.0.1'
    port: int = Field(default=8050, ge=1, le=65535)
    debug: bool = False
    page_size: int = Field(default=15, ge=5, le=100)
    theme: str = 'bootstrap'
    data: DataSettings = DataSettings()


def load_settings(path: str | Path | None = None) -> AppSettings:
    if path is None:
        return AppSettings()
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Configuration file not found: {config_path}')
    raw: dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text()) or {}
    app_cfg = raw.get('app', {})
    data_cfg = raw.get('data', {})
    return AppSettings(**app_cfg, data=DataSettings(**data_cfg))

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys


def configure_logging(level: int = logging.INFO) -> None:
    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s - %(message)s'))
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.handlers.clear()
    root.addHandler(handler)
    root.setLevel(level)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum

import pandas as pd


class ColumnKind(StrEnum):
    NUMERIC = 'numeric'
    CATEGORICAL = 'categorical'
    DATETIME = 'datetime'
    BOOLEAN = 'boolean'
    TEXT = 'text'


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ColumnProfile:
    name: str
    kind: ColumnKind
    missing: int
    unique: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetProfile:
    rows: int
    columns: int
    profiles: tuple[ColumnProfile, ...]

    @property
    def numeric_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind == ColumnKind.NUMERIC]

    @property
    def categorical_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind in {ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL, ColumnKind.BOOLEAN}]


def infer_column_kind(series: pd.Series) -> ColumnKind:
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.BOOLEAN
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.NUMERIC
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.DATETIME
    unique_ratio = series.nunique(dropna=True) / max(len(series), 1)
    if unique_ratio <= 0.2 or series.nunique(dropna=True) <= 30:
        return ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL
    return ColumnKind.TEXT

# "DashDataExplorer/src/dash_data_explorer/data/loader.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import ColumnProfile, DatasetProfile, infer_column_kind


class DataLoadError(ValueError):
    pass


class DataframeStore:
    def __init__(self, frame: pd.DataFrame):
        if frame.empty:
            raise DataLoadError('Dataset is empty')
        self._frame = self._normalise(frame)
        self.profile = self.describe(self._frame)

    @property
    def frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._frame.copy()

    @staticmethod
    def _normalise(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = frame.copy()
        df.columns = [str(c).strip().replace(' ', '_') for c in df.columns]
        for column in df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns:
            converted = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors='ignore')
            df[column] = converted
        df.insert(0, '_row_id', range(len(df)))
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def describe(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> DatasetProfile:
        profiles = tuple(
            ColumnProfile(
                name=column,
                kind=infer_column_kind(frame[column]),
                missing=int(frame[column].isna().sum()),
                unique=int(frame[column].nunique(dropna=True)),
            )
            for column in frame.columns
            if column != '_row_id'
        )
        return DatasetProfile(rows=len(frame), columns=len(profiles), profiles=profiles)


def load_csv(path: str | Path, sample_rows: int | None = None) -> DataframeStore:
    csv_path = Path(path)
    if not csv_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Dataset not found: {csv_path}')
    try:
        frame = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not read CSV file {csv_path}: {exc}') from exc
    if sample_rows and len(frame) > sample_rows:
        frame = frame.sample(sample_rows, random_state=42).sort_index()
    return DataframeStore(frame)


def load_dash_upload(contents: str, filename: str) -> DataframeStore:
    if not filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
        raise DataLoadError('Only CSV uploads are supported')
    try:
        _, content_string = contents.split(',', 1)
        decoded = base64.b64decode(content_string)
        frame = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(decoded))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not parse uploaded CSV: {exc}') from exc
    return DataframeStore(frame)

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import DatasetProfile


class VisualFactories:
    def __init__(self, template: str = 'plotly_white'):
        self.template = template

    def scatter(self, df: pd.DataFrame, x: str, y: str, color: str | None = None) -> go.Figure:
        if x not in df or y not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select valid x and y columns')
        color_arg = color if color in df.columns else None
        figure = px.scatter(df, x=x, y=y, color=color_arg, custom_data=['_row_id'], template=self.template)
        figure.update_traces(marker={'size': 10, 'opacity': 0.75})
        figure.update_layout(dragmode='select', margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def histogram(self, df: pd.DataFrame, column: str | None) -> go.Figure:
        if not column or column not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select a column')
        figure = px.histogram(df, x=column, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def profile_bar(self, profile: DatasetProfile) -> go.Figure:
        names = [p.name for p in profile.profiles]
        missing = [p.missing for p in profile.profiles]
        figure = px.bar(x=names, y=missing, labels={'x': 'column', 'y': 'missing'}, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(title='Missing values by column')
        return figure

    @staticmethod
    def empty_figure(message: str) -> go.Figure:
        figure = go.Figure()
        figure.add_annotation(text=message, showarrow=False, x=0.5, y=0.5, xref='paper', yref='paper')
        figure.update_layout(template='plotly_white')
        return figure

        super().__init__(title=title)
        self.plot_factory = plot_factory
        self.store = store

    def layout(self, params: dict[str, Any] | None = None):

        return dbc.Card(
            dbc.CardBody([
                html.H5('Selected and filtered records'),
                dcc.Loading(

                        data=df.to_dict('records'),

                        sort_action='native',
                        filter_action='native',
                        row_selectable='multi',
                        selected_rows=[],
                        style_table={'overflowX': 'auto'},
                        style_cell={'fontFamily': 'Arial', 'fontSize': 13, 'padding': '6px'},
                    )],
                    type='dot',
                ),
            ]),
            className='mb-3',
        )

        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'selected_rows'),
            Input('main-scatter', 'selectedData'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def display_selected_data(graph_points, records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            if graph_points is None:
                return []
            row_ids = [point['customdata'][0] for point in graph_points.get('points', []) if point.get('customdata')]
            if not row_ids:
                return []
            id_to_position = {row_id: position for position, row_id in enumerate(df['_row_id'].tolist())}
            return [id_to_position[row_id] for row_id in row_ids if row_id in id_to_position]

        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'data'),
            Output('main-table', 'columns'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def refresh_table(records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            columns = [{'name': column, 'id': column} for column in df.columns]
            return df.to_dict('records'), columns

    def set_data(self, store: DataframeStore) -> None:
        self.store = store

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from dash import Dash, Input, Output, State, dcc, html
import dash_bootstrap_components as dbc

from dash_data_explorer.components.controls import Controls
from dash_data_explorer.components.plots import PlotPanel
from dash_data_explorer.components.table import Table
from dash_data_explorer.config import AppSettings
from dash_data_explorer.data.loader import DataLoadError, DataframeStore, load_csv, load_dash_upload
from dash_data_explorer.figures.factories import VisualFactories


def create_dash_app(settings: AppSettings | None = None, data_path: str | Path | None = None) -> Dash:
    settings = settings or AppSettings()
    store = load_csv(data_path or settings.data.default_path, sample_rows=settings.data.sample_rows)
    factory = VisualFactories()

    app = Dash(
        __name__,
        external_stylesheets=[dbc.themes.BOOTSTRAP],
        title=settings.title,
        suppress_callback_exceptions=False,
    )
    app.layout = _layout(settings, store, factory)

    components = [PlotPanel(factory, store), Table(factory, store)]
    for component in components:
        component.component_callbacks(app)
    _register_dataset_callbacks(app, store)
    return app


def _layout(settings: AppSettings, store: DataframeStore, factory: VisualFactories):
    controls = Controls(store.profile)
    plots = PlotPanel(factory, store)
    table = Table(factory, store)
    profile = store.profile
    return dbc.Container([
        dcc.Store(id='dataset-store', data=store.frame.to_dict('records')),
        dbc.NavbarSimple(brand=settings.title, color='primary', dark=True, className='mb-3'),
        dbc.Row([
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.rows), html.P('Rows')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.columns), html.P('Columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.numeric_columns)), html.P('Numeric columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.categorical_columns)), html.P('Categorical columns')])), md=3),
        ], className='mb-3'),
        controls.layout(),
        plots.layout(),
        table.layout(),
        dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([dcc.Graph(id='missing-profile', figure=factory.profile_bar(profile))])),
    ], fluid=True)


def _register_dataset_callbacks(app: Dash, default_store: DataframeStore) -> None:
    @app.callback(
        Output('dataset-store', 'data'),
        Output('upload-status', 'children'),
        Input('upload-data', 'contents'),
        State('upload-data', 'filename'),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def update_dataset(contents, filename):
        if not contents:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), 'Using default dataset.'
        try:
            uploaded = load_dash_upload(contents, filename or 'upload.csv')
        except DataLoadError as exc:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Upload failed: {exc}'
        return uploaded.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Loaded {filename} with {uploaded.profile.rows} rows.'

# "DashDataExplorer/README.md"
# DashDataExplorer

DashDataExplorer is a production-ready Dash application for interactive exploration of tabular datasets. It provides CSV loading, configurable profiling, linked scatter plots, histograms, summary cards, and a selectable data table that stays synchronized with graph selections.

## Features

- Dash application factory for local development and WSGI deployment
- Object-oriented reusable dashboard components
- CSV ingestion with validation and safe type inference
- Linked Plotly visualizations and Dash DataTable selections
- YAML or environment based settings
- Typer CLI for running the app and profiling datasets
- Unit tests for loading, plotting, and callbacks

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

    python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

Run with the included sample dataset:

    dde serve --data data/sample/iris.csv --debug

Generate a profile summary:

    dde profile data/sample/iris.csv

## Project layout

- src/dash_data_explorer/app.py: Dash app factory
- src/dash_data_explorer/components: reusable Dash components
- src/dash_data_explorer/data: dataframe loading and profiling
- src/dash_data_explorer/figures: Plotly figure factories
- tests: unit tests

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class DataSettings(BaseModel):
    default_path: Path = Path('data/sample/iris.csv')
    max_upload_mb: int = Field(default=50, ge=1)
    sample_rows: int = Field(default=5000, ge=100)


class AppSettings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix='DDE_', env_nested_delimiter='__')

    title: str = 'DashDataExplorer'
    host: str = '127.0.0.1'
    port: int = Field(default=8050, ge=1, le=65535)
    debug: bool = False
    page_size: int = Field(default=15, ge=5, le=100)
    theme: str = 'bootstrap'
    data: DataSettings = DataSettings()


def load_settings(path: str | Path | None = None) -> AppSettings:
    if path is None:
        return AppSettings()
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Configuration file not found: {config_path}')
    raw: dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text()) or {}
    app_cfg = raw.get('app', {})
    data_cfg = raw.get('data', {})
    return AppSettings(**app_cfg, data=DataSettings(**data_cfg))

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys


def configure_logging(level: int = logging.INFO) -> None:
    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s - %(message)s'))
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.handlers.clear()
    root.addHandler(handler)
    root.setLevel(level)

# "DashDataExplorer/src/dash_data_explorer/data/schema.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum

import pandas as pd


class ColumnKind(StrEnum):
    NUMERIC = 'numeric'
    CATEGORICAL = 'categorical'
    DATETIME = 'datetime'
    BOOLEAN = 'boolean'
    TEXT = 'text'


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ColumnProfile:
    name: str
    kind: ColumnKind
    missing: int
    unique: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetProfile:
    rows: int
    columns: int
    profiles: tuple[ColumnProfile, ...]

    @property
    def numeric_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind == ColumnKind.NUMERIC]

    @property
    def categorical_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind in {ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL, ColumnKind.BOOLEAN}]


def infer_column_kind(series: pd.Series) -> ColumnKind:
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.BOOLEAN
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.NUMERIC
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.DATETIME
    unique_ratio = series.nunique(dropna=True) / max(len(series), 1)
    if unique_ratio <= 0.2 or series.nunique(dropna=True) <= 30:
        return ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL
    return ColumnKind.TEXT

# "DashDataExplorer/src/dash_data_explorer/data/loader.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import ColumnProfile, DatasetProfile, infer_column_kind


class DataLoadError(ValueError):
    pass


class DataframeStore:
    def __init__(self, frame: pd.DataFrame):
        if frame.empty:
            raise DataLoadError('Dataset is empty')
        self._frame = self._normalise(frame)
        self.profile = self.describe(self._frame)

    @property
    def frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._frame.copy()

    @staticmethod
    def _normalise(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = frame.copy()
        df.columns = [str(c).strip().replace(' ', '_') for c in df.columns]
        for column in df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns:
            converted = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors='ignore')
            df[column] = converted
        df.insert(0, '_row_id', range(len(df)))
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def describe(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> DatasetProfile:
        profiles = tuple(
            ColumnProfile(
                name=column,
                kind=infer_column_kind(frame[column]),
                missing=int(frame[column].isna().sum()),
                unique=int(frame[column].nunique(dropna=True)),
            )
            for column in frame.columns
            if column != '_row_id'
        )
        return DatasetProfile(rows=len(frame), columns=len(profiles), profiles=profiles)


def load_csv(path: str | Path, sample_rows: int | None = None) -> DataframeStore:
    csv_path = Path(path)
    if not csv_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Dataset not found: {csv_path}')
    try:
        frame = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not read CSV file {csv_path}: {exc}') from exc
    if sample_rows and len(frame) > sample_rows:
        frame = frame.sample(sample_rows, random_state=42).sort_index()
    return DataframeStore(frame)


def load_dash_upload(contents: str, filename: str) -> DataframeStore:
    if not filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
        raise DataLoadError('Only CSV uploads are supported')
    try:
        _, content_string = contents.split(',', 1)
        decoded = base64.b64decode(content_string)
        frame = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(decoded))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not parse uploaded CSV: {exc}') from exc
    return DataframeStore(frame)

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import DatasetProfile


class VisualFactories:
    def __init__(self, template: str = 'plotly_white'):
        self.template = template

    def scatter(self, df: pd.DataFrame, x: str, y: str, color: str | None = None) -> go.Figure:
        if x not in df or y not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select valid x and y columns')
        color_arg = color if color in df.columns else None
        figure = px.scatter(df, x=x, y=y, color=color_arg, custom_data=['_row_id'], template=self.template)
        figure.update_traces(marker={'size': 10, 'opacity': 0.75})
        figure.update_layout(dragmode='select', margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def histogram(self, df: pd.DataFrame, column: str | None) -> go.Figure:
        if not column or column not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select a column')
        figure = px.histogram(df, x=column, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def profile_bar(self, profile: DatasetProfile) -> go.Figure:
        names = [p.name for p in profile.profiles]
        missing = [p.missing for p in profile.profiles]
        figure = px.bar(x=names, y=missing, labels={'x': 'column', 'y': 'missing'}, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(title='Missing values by column')
        return figure

    @staticmethod
    def empty_figure(message: str) -> go.Figure:
        figure = go.Figure()
        figure.add_annotation(text=message, showarrow=False, x=0.5, y=0.5, xref='paper', yref='paper')
        figure.update_layout(template='plotly_white')
        return figure

        super().__init__(title=title)
        self.plot_factory = plot_factory
        self.store = store

    def layout(self, params: dict[str, Any] | None = None):

        return dbc.Card(
            dbc.CardBody([
                html.H5('Selected and filtered records'),
                dcc.Loading(
                    id='loading-table',
                    children=[dash_table.DataTable(
                        id='main-table',
                        columns=[{'name': column, 'id': column} for column in df.columns],
                        data=df.to_dict('records'),
                        page_size=15,
                        sort_action='native',
                        filter_action='native',
                        row_selectable='multi',
                        selected_rows=[],
                        style_table={'overflowX': 'auto'},
                        style_cell={'fontFamily': 'Arial', 'fontSize': 13, 'padding': '6px'},
                    )],
                    type='dot',
                ),
            ]),
            className='mb-3',
        )

    def component_callbacks(self, app: Dash) -> None:
        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'selected_rows'),
            Input('main-scatter', 'selectedData'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def display_selected_data(graph_points, records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            if graph_points is None:
                return []
            row_ids = [point['customdata'][0] for point in graph_points.get('points', []) if point.get('customdata')]
            if not row_ids:
                return []
            id_to_position = {row_id: position for position, row_id in enumerate(df['_row_id'].tolist())}
            return [id_to_position[row_id] for row_id in row_ids if row_id in id_to_position]

        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'data'),
            Output('main-table', 'columns'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def refresh_table(records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            columns = [{'name': column, 'id': column} for column in df.columns]
            return df.to_dict('records'), columns

    def set_data(self, store: DataframeStore) -> None:
        self.store = store

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from dash import Dash, Input, Output, State, dcc, html
import dash_bootstrap_components as dbc

from dash_data_explorer.components.controls import Controls
from dash_data_explorer.components.plots import PlotPanel
from dash_data_explorer.components.table import Table
from dash_data_explorer.config import AppSettings
from dash_data_explorer.data.loader import DataLoadError, DataframeStore, load_csv, load_dash_upload
from dash_data_explorer.figures.factories import VisualFactories


def create_dash_app(settings: AppSettings | None = None, data_path: str | Path | None = None) -> Dash:
    settings = settings or AppSettings()
    store = load_csv(data_path or settings.data.default_path, sample_rows=settings.data.sample_rows)
    factory = VisualFactories()

    app = Dash(
        __name__,
        external_stylesheets=[dbc.themes.BOOTSTRAP],
        title=settings.title,
        suppress_callback_exceptions=False,
    )
    app.layout = _layout(settings, store, factory)

    components = [PlotPanel(factory, store), Table(factory, store)]
    for component in components:
        component.component_callbacks(app)
    _register_dataset_callbacks(app, store)
    return app


def _layout(settings: AppSettings, store: DataframeStore, factory: VisualFactories):
    controls = Controls(store.profile)
    plots = PlotPanel(factory, store)
    table = Table(factory, store)
    profile = store.profile
    return dbc.Container([
        dcc.Store(id='dataset-store', data=store.frame.to_dict('records')),
        dbc.NavbarSimple(brand=settings.title, color='primary', dark=True, className='mb-3'),
        dbc.Row([
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.rows), html.P('Rows')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.columns), html.P('Columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.numeric_columns)), html.P('Numeric columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.categorical_columns)), html.P('Categorical columns')])), md=3),
        ], className='mb-3'),
        controls.layout(),
        plots.layout(),
        table.layout(),
        dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([dcc.Graph(id='missing-profile', figure=factory.profile_bar(profile))])),
    ], fluid=True)


def _register_dataset_callbacks(app: Dash, default_store: DataframeStore) -> None:
    @app.callback(
        Output('dataset-store', 'data'),
        Output('upload-status', 'children'),
        Input('upload-data', 'contents'),
        State('upload-data', 'filename'),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def update_dataset(contents, filename):
        if not contents:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), 'Using default dataset.'
        try:
            uploaded = load_dash_upload(contents, filename or 'upload.csv')
        except DataLoadError as exc:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Upload failed: {exc}'
        return uploaded.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Loaded {filename} with {uploaded.profile.rows} rows.'

    config: Path | None = typer.Option(None, help='YAML configuration file'),

# "DashDataExplorer/README.md"
# DashDataExplorer

DashDataExplorer is a production-ready Dash application for interactive exploration of tabular datasets. It provides CSV loading, configurable profiling, linked scatter plots, histograms, summary cards, and a selectable data table that stays synchronized with graph selections.

## Features

- Dash application factory for local development and WSGI deployment
- Object-oriented reusable dashboard components
- CSV ingestion with validation and safe type inference
- Linked Plotly visualizations and Dash DataTable selections
- YAML or environment based settings
- Typer CLI for running the app and profiling datasets
- Unit tests for loading, plotting, and callbacks

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

    python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

Run with the included sample dataset:

    dde serve --data data/sample/iris.csv --debug

Generate a profile summary:

    dde profile data/sample/iris.csv

## Project layout

- src/dash_data_explorer/app.py: Dash app factory
- src/dash_data_explorer/components: reusable Dash components
- src/dash_data_explorer/data: dataframe loading and profiling
- src/dash_data_explorer/figures: Plotly figure factories
- tests: unit tests

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class DataSettings(BaseModel):
    default_path: Path = Path('data/sample/iris.csv')
    max_upload_mb: int = Field(default=50, ge=1)
    sample_rows: int = Field(default=5000, ge=100)


class AppSettings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix='DDE_', env_nested_delimiter='__')

    title: str = 'DashDataExplorer'
    host: str = '127.0.0.1'
    port: int = Field(default=8050, ge=1, le=65535)
    debug: bool = False
    page_size: int = Field(default=15, ge=5, le=100)
    theme: str = 'bootstrap'
    data: DataSettings = DataSettings()


def load_settings(path: str | Path | None = None) -> AppSettings:
    if path is None:
        return AppSettings()
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Configuration file not found: {config_path}')
    raw: dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text()) or {}
    app_cfg = raw.get('app', {})
    data_cfg = raw.get('data', {})
    return AppSettings(**app_cfg, data=DataSettings(**data_cfg))

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys


def configure_logging(level: int = logging.INFO) -> None:
    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s - %(message)s'))
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.handlers.clear()
    root.addHandler(handler)
    root.setLevel(level)

# "DashDataExplorer/src/dash_data_explorer/data/schema.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum

import pandas as pd


class ColumnKind(StrEnum):
    NUMERIC = 'numeric'
    CATEGORICAL = 'categorical'
    DATETIME = 'datetime'
    BOOLEAN = 'boolean'
    TEXT = 'text'


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ColumnProfile:
    name: str
    kind: ColumnKind
    missing: int
    unique: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetProfile:
    rows: int
    columns: int
    profiles: tuple[ColumnProfile, ...]

    @property
    def numeric_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind == ColumnKind.NUMERIC]

    @property
    def categorical_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind in {ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL, ColumnKind.BOOLEAN}]


def infer_column_kind(series: pd.Series) -> ColumnKind:
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.BOOLEAN
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.NUMERIC
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.DATETIME
    unique_ratio = series.nunique(dropna=True) / max(len(series), 1)
    if unique_ratio <= 0.2 or series.nunique(dropna=True) <= 30:
        return ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL
    return ColumnKind.TEXT

# "DashDataExplorer/src/dash_data_explorer/data/loader.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import ColumnProfile, DatasetProfile, infer_column_kind


class DataLoadError(ValueError):
    pass


class DataframeStore:
    def __init__(self, frame: pd.DataFrame):
        if frame.empty:
            raise DataLoadError('Dataset is empty')
        self._frame = self._normalise(frame)
        self.profile = self.describe(self._frame)

    @property
    def frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._frame.copy()

    @staticmethod
    def _normalise(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = frame.copy()
        df.columns = [str(c).strip().replace(' ', '_') for c in df.columns]
        for column in df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns:
            converted = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors='ignore')
            df[column] = converted
        df.insert(0, '_row_id', range(len(df)))
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def describe(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> DatasetProfile:
        profiles = tuple(
            ColumnProfile(
                name=column,
                kind=infer_column_kind(frame[column]),
                missing=int(frame[column].isna().sum()),
                unique=int(frame[column].nunique(dropna=True)),
            )
            for column in frame.columns
            if column != '_row_id'
        )
        return DatasetProfile(rows=len(frame), columns=len(profiles), profiles=profiles)


def load_csv(path: str | Path, sample_rows: int | None = None) -> DataframeStore:
    csv_path = Path(path)
    if not csv_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Dataset not found: {csv_path}')
    try:
        frame = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not read CSV file {csv_path}: {exc}') from exc
    if sample_rows and len(frame) > sample_rows:
        frame = frame.sample(sample_rows, random_state=42).sort_index()
    return DataframeStore(frame)


def load_dash_upload(contents: str, filename: str) -> DataframeStore:
    if not filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
        raise DataLoadError('Only CSV uploads are supported')
    try:
        _, content_string = contents.split(',', 1)
        decoded = base64.b64decode(content_string)
        frame = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(decoded))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not parse uploaded CSV: {exc}') from exc
    return DataframeStore(frame)

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import DatasetProfile


class VisualFactories:
    def __init__(self, template: str = 'plotly_white'):
        self.template = template

    def scatter(self, df: pd.DataFrame, x: str, y: str, color: str | None = None) -> go.Figure:
        if x not in df or y not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select valid x and y columns')
        color_arg = color if color in df.columns else None
        figure = px.scatter(df, x=x, y=y, color=color_arg, custom_data=['_row_id'], template=self.template)
        figure.update_traces(marker={'size': 10, 'opacity': 0.75})
        figure.update_layout(dragmode='select', margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def histogram(self, df: pd.DataFrame, column: str | None) -> go.Figure:
        if not column or column not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select a column')
        figure = px.histogram(df, x=column, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def profile_bar(self, profile: DatasetProfile) -> go.Figure:
        names = [p.name for p in profile.profiles]
        missing = [p.missing for p in profile.profiles]
        figure = px.bar(x=names, y=missing, labels={'x': 'column', 'y': 'missing'}, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(title='Missing values by column')
        return figure

    @staticmethod
    def empty_figure(message: str) -> go.Figure:
        figure = go.Figure()
        figure.add_annotation(text=message, showarrow=False, x=0.5, y=0.5, xref='paper', yref='paper')
        figure.update_layout(template='plotly_white')
        return figure

        self.plot_factory = plot_factory
        self.store = store

    def layout(self, params: dict[str, Any] | None = None):

            dbc.CardBody([
                html.H5('Selected and filtered records'),

                        data=df.to_dict('records'),

                        filter_action='native',

                    )],
                    type='dot',
                ),
            ]),
            className='mb-3',
        )

        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'selected_rows'),
            Input('main-scatter', 'selectedData'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def display_selected_data(graph_points, records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            if graph_points is None:
                return []
            row_ids = [point['customdata'][0] for point in graph_points.get('points', []) if point.get('customdata')]
            if not row_ids:
                return []
            id_to_position = {row_id: position for position, row_id in enumerate(df['_row_id'].tolist())}
            return [id_to_position[row_id] for row_id in row_ids if row_id in id_to_position]

        @app.callback(
            Output('main-table', 'data'),
            Output('main-table', 'columns'),
            Input('dataset-store', 'data'),
        )
        def refresh_table(records):
            df = pd.DataFrame(records) if records else self.store.frame
            columns = [{'name': column, 'id': column} for column in df.columns]
            return df.to_dict('records'), columns

    def set_data(self, store: DataframeStore) -> None:
        self.store = store

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from dash import Dash, Input, Output, State, dcc, html
import dash_bootstrap_components as dbc

from dash_data_explorer.components.controls import Controls
from dash_data_explorer.components.plots import PlotPanel
from dash_data_explorer.components.table import Table
from dash_data_explorer.config import AppSettings
from dash_data_explorer.data.loader import DataLoadError, DataframeStore, load_csv, load_dash_upload
from dash_data_explorer.figures.factories import VisualFactories


def create_dash_app(settings: AppSettings | None = None, data_path: str | Path | None = None) -> Dash:
    settings = settings or AppSettings()
    store = load_csv(data_path or settings.data.default_path, sample_rows=settings.data.sample_rows)
    factory = VisualFactories()

    app = Dash(
        __name__,
        external_stylesheets=[dbc.themes.BOOTSTRAP],
        title=settings.title,
        suppress_callback_exceptions=False,
    )
    app.layout = _layout(settings, store, factory)

    components = [PlotPanel(factory, store), Table(factory, store)]
    for component in components:
        component.component_callbacks(app)
    _register_dataset_callbacks(app, store)
    return app


def _layout(settings: AppSettings, store: DataframeStore, factory: VisualFactories):
    controls = Controls(store.profile)
    plots = PlotPanel(factory, store)
    table = Table(factory, store)
    profile = store.profile
    return dbc.Container([
        dcc.Store(id='dataset-store', data=store.frame.to_dict('records')),
        dbc.NavbarSimple(brand=settings.title, color='primary', dark=True, className='mb-3'),
        dbc.Row([
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.rows), html.P('Rows')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.columns), html.P('Columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.numeric_columns)), html.P('Numeric columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.categorical_columns)), html.P('Categorical columns')])), md=3),
        ], className='mb-3'),
        controls.layout(),
        plots.layout(),
        table.layout(),
        dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([dcc.Graph(id='missing-profile', figure=factory.profile_bar(profile))])),
    ], fluid=True)


def _register_dataset_callbacks(app: Dash, default_store: DataframeStore) -> None:
    @app.callback(
        Output('dataset-store', 'data'),
        Output('upload-status', 'children'),
        Input('upload-data', 'contents'),
        State('upload-data', 'filename'),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def update_dataset(contents, filename):
        if not contents:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), 'Using default dataset.'
        try:
            uploaded = load_dash_upload(contents, filename or 'upload.csv')
        except DataLoadError as exc:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Upload failed: {exc}'
        return uploaded.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Loaded {filename} with {uploaded.profile.rows} rows.'

# "DashDataExplorer/README.md"
# DashDataExplorer

DashDataExplorer is a production-ready Dash application for interactive exploration of tabular datasets. It provides CSV loading, configurable profiling, linked scatter plots, histograms, summary cards, and a selectable data table that stays synchronized with graph selections.

## Features

- Dash application factory for local development and WSGI deployment
- Object-oriented reusable dashboard components
- CSV ingestion with validation and safe type inference
- Linked Plotly visualizations and Dash DataTable selections
- YAML or environment based settings
- Typer CLI for running the app and profiling datasets
- Unit tests for loading, plotting, and callbacks

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

    python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'

Run with the included sample dataset:

    dde serve --data data/sample/iris.csv --debug

Generate a profile summary:

    dde profile data/sample/iris.csv

## Project layout

- src/dash_data_explorer/app.py: Dash app factory
- src/dash_data_explorer/components: reusable Dash components
- src/dash_data_explorer/data: dataframe loading and profiling
- src/dash_data_explorer/figures: Plotly figure factories
- tests: unit tests

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class DataSettings(BaseModel):
    default_path: Path = Path('data/sample/iris.csv')
    max_upload_mb: int = Field(default=50, ge=1)
    sample_rows: int = Field(default=5000, ge=100)


class AppSettings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix='DDE_', env_nested_delimiter='__')

    title: str = 'DashDataExplorer'
    host: str = '127.0.0.1'
    port: int = Field(default=8050, ge=1, le=65535)
    debug: bool = False
    page_size: int = Field(default=15, ge=5, le=100)
    theme: str = 'bootstrap'
    data: DataSettings = DataSettings()


def load_settings(path: str | Path | None = None) -> AppSettings:
    if path is None:
        return AppSettings()
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Configuration file not found: {config_path}')
    raw: dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text()) or {}
    app_cfg = raw.get('app', {})
    data_cfg = raw.get('data', {})
    return AppSettings(**app_cfg, data=DataSettings(**data_cfg))

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys


def configure_logging(level: int = logging.INFO) -> None:
    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s - %(message)s'))
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.handlers.clear()
    root.addHandler(handler)
    root.setLevel(level)

# "DashDataExplorer/src/dash_data_explorer/data/schema.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum

import pandas as pd


class ColumnKind(StrEnum):
    NUMERIC = 'numeric'
    CATEGORICAL = 'categorical'
    DATETIME = 'datetime'
    BOOLEAN = 'boolean'
    TEXT = 'text'


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ColumnProfile:
    name: str
    kind: ColumnKind
    missing: int
    unique: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetProfile:
    rows: int
    columns: int
    profiles: tuple[ColumnProfile, ...]

    @property
    def numeric_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind == ColumnKind.NUMERIC]

    @property
    def categorical_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        return [p.name for p in self.profiles if p.kind in {ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL, ColumnKind.BOOLEAN}]


def infer_column_kind(series: pd.Series) -> ColumnKind:
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.BOOLEAN
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.NUMERIC
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(series):
        return ColumnKind.DATETIME
    unique_ratio = series.nunique(dropna=True) / max(len(series), 1)
    if unique_ratio <= 0.2 or series.nunique(dropna=True) <= 30:
        return ColumnKind.CATEGORICAL
    return ColumnKind.TEXT

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import ColumnProfile, DatasetProfile, infer_column_kind


class DataLoadError(ValueError):
    pass


class DataframeStore:
    def __init__(self, frame: pd.DataFrame):
        if frame.empty:
            raise DataLoadError('Dataset is empty')
        self._frame = self._normalise(frame)
        self.profile = self.describe(self._frame)

    @property
    def frame(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return self._frame.copy()

    @staticmethod
    def _normalise(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = frame.copy()
        df.columns = [str(c).strip().replace(' ', '_') for c in df.columns]
        for column in df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns:
            converted = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors='ignore')
            df[column] = converted
        df.insert(0, '_row_id', range(len(df)))
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def describe(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> DatasetProfile:
        profiles = tuple(
            ColumnProfile(
                name=column,
                kind=infer_column_kind(frame[column]),
                missing=int(frame[column].isna().sum()),
                unique=int(frame[column].nunique(dropna=True)),
            )
            for column in frame.columns
            if column != '_row_id'
        )
        return DatasetProfile(rows=len(frame), columns=len(profiles), profiles=profiles)


def load_csv(path: str | Path, sample_rows: int | None = None) -> DataframeStore:
    csv_path = Path(path)
    if not csv_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Dataset not found: {csv_path}')
    try:
        frame = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not read CSV file {csv_path}: {exc}') from exc
    if sample_rows and len(frame) > sample_rows:
        frame = frame.sample(sample_rows, random_state=42).sort_index()
    return DataframeStore(frame)


def load_dash_upload(contents: str, filename: str) -> DataframeStore:
    if not filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
        raise DataLoadError('Only CSV uploads are supported')
    try:
        _, content_string = contents.split(',', 1)
        decoded = base64.b64decode(content_string)
        frame = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(decoded))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise DataLoadError(f'Could not parse uploaded CSV: {exc}') from exc
    return DataframeStore(frame)

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from dash_data_explorer.data.schema import DatasetProfile


class VisualFactories:
    def __init__(self, template: str = 'plotly_white'):
        self.template = template

    def scatter(self, df: pd.DataFrame, x: str, y: str, color: str | None = None) -> go.Figure:
        if x not in df or y not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select valid x and y columns')
        color_arg = color if color in df.columns else None
        figure = px.scatter(df, x=x, y=y, color=color_arg, custom_data=['_row_id'], template=self.template)
        figure.update_traces(marker={'size': 10, 'opacity': 0.75})
        figure.update_layout(dragmode='select', margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def histogram(self, df: pd.DataFrame, column: str | None) -> go.Figure:
        if not column or column not in df:
            return self.empty_figure('Select a column')
        figure = px.histogram(df, x=column, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(margin={'l': 30, 'r': 20, 't': 35, 'b': 30})
        return figure

    def profile_bar(self, profile: DatasetProfile) -> go.Figure:
        names = [p.name for p in profile.profiles]
        missing = [p.missing for p in profile.profiles]
        figure = px.bar(x=names, y=missing, labels={'x': 'column', 'y': 'missing'}, template=self.template)
        figure.update_layout(title='Missing values by column')
        return figure

    @staticmethod
    def empty_figure(message: str) -> go.Figure:
        figure = go.Figure()
        figure.add_annotation(text=message, showarrow=False, x=0.5, y=0.5, xref='paper', yref='paper')
        figure.update_layout(template='plotly_white')
        return figure

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from dash import Dash, Input, Output, State, dcc, html
import dash_bootstrap_components as dbc

from dash_data_explorer.components.controls import Controls
from dash_data_explorer.components.plots import PlotPanel
from dash_data_explorer.components.table import Table
from dash_data_explorer.config import AppSettings
from dash_data_explorer.data.loader import DataLoadError, DataframeStore, load_csv, load_dash_upload
from dash_data_explorer.figures.factories import VisualFactories


def create_dash_app(settings: AppSettings | None = None, data_path: str | Path | None = None) -> Dash:
    settings = settings or AppSettings()
    store = load_csv(data_path or settings.data.default_path, sample_rows=settings.data.sample_rows)
    factory = VisualFactories()

    app = Dash(
        __name__,
        external_stylesheets=[dbc.themes.BOOTSTRAP],
        title=settings.title,
        suppress_callback_exceptions=False,
    )
    app.layout = _layout(settings, store, factory)

    components = [PlotPanel(factory, store), Table(factory, store)]
    for component in components:
        component.component_callbacks(app)
    _register_dataset_callbacks(app, store)
    return app


def _layout(settings: AppSettings, store: DataframeStore, factory: VisualFactories):
    controls = Controls(store.profile)
    plots = PlotPanel(factory, store)
    table = Table(factory, store)
    profile = store.profile
    return dbc.Container([
        dcc.Store(id='dataset-store', data=store.frame.to_dict('records')),
        dbc.NavbarSimple(brand=settings.title, color='primary', dark=True, className='mb-3'),
        dbc.Row([
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.rows), html.P('Rows')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(profile.columns), html.P('Columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.numeric_columns)), html.P('Numeric columns')])), md=3),
            dbc.Col(dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([html.H4(len(profile.categorical_columns)), html.P('Categorical columns')])), md=3),
        ], className='mb-3'),
        controls.layout(),
        plots.layout(),
        table.layout(),
        dbc.Card(dbc.CardBody([dcc.Graph(id='missing-profile', figure=factory.profile_bar(profile))])),
    ], fluid=True)


def _register_dataset_callbacks(app: Dash, default_store: DataframeStore) -> None:
    @app.callback(
        Output('dataset-store', 'data'),
        Output('upload-status', 'children'),
        Input('upload-data', 'contents'),
        State('upload-data', 'filename'),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def update_dataset(contents, filename):
        if not contents:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), 'Using default dataset.'
        try:
            uploaded = load_dash_upload(contents, filename or 'upload.csv')
        except DataLoadError as exc:
            return default_store.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Upload failed: {exc}'
        return uploaded.frame.to_dict('records'), f'Loaded {filename} with {uploaded.profile.rows} rows.'

# "CareQualitySpark/README.md"
# CareQualitySpark

CareQualitySpark is a PySpark analytics project for measuring variation in hospital effective-care quality scores.

The original prototype used Spark RDDs to compute the score range for each procedure from healthcare CSV extracts. This project provides a maintainable production and research implementation using Spark SQL DataFrames, explicit schemas, configuration files, command-line interfaces, tests, and an optional API for serving computed results.

## Features

- Reads CMS-style effective-care CSV data and measure metadata.
- Cleans score fields and keeps invalid or unavailable scores from corrupting statistics.
- Computes per-measure score count, minimum, maximum, range, mean, standard deviation, and hospital count.
- Joins analytics with measure metadata such as measure name, condition, start date, and end date.
- Ranks the highest-variation measures for downstream review.
- Writes partition-friendly Parquet, CSV, or JSON artifacts.
- Provides a Typer CLI for local and cluster execution.
- Includes a small FastAPI service for querying exported JSON results.
- Includes unit tests for metric logic and configuration behavior.

## Expected input columns

The application is intentionally tolerant of common healthcare extract column names. For effective care data it expects columns equivalent to:

- provider_id
- hospital_name
- condition
- measure_id
- measure_name
- score

For measure metadata it expects columns equivalent to:

- measure_id
- measure_name
- condition
- measure_start_date
- measure_end_date

Column names are normalized by lowercasing and replacing spaces, hyphens, and slashes with underscores.

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

    python -m pip install -e '.[dev,serve]'

Run the analysis locally:

    care-quality run --effective-care data/effective_care.csv --measure-dates data/measure_dates.csv --output-dir outputs/latest --top-n 10

Show the top measures from an exported JSON artifact:

    care-quality inspect outputs/latest/top_measures.json

Start the API after producing JSON output:

    care-quality-api --artifact outputs/latest/top_measures.json --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

## Configuration

A YAML config can be used instead of passing every option at the command line:

    care-quality run --config configs/local.yaml

CLI arguments override config file values.

## Development

Run tests:

    pytest

Run linting and type checking if installed:

    ruff check src tests
    mypy src

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class JobConfig:
    app_name: str = 'care-quality'
    master: str | None = None
    effective_care_path: str = 'data/effective_care.csv'
    measure_dates_path: str = 'data/measure_dates.csv'
    output_dir: str = 'outputs/latest'
    output_format: str = 'parquet'
    top_n: int = 10
    csv_header: bool = True
    csv_delimiter: str = ','
    fail_on_empty: bool = True
    log_level: str = 'INFO'

    def validate(self) -> None:
        if self.top_n <= 0:
            raise ValueError('top_n must be a positive integer')
        if self.output_format not in {'parquet', 'csv', 'json'}:
            raise ValueError('output_format must be one of parquet, csv, or json')
        if len(self.csv_delimiter) != 1:
            raise ValueError('csv_delimiter must be exactly one character')
        if not self.effective_care_path:
            raise ValueError('effective_care_path is required')
        if not self.measure_dates_path:
            raise ValueError('measure_dates_path is required')

    @classmethod
    def from_yaml(cls, path: str | Path) -> 'JobConfig':
        payload = yaml.safe_load(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) or {}
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ValueError(f'configuration at {path} must be a mapping')
        config = cls(**{k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k in cls.__dataclass_fields__})
        config.validate()
        return config

    def with_overrides(self, **overrides: Any) -> 'JobConfig':
        clean = {k: v for k, v in overrides.items() if v is not None and k in self.__dataclass_fields__}
        config = replace(self, **clean)
        config.validate()
        return config

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable

from pyspark.sql import DataFrame, SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

from care_quality.config import JobConfig


def normalize_column_name(name: str) -> str:
    cleaned = name.strip().lower()
    for token in (' ', '-', '/', '(', ')', '.'):
        cleaned = cleaned.replace(token, '_')
    while '__' in cleaned:
        cleaned = cleaned.replace('__', '_')
    return cleaned.strip('_')


def normalize_columns(df: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    for original in df.columns:
        normalized = normalize_column_name(original)
        if normalized != original:
            df = df.withColumnRenamed(original, normalized)
    return df


def _read_csv(spark: SparkSession, path: str, config: JobConfig) -> DataFrame:
    return spark.read.option('header', str(config.csv_header).lower()).option(
        'delimiter', config.csv_delimiter
    ).option('mode', 'PERMISSIVE').csv(path)


def read_effective_care(spark: SparkSession, config: JobConfig) -> DataFrame:
    df = normalize_columns(_read_csv(spark, config.effective_care_path, config))
    aliases = {
        'provider_number': 'provider_id',
        'hospital_overall_rating': 'score',
        'measure': 'measure_name',
    }
    for old, new in aliases.items():
        if old in df.columns and new not in df.columns:
            df = df.withColumnRenamed(old, new)
    require_columns(df, ['provider_id', 'measure_id', 'score'], 'effective care')
    return df


def read_measure_dates(spark: SparkSession, config: JobConfig) -> DataFrame:
    df = normalize_columns(_read_csv(spark, config.measure_dates_path, config))
    if 'measure' in df.columns and 'measure_name' not in df.columns:
        df = df.withColumnRenamed('measure', 'measure_name')
    require_columns(df, ['measure_id'], 'measure dates')
    return df


def require_columns(df: DataFrame, required: Iterable[str], dataset_name: str) -> None:
    missing = sorted(set(required).difference(df.columns))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f'{dataset_name} dataset is missing required columns: {missing}')


def write_dataframe(df: DataFrame, output_dir: str, name: str, fmt: str) -> str:
    path = str(Path(output_dir) / name)
    writer = df.coalesce(1).write.mode('overwrite')
    if fmt == 'parquet':
        writer.parquet(path)
    elif fmt == 'csv':
        writer.option('header', 'true').csv(path)
    elif fmt == 'json':
        writer.json(path)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f'unsupported output format: {fmt}')
    return path


def write_single_json_artifact(df: DataFrame, output_dir: str, file_name: str) -> str:
    rows = [row.asDict(recursive=True) for row in df.collect()]
    path = Path(output_dir)
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    artifact = path / file_name
    import json

    artifact.write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding='utf-8')
    return str(artifact)


# "CareQualitySpark/src/care_quality/metrics.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pyspark.sql import DataFrame
from pyspark.sql import functions as F


def add_clean_score(df: DataFrame, score_col: str = 'score') -> DataFrame:
    cleaned = F.trim(F.col(score_col).cast('string'))
    numeric = F.when(cleaned.rlike(r'^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$'), cleaned.cast('double'))
    return df.withColumn('score_numeric', numeric)


def compute_measure_variation(effective_care: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    df = add_clean_score(effective_care)
    measure_name = F.first(F.col('measure_name'), ignorenulls=True).alias('measure_name') if 'measure_name' in df.columns else F.lit(None).alias('measure_name')
    condition = F.first(F.col('condition'), ignorenulls=True).alias('condition') if 'condition' in df.columns else F.lit(None).alias('condition')
    return (
        df.where(F.col('measure_id').isNotNull())
        .groupBy('measure_id')
        .agg(
            measure_name,
            condition,
            F.count('score_numeric').cast('double').alias('valid_score_count'),
            F.countDistinct('provider_id').cast('double').alias('hospital_count'),
            F.min('score_numeric').alias('min_score'),
            F.max('score_numeric').alias('max_score'),
            F.avg('score_numeric').alias('mean_score'),
            F.stddev_samp('score_numeric').alias('stddev_score'),
        )
        .withColumn('score_range', F.when(F.col('valid_score_count') > 0, F.col('max_score') - F.col('min_score')).otherwise(F.lit(0.0)))
    )


def enrich_with_measure_dates(metrics: DataFrame, measure_dates: DataFrame) -> DataFrame:
    metadata_cols = [c for c in ['measure_id', 'measure_name', 'condition', 'measure_start_date', 'measure_end_date'] if c in measure_dates.columns]
    metadata = measure_dates.select(*metadata_cols).dropDuplicates(['measure_id'])
    joined = metrics.alias('m').join(metadata.alias('d'), on='measure_id', how='left')
    if 'd.measure_name' in joined.columns:
        return joined
    selected = [
        F.col('measure_id'),
        F.coalesce(F.col('d.measure_name'), F.col('m.measure_name')).alias('measure_name') if 'measure_name' in metadata_cols else F.col('m.measure_name').alias('measure_name'),
        F.coalesce(F.col('d.condition'), F.col('m.condition')).alias('condition') if 'condition' in metadata_cols else F.col('m.condition').alias('condition'),
    ]
    for col_name in ['measure_start_date', 'measure_end_date']:
        if col_name in metadata_cols:
            selected.append(F.col(f'd.{col_name}').alias(col_name))
        else:
            selected.append(F.lit(None).cast('string').alias(col_name))
    selected.extend(
        [
            F.col('valid_score_count'),
            F.col('hospital_count'),
            F.col('min_score'),
            F.col('max_score'),
            F.col('score_range'),
            F.col('mean_score'),
            F.col('stddev_score'),
        ]
    )
    return joined.select(*selected)


def rank_top_variation(enriched_metrics: DataFrame, top_n: int) -> DataFrame:
    return enriched_metrics.orderBy(F.col('score_range').desc(), F.col('valid_score_count').desc(), F.col('measure_id').asc()).limit(top_n)


# "CareQualitySpark/src/care_quality/pipeline.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass

from pyspark.sql import DataFrame, SparkSession

from care_quality.config import JobConfig
from care_quality.io import read_effective_care, read_measure_dates, write_dataframe, write_single_json_artifact
from care_quality.metrics import compute_measure_variation, enrich_with_measure_dates, rank_top_variation

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PipelineResult:
    metrics_path: str
    top_path: str
    top_json_path: str
    top_count: int


def run_pipeline(spark: SparkSession, config: JobConfig) -> PipelineResult:
    config.validate()
    LOGGER.info('reading effective care data from %s', config.effective_care_path)
    effective_care = read_effective_care(spark, config)
    LOGGER.info('reading measure metadata from %s', config.measure_dates_path)
    measure_dates = read_measure_dates(spark, config)

    if config.fail_on_empty and effective_care.rdd.isEmpty():
        raise ValueError('effective care dataset is empty')

    metrics = compute_measure_variation(effective_care)
    enriched = enrich_with_measure_dates(metrics, measure_dates).cache()
    top = rank_top_variation(enriched, config.top_n).cache()

    metrics_path = write_dataframe(enriched, config.output_dir, 'measure_metrics', config.output_format)
    top_path = write_dataframe(top, config.output_dir, 'top_measures', config.output_format)
    top_json_path = write_single_json_artifact(top, config.output_dir, 'top_measures.json')
    top_count = top.count()
    LOGGER.info('wrote %s top measures to %s', top_count, config.output_dir)
    return PipelineResult(metrics_path=metrics_path, top_path=top_path, top_json_path=top_json_path, top_count=top_count)

    config: Optional[Path] = typer.Option(None, '--config', '-c', help='YAML configuration file.'),

    master: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, help='Spark master URL, for example local[*].'),

    if not isinstance(payload, list):
        raise typer.BadParameter('artifact must contain a JSON list')
    for index, row in enumerate(payload, start=1):
        measure_id = row.get('measure_id', '<unknown>')
        name = row.get('measure_name') or '<unnamed>'
        score_range = row.get('score_range')
        typer.echo(f'{index:02d}. {measure_id} | range={score_range} | {name}')

    app()

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def load_artifact(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    payload = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if not isinstance(payload, list) or not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in payload):
        raise ValueError('artifact must be a JSON list of objects')
    return payload


def create_app(artifact: str | Path):
    from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query

    rows = load_artifact(artifact)
    app = FastAPI(title='CareQualitySpark API', version='0.1.0')

    @app.get('/health')
    def health() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    @app.get('/measures')
    def measures(limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100)) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return rows[:limit]

    @app.get('/measures/{measure_id}')
    def measure(measure_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        for row in rows:
            if row.get('measure_id') == measure_id:
                return row
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='measure not found')

    return app


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Serve CareQualitySpark JSON artifacts.')
    parser.add_argument('--artifact', required=True, help='Path to top_measures.json')
    parser.add_argument('--host', default='127.0.0.1')
    parser.add_argument('--port', default=8080, type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    import uvicorn

    uvicorn.run(create_app(args.artifact), host=args.host, port=args.port)

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable


def score_range_from_entries(entries: Iterable[tuple[str, str]]) -> int:
    scores: list[int] = []
    for _, raw_score in entries:
        try:
            scores.append(int(raw_score))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
    if not scores:
        return 0
    return max(scores) - min(scores)
