from __future__ import annotations

import json
from json import JSONDecodeError
from typing import Any

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseNotAllowed, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods, require_POST

from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, create_todo, reopen_todo


def serialize_todo(todo: Todo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        'id': todo.pk,
        'title': todo.title,
        'slug': todo.slug,
        'description': todo.description,
        'priority': todo.priority,
        'is_done': todo.is_done,
        'owner': todo.owner.username,
        'done_by': todo.done_by.username if todo.done_by else None,
        'due_at': todo.due_at.isoformat() if todo.due_at else None,
        'done_at': todo.done_at.isoformat() if todo.done_at else None,
        'created_at': todo.created_at.isoformat() if todo.created_at else None,
        'updated_at': todo.updated_at.isoformat() if todo.updated_at else None,
    }


def request_json(request: HttpRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(request.body.decode('utf-8') or '{}')
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be valid JSON.') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be a JSON object.')
    return payload


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def todo_collection(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    if request.method == 'GET':
        items = [serialize_todo(todo) for todo in todos_for_user(request.user)]
        return JsonResponse({'results': items})
    if request.method == 'POST':
        try:
            payload = request_json(request)
            todo = create_todo(
                owner=request.user,
                title=str(payload.get('title', '')).strip(),
                description=str(payload.get('description', '')).strip(),
                priority=str(payload.get('priority', 'normal')),
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            return JsonResponse({'errors': exc.messages}, status=400)
        return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo), status=201)
    return HttpResponseNotAllowed(['GET', 'POST'])


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET'])
def todo_detail(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo))


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.mixins import LoginRequiredMixin
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseRedirect
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect
from django.urls import reverse_lazy
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST
from django.views.generic import CreateView, DeleteView, DetailView, ListView, UpdateView

from .forms import TodoForm
from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todo_counts_for_user, todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, delete_todo, reopen_todo


class TodoListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/list.html'
    context_object_name = 'todos'
    paginate_by = 25

    def get_queryset(self):
        queryset = todos_for_user(self.request.user)
        status = self.request.GET.get('status')
        if status == 'open':
            queryset = queryset.open()
        elif status == 'done':
            queryset = queryset.done()
        return queryset

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        context = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        context['counts'] = todo_counts_for_user(self.request.user)
        context['status'] = self.request.GET.get('status', 'all')
        return context


class TodoDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/detail.html'

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)


class TodoCreateView(LoginRequiredMixin, CreateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def form_valid(self, form):
        form.instance.owner = self.request.user
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo created.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoUpdateView(LoginRequiredMixin, UpdateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user).open()

    def form_valid(self, form):
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo updated.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, DeleteView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/confirm_delete.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)

    def form_valid(self, form):
        delete_todo(todo=self.object, actor=self.request.user)
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo deleted.')
        return HttpResponseRedirect(self.get_success_url())


@login_required
@require_POST
def complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo completed.' if changed else 'Todo was already completed.')
    return redirect('todo-list')


@login_required
@require_POST
def reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo reopened.' if changed else 'Todo was already open.')
    return redirect('todo-list')

class TodoModelTests(TestCase):

        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertTrue(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertTrue(todo.is_done)
        self.assertEqual(todo.done_by, user)
        self.assertIsNotNone(todo.done_at)

    def test_mark_done_already_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', is_done=True, done_by=user, owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertIsNone(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_mark_done_rejects_non_owner(self):
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username='owner', password='pw')
        other = User.objects.create_user(username='other', password='pw')
        todo = Todo.objects.create(title='Private task', owner=owner)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionDenied):
            todo.mark_done(other)

    def test_open_todo_cannot_have_done_by(self):

        todo = Todo(title='Bad state', owner=user, done_by=user, is_done=False)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            todo.full_clean()

    def test_slug_is_unique_per_owner(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username='user', password='pw')
        first = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        second = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        self.assertNotEqual(first.slug, second.slug)

# "Django_Todo_Tracker/README.md"
# Django Todo Tracker

Django Todo Tracker is a compact but production-oriented task management application. It demonstrates a clean Django architecture around a deceptively small domain object: a todo item that can be completed exactly once by an authorized user.

## Features

- Authenticated CRUD workflow for todos.
- Model-level completion rules compatible with direct ORM usage.
- Service layer for transactional command operations.
- Selector layer for reusable read queries.
- Server-rendered HTML views.
- Lightweight JSON API implemented with core Django.
- Admin customization.
- Test coverage for models, services, views, and API behavior.
- Twelve-factor friendly settings using environment variables.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py runserver
```

Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/ and sign in through the Django admin or login view.

## Demo data

```bash
python scripts/seed_demo.py
```

This creates a demo user with username `demo` and password `demo-password-123`, then inserts a few sample tasks.

## Running tests

```bash
pytest
# or
python manage.py test
```

## Configuration

Environment variables:

- `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`: secret key for the deployment.
- `DJANGO_DEBUG`: `true` or `false`.
- `DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma-separated host list.
- `DATABASE_URL`: currently supports sqlite URLs such as `sqlite:///db.sqlite3`.

# "Django_Todo_Tracker/.env.example"
DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=change-me-in-production
DJANGO_DEBUG=true
DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///db.sqlite3

from __future__ import annotations

from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.template.defaultfilters import slugify
from django.utils import timezone


class TodoPriority(models.TextChoices):
    LOW = 'low', 'Low'
    NORMAL = 'normal', 'Normal'
    HIGH = 'high', 'High'
    URGENT = 'urgent', 'Urgent'


class TodoQuerySet(models.QuerySet['Todo']):
    def for_user(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        if not getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False):
            return self.none()
        return self.filter(owner=user)

    def open(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=False)

    def done(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=True)

    def overdue(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.open().filter(due_at__lt=timezone.now())


class Todo(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    slug = models.SlugField(max_length=220, blank=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    priority = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TodoPriority.choices, default=TodoPriority.NORMAL)
    owner = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, related_name='todos', on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    is_done = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    done_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        related_name='completed_todos',
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
    )
    due_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    done_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    objects = TodoQuerySet.as_manager()

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['is_done', '-priority', 'due_at', '-created_at']
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['owner', 'slug'], name='unique_todo_slug_per_owner'),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(is_done=False, done_at__isnull=True) | Q(is_done=True),
                name='open_todos_do_not_have_done_at',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'is_done']),
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'due_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.title

    def clean(self) -> None:
        if self.done_by_id and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_by': 'Only completed todos may have a completing user.'})
        if self.done_at and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_at': 'Only completed todos may have a completion timestamp.'})

    def save(self, *args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        if not self.slug:
            self.slug = self._build_unique_slug()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def _build_unique_slug(self) -> str:
        base = slugify(self.title)[:180] or 'todo'
        slug = base
        counter = 2
        queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
        if self.pk:
            queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
        while queryset.exists():
            suffix = f'-{counter}'
            slug = f'{base[: 220 - len(suffix)]}{suffix}'
            queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
            if self.pk:
                queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
            counter += 1
        return slug

    def can_be_changed_by(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool:
        return bool(getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False) and self.owner_id == user.pk)

    def mark_done(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can complete this todo.')
        self.is_done = True
        self.done_by = user  # type: ignore[assignment]
        self.done_at = timezone.now()
        if self.pk:
            self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        else:
            self.save()
        return True

    def reopen(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if not self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can reopen this todo.')
        self.is_done = False
        self.done_by = None
        self.done_at = None
        self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        return True

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.db.models import Count, QuerySet

from .models import Todo


def todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return Todo.objects.for_user(user).select_related('owner', 'done_by')


def open_todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return todos_for_user(user).open()


def todo_counts_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = todos_for_user(user).values('is_done').annotate(total=Count('id'))
    counts = {'open': 0, 'done': 0}
    for row in rows:
        counts['done' if row['is_done'] else 'open'] = row['total']
    return counts

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.db import transaction

from .models import Todo, TodoPriority


def ensure_owner(todo: Todo, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    if not todo.can_be_changed_by(user):
        raise PermissionDenied('You do not have access to this todo.')


@transaction.atomic
def create_todo(
    *,
    owner: AbstractBaseUser,
    title: str,
    description: str = '',
    priority: str = TodoPriority.NORMAL,
    due_at: object | None = None,
) -> Todo:
    todo = Todo(owner=owner, title=title.strip(), description=description.strip(), priority=priority, due_at=due_at)
    todo.full_clean()
    todo.save()
    return todo


@transaction.atomic
def complete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.mark_done(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def reopen_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.reopen(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def delete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    todo.delete()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from json import JSONDecodeError
from typing import Any

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseNotAllowed, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods, require_POST

from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, create_todo, reopen_todo


def serialize_todo(todo: Todo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        'id': todo.pk,
        'title': todo.title,
        'slug': todo.slug,
        'description': todo.description,
        'priority': todo.priority,
        'is_done': todo.is_done,
        'owner': todo.owner.username,
        'done_by': todo.done_by.username if todo.done_by else None,
        'due_at': todo.due_at.isoformat() if todo.due_at else None,
        'done_at': todo.done_at.isoformat() if todo.done_at else None,
        'created_at': todo.created_at.isoformat() if todo.created_at else None,
        'updated_at': todo.updated_at.isoformat() if todo.updated_at else None,
    }


def request_json(request: HttpRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(request.body.decode('utf-8') or '{}')
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be valid JSON.') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be a JSON object.')
    return payload


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def todo_collection(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    if request.method == 'GET':
        items = [serialize_todo(todo) for todo in todos_for_user(request.user)]
        return JsonResponse({'results': items})
    if request.method == 'POST':
        try:
            payload = request_json(request)
            todo = create_todo(
                owner=request.user,
                title=str(payload.get('title', '')).strip(),
                description=str(payload.get('description', '')).strip(),
                priority=str(payload.get('priority', 'normal')),
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            return JsonResponse({'errors': exc.messages}, status=400)
        return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo), status=201)
    return HttpResponseNotAllowed(['GET', 'POST'])


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET'])
def todo_detail(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo))


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})

class TodoListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/list.html'
    context_object_name = 'todos'
    paginate_by = 25

    def get_queryset(self):
        queryset = todos_for_user(self.request.user)
        status = self.request.GET.get('status')
        if status == 'open':
            queryset = queryset.open()
        elif status == 'done':
            queryset = queryset.done()
        return queryset

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        context = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        context['counts'] = todo_counts_for_user(self.request.user)
        context['status'] = self.request.GET.get('status', 'all')
        return context


class TodoDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/detail.html'

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)


class TodoCreateView(LoginRequiredMixin, CreateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def form_valid(self, form):
        form.instance.owner = self.request.user
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo created.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoUpdateView(LoginRequiredMixin, UpdateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user).open()

    def form_valid(self, form):
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo updated.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, DeleteView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/confirm_delete.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)

    def form_valid(self, form):
        delete_todo(todo=self.object, actor=self.request.user)
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo deleted.')
        return HttpResponseRedirect(self.get_success_url())


@login_required
@require_POST
def complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo completed.' if changed else 'Todo was already completed.')
    return redirect('todo-list')


@login_required
@require_POST
def reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo reopened.' if changed else 'Todo was already open.')
    return redirect('todo-list')

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.test import TestCase

from todos.models import Todo


class TodoModelTests(TestCase):
    def test_mark_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertTrue(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertTrue(todo.is_done)
        self.assertEqual(todo.done_by, user)
        self.assertIsNotNone(todo.done_at)

    def test_mark_done_already_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', is_done=True, done_by=user, owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertIsNone(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_mark_done_rejects_non_owner(self):
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username='owner', password='pw')
        other = User.objects.create_user(username='other', password='pw')
        todo = Todo.objects.create(title='Private task', owner=owner)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionDenied):
            todo.mark_done(other)

    def test_open_todo_cannot_have_done_by(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username='user', password='pw')
        todo = Todo(title='Bad state', owner=user, done_by=user, is_done=False)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            todo.full_clean()

    def test_slug_is_unique_per_owner(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username='user', password='pw')
        first = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        second = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        self.assertNotEqual(first.slug, second.slug)

# "Django_Todo_Tracker/README.md"
# Django Todo Tracker

Django Todo Tracker is a compact but production-oriented task management application. It demonstrates a clean Django architecture around a deceptively small domain object: a todo item that can be completed exactly once by an authorized user.

## Features

- Authenticated CRUD workflow for todos.
- Model-level completion rules compatible with direct ORM usage.
- Service layer for transactional command operations.
- Selector layer for reusable read queries.
- Server-rendered HTML views.
- Lightweight JSON API implemented with core Django.
- Admin customization.
- Test coverage for models, services, views, and API behavior.
- Twelve-factor friendly settings using environment variables.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py runserver
```

Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/ and sign in through the Django admin or login view.

## Demo data

```bash
python scripts/seed_demo.py
```

This creates a demo user with username `demo` and password `demo-password-123`, then inserts a few sample tasks.

## Running tests

```bash
pytest
# or
python manage.py test
```

## Configuration

Environment variables:

- `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`: secret key for the deployment.
- `DJANGO_DEBUG`: `true` or `false`.
- `DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma-separated host list.
- `DATABASE_URL`: currently supports sqlite URLs such as `sqlite:///db.sqlite3`.

DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=change-me-in-production
DJANGO_DEBUG=true
DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///db.sqlite3

def env_list(name: str, default: list[str]) -> list[str]:

# "Django_Todo_Tracker/todos/models.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.template.defaultfilters import slugify
from django.utils import timezone


class TodoPriority(models.TextChoices):
    LOW = 'low', 'Low'
    NORMAL = 'normal', 'Normal'
    HIGH = 'high', 'High'
    URGENT = 'urgent', 'Urgent'


class TodoQuerySet(models.QuerySet['Todo']):
    def for_user(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        if not getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False):
            return self.none()
        return self.filter(owner=user)

    def open(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=False)

    def done(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=True)

    def overdue(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.open().filter(due_at__lt=timezone.now())


class Todo(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    slug = models.SlugField(max_length=220, blank=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    priority = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TodoPriority.choices, default=TodoPriority.NORMAL)
    owner = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, related_name='todos', on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    is_done = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    done_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        related_name='completed_todos',
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
    )
    due_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    done_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    objects = TodoQuerySet.as_manager()

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['is_done', '-priority', 'due_at', '-created_at']
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['owner', 'slug'], name='unique_todo_slug_per_owner'),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(is_done=False, done_at__isnull=True) | Q(is_done=True),
                name='open_todos_do_not_have_done_at',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'is_done']),
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'due_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.title

    def clean(self) -> None:
        if self.done_by_id and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_by': 'Only completed todos may have a completing user.'})
        if self.done_at and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_at': 'Only completed todos may have a completion timestamp.'})

    def save(self, *args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        if not self.slug:
            self.slug = self._build_unique_slug()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def _build_unique_slug(self) -> str:
        base = slugify(self.title)[:180] or 'todo'
        slug = base
        counter = 2
        queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
        if self.pk:
            queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
        while queryset.exists():
            suffix = f'-{counter}'
            slug = f'{base[: 220 - len(suffix)]}{suffix}'
            queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
            if self.pk:
                queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
            counter += 1
        return slug

    def can_be_changed_by(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool:
        return bool(getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False) and self.owner_id == user.pk)

    def mark_done(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can complete this todo.')
        self.is_done = True
        self.done_by = user  # type: ignore[assignment]
        self.done_at = timezone.now()
        if self.pk:
            self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        else:
            self.save()
        return True

    def reopen(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if not self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can reopen this todo.')
        self.is_done = False
        self.done_by = None
        self.done_at = None
        self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        return True

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.db.models import Count, QuerySet

from .models import Todo


def todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return Todo.objects.for_user(user).select_related('owner', 'done_by')


def open_todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return todos_for_user(user).open()


def todo_counts_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = todos_for_user(user).values('is_done').annotate(total=Count('id'))
    counts = {'open': 0, 'done': 0}
    for row in rows:
        counts['done' if row['is_done'] else 'open'] = row['total']
    return counts

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.db import transaction

from .models import Todo, TodoPriority


def ensure_owner(todo: Todo, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    if not todo.can_be_changed_by(user):
        raise PermissionDenied('You do not have access to this todo.')


@transaction.atomic
def create_todo(
    *,
    owner: AbstractBaseUser,
    title: str,
    description: str = '',
    priority: str = TodoPriority.NORMAL,
    due_at: object | None = None,
) -> Todo:
    todo = Todo(owner=owner, title=title.strip(), description=description.strip(), priority=priority, due_at=due_at)
    todo.full_clean()
    todo.save()
    return todo


@transaction.atomic
def complete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.mark_done(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def reopen_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.reopen(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def delete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    todo.delete()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from json import JSONDecodeError
from typing import Any

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseNotAllowed, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods, require_POST

from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, create_todo, reopen_todo


def serialize_todo(todo: Todo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        'id': todo.pk,
        'title': todo.title,
        'slug': todo.slug,
        'description': todo.description,
        'priority': todo.priority,
        'is_done': todo.is_done,
        'owner': todo.owner.username,
        'done_by': todo.done_by.username if todo.done_by else None,
        'due_at': todo.due_at.isoformat() if todo.due_at else None,
        'done_at': todo.done_at.isoformat() if todo.done_at else None,
        'created_at': todo.created_at.isoformat() if todo.created_at else None,
        'updated_at': todo.updated_at.isoformat() if todo.updated_at else None,
    }


def request_json(request: HttpRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(request.body.decode('utf-8') or '{}')
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be valid JSON.') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be a JSON object.')
    return payload


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def todo_collection(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    if request.method == 'GET':
        items = [serialize_todo(todo) for todo in todos_for_user(request.user)]
        return JsonResponse({'results': items})
    if request.method == 'POST':
        try:
            payload = request_json(request)
            todo = create_todo(
                owner=request.user,
                title=str(payload.get('title', '')).strip(),
                description=str(payload.get('description', '')).strip(),
                priority=str(payload.get('priority', 'normal')),
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            return JsonResponse({'errors': exc.messages}, status=400)
        return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo), status=201)
    return HttpResponseNotAllowed(['GET', 'POST'])


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET'])
def todo_detail(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo))


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.mixins import LoginRequiredMixin
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseRedirect
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect
from django.urls import reverse_lazy
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST
from django.views.generic import CreateView, DeleteView, DetailView, ListView, UpdateView

from .forms import TodoForm
from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todo_counts_for_user, todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, delete_todo, reopen_todo


class TodoListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/list.html'
    context_object_name = 'todos'
    paginate_by = 25

    def get_queryset(self):
        queryset = todos_for_user(self.request.user)
        status = self.request.GET.get('status')
        if status == 'open':
            queryset = queryset.open()
        elif status == 'done':
            queryset = queryset.done()
        return queryset

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        context = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        context['counts'] = todo_counts_for_user(self.request.user)
        context['status'] = self.request.GET.get('status', 'all')
        return context


class TodoDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/detail.html'

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)


class TodoCreateView(LoginRequiredMixin, CreateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def form_valid(self, form):
        form.instance.owner = self.request.user
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo created.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoUpdateView(LoginRequiredMixin, UpdateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user).open()

    def form_valid(self, form):
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo updated.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, DeleteView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/confirm_delete.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)

    def form_valid(self, form):
        delete_todo(todo=self.object, actor=self.request.user)
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo deleted.')
        return HttpResponseRedirect(self.get_success_url())


@login_required
@require_POST
def complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo completed.' if changed else 'Todo was already completed.')
    return redirect('todo-list')


@login_required
@require_POST
def reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo reopened.' if changed else 'Todo was already open.')
    return redirect('todo-list')

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.test import TestCase

from todos.models import Todo


class TodoModelTests(TestCase):
    def test_mark_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertTrue(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertTrue(todo.is_done)
        self.assertEqual(todo.done_by, user)
        self.assertIsNotNone(todo.done_at)

    def test_mark_done_already_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', is_done=True, done_by=user, owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertIsNone(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_mark_done_rejects_non_owner(self):
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username='owner', password='pw')
        other = User.objects.create_user(username='other', password='pw')
        todo = Todo.objects.create(title='Private task', owner=owner)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionDenied):
            todo.mark_done(other)

    def test_open_todo_cannot_have_done_by(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username='user', password='pw')
        todo = Todo(title='Bad state', owner=user, done_by=user, is_done=False)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            todo.full_clean()

    def test_slug_is_unique_per_owner(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username='user', password='pw')
        first = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        second = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        self.assertNotEqual(first.slug, second.slug)

# "Django_Todo_Tracker/README.md"
# Django Todo Tracker

Django Todo Tracker is a compact but production-oriented task management application. It demonstrates a clean Django architecture around a deceptively small domain object: a todo item that can be completed exactly once by an authorized user.

## Features

- Authenticated CRUD workflow for todos.
- Model-level completion rules compatible with direct ORM usage.
- Service layer for transactional command operations.
- Selector layer for reusable read queries.
- Server-rendered HTML views.
- Lightweight JSON API implemented with core Django.
- Admin customization.
- Test coverage for models, services, views, and API behavior.
- Twelve-factor friendly settings using environment variables.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py runserver
```

Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/ and sign in through the Django admin or login view.

## Demo data

```bash
python scripts/seed_demo.py
```

This creates a demo user with username `demo` and password `demo-password-123`, then inserts a few sample tasks.

## Running tests

```bash
pytest
# or
python manage.py test
```

## Configuration

Environment variables:

- `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`: secret key for the deployment.
- `DJANGO_DEBUG`: `true` or `false`.
- `DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma-separated host list.
- `DATABASE_URL`: currently supports sqlite URLs such as `sqlite:///db.sqlite3`.

DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=change-me-in-production
DJANGO_DEBUG=true
DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///db.sqlite3

from __future__ import annotations

from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.template.defaultfilters import slugify
from django.utils import timezone


class TodoPriority(models.TextChoices):
    LOW = 'low', 'Low'
    NORMAL = 'normal', 'Normal'
    HIGH = 'high', 'High'
    URGENT = 'urgent', 'Urgent'


class TodoQuerySet(models.QuerySet['Todo']):
    def for_user(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        if not getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False):
            return self.none()
        return self.filter(owner=user)

    def open(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=False)

    def done(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=True)

    def overdue(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.open().filter(due_at__lt=timezone.now())


class Todo(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    slug = models.SlugField(max_length=220, blank=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    priority = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TodoPriority.choices, default=TodoPriority.NORMAL)
    owner = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, related_name='todos', on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    is_done = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    done_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        related_name='completed_todos',
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
    )
    due_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    done_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    objects = TodoQuerySet.as_manager()

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['is_done', '-priority', 'due_at', '-created_at']
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['owner', 'slug'], name='unique_todo_slug_per_owner'),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(is_done=False, done_at__isnull=True) | Q(is_done=True),
                name='open_todos_do_not_have_done_at',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'is_done']),
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'due_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.title

    def clean(self) -> None:
        if self.done_by_id and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_by': 'Only completed todos may have a completing user.'})
        if self.done_at and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_at': 'Only completed todos may have a completion timestamp.'})

    def save(self, *args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        if not self.slug:
            self.slug = self._build_unique_slug()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def _build_unique_slug(self) -> str:
        base = slugify(self.title)[:180] or 'todo'
        slug = base
        counter = 2
        queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
        if self.pk:
            queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
        while queryset.exists():
            suffix = f'-{counter}'
            slug = f'{base[: 220 - len(suffix)]}{suffix}'
            queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
            if self.pk:
                queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
            counter += 1
        return slug

    def can_be_changed_by(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool:
        return bool(getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False) and self.owner_id == user.pk)

    def mark_done(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can complete this todo.')
        self.is_done = True
        self.done_by = user  # type: ignore[assignment]
        self.done_at = timezone.now()
        if self.pk:
            self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        else:
            self.save()
        return True

    def reopen(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if not self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can reopen this todo.')
        self.is_done = False
        self.done_by = None
        self.done_at = None
        self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        return True

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.db.models import Count, QuerySet

from .models import Todo


def todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return Todo.objects.for_user(user).select_related('owner', 'done_by')


def open_todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return todos_for_user(user).open()


def todo_counts_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = todos_for_user(user).values('is_done').annotate(total=Count('id'))
    counts = {'open': 0, 'done': 0}
    for row in rows:
        counts['done' if row['is_done'] else 'open'] = row['total']
    return counts

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.db import transaction

from .models import Todo, TodoPriority


def ensure_owner(todo: Todo, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    if not todo.can_be_changed_by(user):
        raise PermissionDenied('You do not have access to this todo.')


@transaction.atomic
def create_todo(
    *,
    owner: AbstractBaseUser,
    title: str,
    description: str = '',
    priority: str = TodoPriority.NORMAL,
    due_at: object | None = None,
) -> Todo:
    todo = Todo(owner=owner, title=title.strip(), description=description.strip(), priority=priority, due_at=due_at)
    todo.full_clean()
    todo.save()
    return todo


@transaction.atomic
def complete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.mark_done(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def reopen_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.reopen(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def delete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    todo.delete()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from json import JSONDecodeError
from typing import Any

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseNotAllowed, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods, require_POST

from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, create_todo, reopen_todo


def serialize_todo(todo: Todo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        'id': todo.pk,
        'title': todo.title,
        'slug': todo.slug,
        'description': todo.description,
        'priority': todo.priority,
        'is_done': todo.is_done,
        'owner': todo.owner.username,
        'done_by': todo.done_by.username if todo.done_by else None,
        'due_at': todo.due_at.isoformat() if todo.due_at else None,
        'done_at': todo.done_at.isoformat() if todo.done_at else None,
        'created_at': todo.created_at.isoformat() if todo.created_at else None,
        'updated_at': todo.updated_at.isoformat() if todo.updated_at else None,
    }


def request_json(request: HttpRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(request.body.decode('utf-8') or '{}')
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be valid JSON.') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be a JSON object.')
    return payload


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def todo_collection(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    if request.method == 'GET':
        items = [serialize_todo(todo) for todo in todos_for_user(request.user)]
        return JsonResponse({'results': items})
    if request.method == 'POST':
        try:
            payload = request_json(request)
            todo = create_todo(
                owner=request.user,
                title=str(payload.get('title', '')).strip(),
                description=str(payload.get('description', '')).strip(),
                priority=str(payload.get('priority', 'normal')),
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            return JsonResponse({'errors': exc.messages}, status=400)
        return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo), status=201)
    return HttpResponseNotAllowed(['GET', 'POST'])


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET'])
def todo_detail(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo))


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})

class TodoListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/list.html'
    context_object_name = 'todos'
    paginate_by = 25

    def get_queryset(self):
        queryset = todos_for_user(self.request.user)
        status = self.request.GET.get('status')
        if status == 'open':
            queryset = queryset.open()
        elif status == 'done':
            queryset = queryset.done()
        return queryset

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        context = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        context['counts'] = todo_counts_for_user(self.request.user)
        context['status'] = self.request.GET.get('status', 'all')
        return context

@require_POST
def complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo completed.' if changed else 'Todo was already completed.')
    return redirect('todo-list')


@login_required
@require_POST
def reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo reopened.' if changed else 'Todo was already open.')
    return redirect('todo-list')

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.test import TestCase

from todos.models import Todo


class TodoModelTests(TestCase):
    def test_mark_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertTrue(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertTrue(todo.is_done)
        self.assertEqual(todo.done_by, user)
        self.assertIsNotNone(todo.done_at)

    def test_mark_done_already_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', is_done=True, done_by=user, owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertIsNone(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_mark_done_rejects_non_owner(self):
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username='owner', password='pw')
        other = User.objects.create_user(username='other', password='pw')
        todo = Todo.objects.create(title='Private task', owner=owner)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionDenied):
            todo.mark_done(other)

    def test_open_todo_cannot_have_done_by(self):

        todo = Todo(title='Bad state', owner=user, done_by=user, is_done=False)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            todo.full_clean()

    def test_slug_is_unique_per_owner(self):

        self.assertNotEqual(first.slug, second.slug)

# "Django_Todo_Tracker/README.md"
# Django Todo Tracker

Django Todo Tracker is a compact but production-oriented task management application. It demonstrates a clean Django architecture around a deceptively small domain object: a todo item that can be completed exactly once by an authorized user.

## Features

- Authenticated CRUD workflow for todos.
- Model-level completion rules compatible with direct ORM usage.
- Service layer for transactional command operations.
- Selector layer for reusable read queries.
- Server-rendered HTML views.
- Lightweight JSON API implemented with core Django.
- Admin customization.
- Test coverage for models, services, views, and API behavior.
- Twelve-factor friendly settings using environment variables.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py createsuperuser
python manage.py runserver
```

Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/ and sign in through the Django admin or login view.

## Demo data

```bash
python scripts/seed_demo.py
```

This creates a demo user with username `demo` and password `demo-password-123`, then inserts a few sample tasks.

## Running tests

```bash
pytest
# or
python manage.py test
```

## Configuration

Environment variables:

- `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`: secret key for the deployment.
- `DJANGO_DEBUG`: `true` or `false`.
- `DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS`: comma-separated host list.
- `DATABASE_URL`: currently supports sqlite URLs such as `sqlite:///db.sqlite3`.

DJANGO_DEBUG=true

DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///db.sqlite3

# "Django_Todo_Tracker/todos/models.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from django.conf import settings
from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.template.defaultfilters import slugify
from django.utils import timezone


class TodoPriority(models.TextChoices):
    LOW = 'low', 'Low'
    NORMAL = 'normal', 'Normal'
    HIGH = 'high', 'High'
    URGENT = 'urgent', 'Urgent'


class TodoQuerySet(models.QuerySet['Todo']):
    def for_user(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        if not getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False):
            return self.none()
        return self.filter(owner=user)

    def open(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=False)

    def done(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.filter(is_done=True)

    def overdue(self) -> 'TodoQuerySet':
        return self.open().filter(due_at__lt=timezone.now())


class Todo(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    slug = models.SlugField(max_length=220, blank=True)
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    priority = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=TodoPriority.choices, default=TodoPriority.NORMAL)
    owner = models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, related_name='todos', on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    is_done = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    done_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        related_name='completed_todos',
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
    )
    due_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    done_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    objects = TodoQuerySet.as_manager()

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['is_done', '-priority', 'due_at', '-created_at']
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['owner', 'slug'], name='unique_todo_slug_per_owner'),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(is_done=False, done_at__isnull=True) | Q(is_done=True),
                name='open_todos_do_not_have_done_at',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'is_done']),
            models.Index(fields=['owner', 'due_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.title

    def clean(self) -> None:
        if self.done_by_id and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_by': 'Only completed todos may have a completing user.'})
        if self.done_at and not self.is_done:
            raise ValidationError({'done_at': 'Only completed todos may have a completion timestamp.'})

    def save(self, *args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        if not self.slug:
            self.slug = self._build_unique_slug()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def _build_unique_slug(self) -> str:
        base = slugify(self.title)[:180] or 'todo'
        slug = base
        counter = 2
        queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
        if self.pk:
            queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
        while queryset.exists():
            suffix = f'-{counter}'
            slug = f'{base[: 220 - len(suffix)]}{suffix}'
            queryset = Todo.objects.filter(owner=self.owner, slug=slug)
            if self.pk:
                queryset = queryset.exclude(pk=self.pk)
            counter += 1
        return slug

    def can_be_changed_by(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool:
        return bool(getattr(user, 'is_authenticated', False) and self.owner_id == user.pk)

    def mark_done(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can complete this todo.')
        self.is_done = True
        self.done_by = user  # type: ignore[assignment]
        self.done_at = timezone.now()
        if self.pk:
            self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        else:
            self.save()
        return True

    def reopen(self, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
        if not self.is_done:
            return None
        if not self.can_be_changed_by(user):
            raise PermissionDenied('Only the owner can reopen this todo.')
        self.is_done = False
        self.done_by = None
        self.done_at = None
        self.save(update_fields=['is_done', 'done_by', 'done_at', 'updated_at'])
        return True

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.db.models import Count, QuerySet

from .models import Todo


def todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return Todo.objects.for_user(user).select_related('owner', 'done_by')


def open_todos_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> QuerySet[Todo]:
    return todos_for_user(user).open()


def todo_counts_for_user(user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = todos_for_user(user).values('is_done').annotate(total=Count('id'))
    counts = {'open': 0, 'done': 0}
    for row in rows:
        counts['done' if row['is_done'] else 'open'] = row['total']
    return counts

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractBaseUser, AnonymousUser
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.db import transaction

from .models import Todo, TodoPriority


def ensure_owner(todo: Todo, user: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    if not todo.can_be_changed_by(user):
        raise PermissionDenied('You do not have access to this todo.')


@transaction.atomic
def create_todo(
    *,
    owner: AbstractBaseUser,
    title: str,
    description: str = '',
    priority: str = TodoPriority.NORMAL,
    due_at: object | None = None,
) -> Todo:
    todo = Todo(owner=owner, title=title.strip(), description=description.strip(), priority=priority, due_at=due_at)
    todo.full_clean()
    todo.save()
    return todo


@transaction.atomic
def complete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.mark_done(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def reopen_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> bool | None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    return todo.reopen(actor)


@transaction.atomic
def delete_todo(*, todo: Todo, actor: AbstractBaseUser | AnonymousUser) -> None:
    ensure_owner(todo, actor)
    todo.delete()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from json import JSONDecodeError
from typing import Any

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseNotAllowed, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods, require_POST

from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, create_todo, reopen_todo


def serialize_todo(todo: Todo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        'id': todo.pk,
        'title': todo.title,
        'slug': todo.slug,
        'description': todo.description,
        'priority': todo.priority,
        'is_done': todo.is_done,
        'owner': todo.owner.username,
        'done_by': todo.done_by.username if todo.done_by else None,
        'due_at': todo.due_at.isoformat() if todo.due_at else None,
        'done_at': todo.done_at.isoformat() if todo.done_at else None,
        'created_at': todo.created_at.isoformat() if todo.created_at else None,
        'updated_at': todo.updated_at.isoformat() if todo.updated_at else None,
    }


def request_json(request: HttpRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(request.body.decode('utf-8') or '{}')
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be valid JSON.') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValidationError('Request body must be a JSON object.')
    return payload


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def todo_collection(request: HttpRequest) -> HttpResponse:
    if request.method == 'GET':
        items = [serialize_todo(todo) for todo in todos_for_user(request.user)]
        return JsonResponse({'results': items})
    if request.method == 'POST':
        try:
            payload = request_json(request)
            todo = create_todo(
                owner=request.user,
                title=str(payload.get('title', '')).strip(),
                description=str(payload.get('description', '')).strip(),
                priority=str(payload.get('priority', 'normal')),
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            return JsonResponse({'errors': exc.messages}, status=400)
        return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo), status=201)
    return HttpResponseNotAllowed(['GET', 'POST'])


@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET'])
def todo_detail(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    return JsonResponse(serialize_todo(todo))


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})


@login_required
@require_POST
def todo_reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> JsonResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(Todo, pk=pk)
    try:
        changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    except PermissionDenied:
        return JsonResponse({'detail': 'Not found.'}, status=404)
    return JsonResponse({'changed': bool(changed), 'todo': serialize_todo(todo)})

from __future__ import annotations

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.mixins import LoginRequiredMixin
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.http import HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpResponseRedirect
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect
from django.urls import reverse_lazy
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST
from django.views.generic import CreateView, DeleteView, DetailView, ListView, UpdateView

from .forms import TodoForm
from .models import Todo
from .selectors import todo_counts_for_user, todos_for_user
from .services import complete_todo, delete_todo, reopen_todo


class TodoListView(LoginRequiredMixin, ListView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/list.html'
    context_object_name = 'todos'
    paginate_by = 25

    def get_queryset(self):
        queryset = todos_for_user(self.request.user)
        status = self.request.GET.get('status')
        if status == 'open':
            queryset = queryset.open()
        elif status == 'done':
            queryset = queryset.done()
        return queryset

    def get_context_data(self, **kwargs):
        context = super().get_context_data(**kwargs)
        context['counts'] = todo_counts_for_user(self.request.user)
        context['status'] = self.request.GET.get('status', 'all')
        return context


class TodoDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/detail.html'

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)


class TodoCreateView(LoginRequiredMixin, CreateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def form_valid(self, form):
        form.instance.owner = self.request.user
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo created.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoUpdateView(LoginRequiredMixin, UpdateView):
    model = Todo
    form_class = TodoForm
    template_name = 'todos/form.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user).open()

    def form_valid(self, form):
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo updated.')
        return super().form_valid(form)


class TodoDeleteView(LoginRequiredMixin, DeleteView):
    model = Todo
    template_name = 'todos/confirm_delete.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('todo-list')

    def get_queryset(self):
        return todos_for_user(self.request.user)

    def form_valid(self, form):
        delete_todo(todo=self.object, actor=self.request.user)
        messages.success(self.request, 'Todo deleted.')
        return HttpResponseRedirect(self.get_success_url())


@login_required
@require_POST
def complete(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = complete_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo completed.' if changed else 'Todo was already completed.')
    return redirect('todo-list')


@login_required
@require_POST
def reopen(request: HttpRequest, pk: int) -> HttpResponse:
    todo = get_object_or_404(todos_for_user(request.user), pk=pk)
    changed = reopen_todo(todo=todo, actor=request.user)
    messages.success(request, 'Todo reopened.' if changed else 'Todo was already open.')
    return redirect('todo-list')

from todos.models import Todo


class TodoModelTests(TestCase):
    def test_mark_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertTrue(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertTrue(todo.is_done)
        self.assertEqual(todo.done_by, user)
        self.assertIsNotNone(todo.done_at)

    def test_mark_done_already_done(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(email='user@example.com', username='user', password='somepasswd')
        todo = Todo(title='SomeTitle', description='SomeDescr', is_done=True, done_by=user, owner=user)
        res = todo.mark_done(user)
        self.assertIsNone(res)
        self.assertEqual(Todo.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_mark_done_rejects_non_owner(self):
        owner = User.objects.create_user(username='owner', password='pw')
        other = User.objects.create_user(username='other', password='pw')
        todo = Todo.objects.create(title='Private task', owner=owner)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionDenied):
            todo.mark_done(other)

    def test_open_todo_cannot_have_done_by(self):

        todo = Todo(title='Bad state', owner=user, done_by=user, is_done=False)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            todo.full_clean()

    def test_slug_is_unique_per_owner(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username='user', password='pw')
        first = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        second = Todo.objects.create(title='Repeated title', owner=user)
        self.assertNotEqual(first.slug, second.slug)

The original workflow was a small script that assumed fixed spreadsheet columns and wrote files into `../EventObjects`. This project keeps that behavior available while adding a tested package, a CLI, configuration files, validation, deterministic rendering, and safer filesystem handling. ## Features - Parses Civ VI event rows from CSV files with configurable column mappings. - Distinguishes `Events` from `GameEvents` using the companion spreadsheet marker column. - Generates one index page per event container. - Generates one Markdown page per event with usage examples and parameter sections. - Supports dry runs, strict validation, YAML configuration, and custom output directories. - Uses deterministic ordering for reproducible documentation builds. ## Installation ```bash python -m pip install -e '.[dev]' ``` ## Quick start ```bash civ6-docgen generate \ --csv 'Civ VI Modding Companion - Events.csv' \ --output EventObjects ``` Or use a configuration file: ```bash civ6-docgen generate --config examples/docgen.yaml ``` ## CSV expectations By default the generator matches the legacy companion export: | Meaning | Default column index | | --- | ---: | | Event name | 3 | | Argument name | 4 | | Argument type | 5 | | GameEvents marker | 10 | The first four rows are skipped by default because the spreadsheet export commonly contains title and helper rows before the actual event data. ## Development Run tests: ```bash pytest ``` Run linting: ```bash ruff check . ``` # # "CharWordCRF_NER/README.md"
# CharWordCRF NER

A modern Python 3.12 and PyTorch implementation of a character-aware word BiLSTM-CRF sequence tagger for CoNLL-style named entity recognition.

The project expands an old TensorFlow research script into a reproducible training and inference package with configuration, checkpointing, metrics, command line tools, tests, and an optional FastAPI serving layer.

## Features

- CoNLL token-per-line data loading with sentence boundaries
- Word vocabulary, character vocabulary, and label vocabulary persistence
- Character BiLSTM encoder for subword morphology
- Word BiLSTM encoder over concatenated word and character features
- Linear-chain CRF loss and Viterbi decoding implemented in PyTorch
- Training loop with validation, gradient clipping, early stopping, checkpoints, and JSONL metrics
- Evaluation report with token accuracy and entity-level precision, recall, and F1
- Batch prediction CLI and HTTP serving API

## Data format

Each non-empty line should contain a token and a tag. Extra columns are allowed; the first column is treated as token and the last column as tag.

Example:

John B-PER
lives O
in O
Berlin B-LOC

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

python -m pip install -e .[serve]

Train:

ner-crf train --config configs/default.yaml

Evaluate:

ner-crf evaluate --checkpoint artifacts/checkpoints/best.pt --data data/eng.testa

Predict:

ner-crf predict --checkpoint artifacts/checkpoints/best.pt --text John lives in Berlin

Serve:

uvicorn charwordcrf.serve:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

import yaml


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Config:
    seed: int = 13
    train_path: str = 'data/eng.train'
    valid_path: str = 'data/eng.testa'
    test_path: str = 'data/eng.testb'
    output_dir: str = 'artifacts'
    lowercase: bool = True
    min_word_freq: int = 1
    max_char_length: int = 32
    batch_size: int = 32
    epochs: int = 20
    patience: int = 5
    learning_rate: float = 1e-3
    weight_decay: float = 0.0
    grad_clip: float = 5.0
    word_embedding_dim: int = 100
    char_embedding_dim: int = 48
    char_hidden_dim: int = 64
    word_hidden_dim: int = 192
    num_lstm_layers: int = 1
    dropout: float = 0.35
    device: str = 'auto'

    @classmethod
    def from_yaml(cls, path: str | Path) -> Config:
        with Path(path).open('r', encoding='utf8') as handle:
            data: dict[str, Any] = yaml.safe_load(handle) or {}
        allowed = set(cls.__dataclass_fields__)
        unknown = sorted(set(data) - allowed)
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f'Unknown config fields: {unknown}')
        return cls(**data)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    def save(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        target = Path(path)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with target.open('w', encoding='utf8') as handle:
            yaml.safe_dump(self.to_dict(), handle, sort_keys=False)
