from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from django.core.validators import MaxValueValidator, MinValueValidator
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone


class TimestampedModel(models.Model):
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        abstract = True


class Location(TimestampedModel):
    city = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    street_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    street_number = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
    postal_code = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
    country = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    latitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6, null=True, blank=True, validators=[MinValueValidator(-90), MaxValueValidator(90)])
    longitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6, null=True, blank=True, validators=[MinValueValidator(-180), MaxValueValidator(180)])

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['country', 'city', 'name']
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=['country', 'city']), models.Index(fields=['name'])]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        label = self.name or self.street_name or 'Unnamed location'
        place = ', '.join(part for part in [self.city, self.country] if part)
        return f'{label} - {place}' if place else label


class Person(TimestampedModel):
    class Gender(models.TextChoices):
        FEMALE = 'Female', 'Female'
        MALE = 'Male', 'Male'
        NON_BINARY = 'NonBinary', 'Non-binary'
        UNKNOWN = 'Unknown', 'Unknown'

    nickname = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    first_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    last_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    location = models.ForeignKey(Location, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name='residents')
    birth_day = models.DateField(default=date(1900, 1, 1))
    height_cm = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(null=True, blank=True, validators=[MinValueValidator(40), MaxValueValidator(260)])
    gender = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=Gender.choices, default=Gender.UNKNOWN)
    notes = models.TextField(blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['last_name', 'first_name', 'nickname']
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=['last_name', 'first_name']), models.Index(fields=['nickname'])]

    @property
    def display_name(self) -> str:
        full_name = ' '.join(part for part in [self.first_name, self.last_name] if part).strip()
        return self.nickname or full_name or f'Person {self.pk}'

    @property
    def age(self) -> int | None:
        if self.birth_day == date(1900, 1, 1):
            return None
        today = timezone.localdate()
        return today.year - self.birth_day.year - ((today.month, today.day) < (self.birth_day.month, self.birth_day.day))

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.display_name


class ContactType(TimestampedModel):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True)
    validation_regexp = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['name']

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Contact(TimestampedModel):
    person = models.ForeignKey(Person, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='contacts')
    contact_type = models.ForeignKey(ContactType, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name='contacts')
    contact = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    is_primary = models.BooleanField(default=False)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['person', 'contact_type', 'contact']
        constraints = [models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['person', 'contact_type', 'contact'], name='unique_contact_per_person_type')]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.person}: {self.contact}'


class RelationType(TimestampedModel):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True)
    reciprocal_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['name']

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class Relation(TimestampedModel):
    person1 = models.ForeignKey(Person, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='outgoing_relations')
    person2 = models.ForeignKey(Person, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='incoming_relations')
    description = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    relation_type = models.ForeignKey(RelationType, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name='relations')

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['person1', 'person2']
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(check=~Q(person1=models.F('person2')), name='relation_people_must_differ'),
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['person1', 'person2', 'relation_type'], name='unique_relation_edge'),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.person1} -> {self.person2} ({self.relation_type})'


class Meeting(TimestampedModel):
    start_at = models.DateTimeField(db_index=True)
    description = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True)
    duration = models.DurationField()
    location = models.ForeignKey(Location, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name='meetings')
    participants = models.ManyToManyField(Person, through='MeetingParticipant', related_name='meetings')

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-start_at']
        indexes = [models.Index(fields=['start_at', 'location'])]

    @property
    def ends_at(self):
        return self.start_at + self.duration

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.start_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} {self.description} at {self.location}'


class MeetingParticipant(TimestampedModel):
    person = models.ForeignKey(Person, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    meeting = models.ForeignKey(Meeting, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    attended = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    role = models.CharField(max_length=60, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['meeting', 'person']
        constraints = [models.UniqueConstraint(fields=['person', 'meeting'], name='unique_person_meeting')]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f'{self.person} at {self.meeting}'

        read_only_fields = ['created_at', 'updated_at']

    def validate(self, attrs):
        contact_type = attrs.get('contact_type') or getattr(self.instance, 'contact_type', None)
        contact = attrs.get('contact') or getattr(self.instance, 'contact', '')
        if contact_type and contact_type.validation_regexp and not re.fullmatch(contact_type.validation_regexp, contact):

    class Meta:
        model = Relation
        fields = ['id', 'person1', 'person1_name', 'person2', 'person2_name', 'relation_type', 'relation_type_name', 'description', 'created_at', 'updated_at']
        read_only_fields = ['created_at', 'updated_at']

    def validate(self, attrs):
        person1 = attrs.get('person1') or getattr(self.instance, 'person1', None)
        person2 = attrs.get('person2') or getattr(self.instance, 'person2', None)
        if person1 and person2 and person1 == person2:

class MeetingParticipantSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):

    class Meta:

        fields = ['id', 'person', 'person_name', 'attended', 'role']


class MeetingSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    participants_detail = MeetingParticipantSerializer(source='meetingparticipant_set', many=True, read_only=True)
    participant_ids = serializers.PrimaryKeyRelatedField(source='participants', queryset=Person.objects.all(), many=True, write_only=True, required=False)
    location_name = serializers.CharField(source='location.name', read_only=True)

    class Meta:
        model = Meeting
        fields = ['id', 'start_at', 'description', 'duration', 'location', 'location_name', 'participant_ids', 'participants_detail', 'created_at', 'updated_at']
        read_only_fields = ['created_at', 'updated_at']

    def validate_duration(self, value: timedelta) -> timedelta:
        if value.total_seconds() <= 0:
            raise serializers.ValidationError('Meeting duration must be positive.')
        if value > timedelta(hours=24):
            raise serializers.ValidationError('Meeting duration cannot exceed 24 hours.')
        return value

    def create(self, validated_data):
        participants = validated_data.pop('participants', [])
        try:
            return MeetingScheduler().schedule(participants=participants, **validated_data)
        except DjangoValidationError as exc:
            raise serializers.ValidationError(exc.message_dict if hasattr(exc, 'message_dict') else exc.messages) from exc

    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        participants = validated_data.pop('participants', None)
        for key, value in validated_data.items():
            setattr(instance, key, value)
        instance.full_clean()
        instance.save()
        if participants is not None:
            instance.meetingparticipant_set.all().delete()
            MeetingParticipant.objects.bulk_create([MeetingParticipant(meeting=instance, person=person) for person in participants])
        return instance

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Iterable

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q, QuerySet
from django.utils import timezone

from crm.models import Contact, ContactType, Location, Meeting, MeetingParticipant, Person, Relation, RelationType


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NetworkEdge:
    person_id: int
    person_name: str
    relation_type: str
    direction: str
    depth: int


class ContactBookService:
    def ensure_contact_type(self, name: str, validation_regexp: str = '') -> ContactType:
        contact_type, _ = ContactType.objects.get_or_create(name=name, defaults={'validation_regexp': validation_regexp})
        return contact_type

    def set_primary_contact(self, contact: Contact) -> Contact:
        with transaction.atomic():
            Contact.objects.filter(person=contact.person, contact_type=contact.contact_type, is_primary=True).exclude(pk=contact.pk).update(is_primary=False)
            contact.is_primary = True
            contact.save(update_fields=['is_primary', 'updated_at'])
        return contact


class RelationshipGraphService:
    def create_relation(self, person1: Person, person2: Person, relation_type: RelationType, description: str = '') -> Relation:
        if person1.pk == person2.pk:
            raise ValidationError('A person cannot be related to themselves.')
        relation, _ = Relation.objects.get_or_create(
            person1=person1,
            person2=person2,
            relation_type=relation_type,
            defaults={'description': description},
        )
        return relation

    def neighborhood(self, person: Person, max_depth: int = 1) -> list[NetworkEdge]:
        if max_depth < 1 or max_depth > 4:
            raise ValidationError('max_depth must be between 1 and 4.')
        visited = {person.pk}
        queue: deque[tuple[Person, int]] = deque([(person, 0)])
        edges: list[NetworkEdge] = []
        while queue:
            current, depth = queue.popleft()
            if depth >= max_depth:
                continue
            relations = Relation.objects.select_related('person1', 'person2', 'relation_type').filter(Q(person1=current) | Q(person2=current))
            for relation in relations:
                if relation.person1_id == current.pk:
                    other = relation.person2
                    direction = 'outgoing'
                    relation_name = relation.relation_type.name
                else:
                    other = relation.person1
                    direction = 'incoming'
                    relation_name = relation.relation_type.reciprocal_name or relation.relation_type.name
                edges.append(NetworkEdge(other.pk, other.display_name, relation_name, direction, depth + 1))
                if other.pk not in visited:
                    visited.add(other.pk)
                    queue.append((other, depth + 1))
        return edges


class MeetingScheduler:
    def schedule(self, *, start_at, duration: timedelta, location: Location, description: str = '', participants: Iterable[Person] = ()) -> Meeting:
        if duration.total_seconds() <= 0:
            raise ValidationError('Meeting duration must be positive.')
        if start_at < timezone.now() - timedelta(days=3650):
            raise ValidationError('Meeting start date is unrealistically far in the past.')
        people = list(participants)
        with transaction.atomic():
            meeting = Meeting.objects.create(start_at=start_at, duration=duration, location=location, description=description)
            MeetingParticipant.objects.bulk_create([MeetingParticipant(meeting=meeting, person=person) for person in people])
        return meeting

    def upcoming(self) -> QuerySet[Meeting]:
        return Meeting.objects.select_related('location').prefetch_related('participants').filter(start_at__gte=timezone.now()).order_by('start_at')

    def for_person(self, person: Person) -> QuerySet[Meeting]:
        return Meeting.objects.select_related('location').prefetch_related('participants').filter(participants=person).distinct()

# "RoadVehicleDetector/README.md"
# RoadVehicleDetector

RoadVehicleDetector is a research-to-production classical computer-vision pipeline for detecting vehicles in front-facing road images and dashcam video. It expands a small trained-classifier wrapper into a complete project with feature extraction, dataset loading, training, evaluation, checkpointing, inference, a CLI, and an optional HTTP serving layer.

The default model is intentionally transparent: it extracts HOG, spatial color, and color-histogram features from labeled vehicle and non-vehicle crops, scales them, and trains a linear SVM. The inference pipeline applies the classifier over multi-scale sliding windows, accumulates heat maps, thresholds unstable detections, and returns bounding boxes.

## Expected dataset layout

Place images in separate positive and negative directories:

- data/raw/vehicles
- data/raw/non_vehicles

Supported image suffixes are jpg, jpeg, png, and bmp.

## Common commands

Install locally:

python -m pip install -e .[dev]

Train:

rvehicle train --config configs/default.yaml

Evaluate an existing checkpoint:

rvehicle evaluate --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib

Run inference on an image:

rvehicle predict-image input.jpg output.jpg --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib

Serve HTTP predictions:

rvehicle serve --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080

## Notes

This project is designed for reproducible baselines and embedded-friendly deployments where a small classical model is preferable to a large neural network. It is also useful for teaching feature engineering, model evaluation, and sliding-window object detection.

def _tuple2(value: Any, field_name: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) or len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError(f'{field_name} must contain exactly two integers')
    return int(value[0]), int(value[1])


def _path(value: Any) -> Path:
    return value if isinstance(value, Path) else Path(str(value))


def load_config(path: str | Path) -> AppConfig:
    config_path = Path(path)

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from skimage.feature import hog

from road_vehicle_detector.config import FeatureConfig

SUPPORTED_COLOR_SPACES = {'RGB', 'HSV', 'LUV', 'HLS', 'YUV', 'YCrCb'}


def read_image(path: str | Path, size: int | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    image = cv2.imread(str(path))
    if image is None:
        raise ValueError(f'Unable to read image: {path}')
    image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    if size is not None:
        image = cv2.resize(image, (size, size), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    return image


def convert_color(image: np.ndarray, color_space: str) -> np.ndarray:
    if color_space not in SUPPORTED_COLOR_SPACES:
        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported color space: {color_space}')
    if color_space == 'RGB':
        return np.copy(image)
    code = {
        'HSV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV,
        'LUV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2LUV,
        'HLS': cv2.COLOR_RGB2HLS,
        'YUV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2YUV,
        'YCrCb': cv2.COLOR_RGB2YCrCb,
    }[color_space]
    return cv2.cvtColor(image, code)


def bin_spatial(image: np.ndarray, size: tuple[int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
    return cv2.resize(image, size, interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).ravel()


def color_hist(image: np.ndarray, nbins: int) -> np.ndarray:
    channel_features = [np.histogram(image[:, :, channel], bins=nbins, range=(0, 256))[0] for channel in range(image.shape[2])]
    return np.concatenate(channel_features).astype(np.float32)


def get_hog_features(
    channel: np.ndarray,
    orient: int,
    pix_per_cell: int,
    cell_per_block: int,
    feature_vec: bool = True,
) -> np.ndarray:
    return hog(
        channel,
        orientations=orient,
        pixels_per_cell=(pix_per_cell, pix_per_cell),
        cells_per_block=(cell_per_block, cell_per_block),
        transform_sqrt=True,
        visualize=False,
        feature_vector=feature_vec,
    )


def extract_image_features(image: np.ndarray, config: FeatureConfig) -> np.ndarray:
    feature_image = convert_color(image, config.color_space)
    features: list[np.ndarray] = []
    if config.use_spatial:
        features.append(bin_spatial(feature_image, config.spatial_size))
    if config.use_histogram:
        features.append(color_hist(feature_image, config.hist_bins))
    if config.use_hog:
        if config.hog_channel == 'all':
            hog_features = [
                get_hog_features(feature_image[:, :, channel], config.orient, config.pix_per_cell, config.cell_per_block)
                for channel in range(feature_image.shape[2])
            ]
            features.append(np.ravel(hog_features))
        else:
            channel = int(config.hog_channel)
            features.append(get_hog_features(feature_image[:, :, channel], config.orient, config.pix_per_cell, config.cell_per_block))
    if not features:
        raise ValueError('At least one feature family must be enabled')
    return np.concatenate(features).astype(np.float32)


def extract_features_from_paths(paths: Iterable[str | Path], config: FeatureConfig, image_size: int) -> np.ndarray:
    rows = []
    for path in paths:
        rows.append(extract_image_features(read_image(path, image_size), config))
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError('No images were provided for feature extraction')
    return np.vstack(rows)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

from road_vehicle_detector.config import DataConfig
from road_vehicle_detector.features import extract_features_from_paths
from road_vehicle_detector.config import FeatureConfig

IMAGE_SUFFIXES = {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.bmp'}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetPaths:
    vehicle_paths: list[Path]
    non_vehicle_paths: list[Path]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SplitDataset:
    x_train: np.ndarray
    x_test: np.ndarray
    y_train: np.ndarray
    y_test: np.ndarray


def list_images(directory: Path) -> list[Path]:
    if not directory.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Dataset directory does not exist: {directory}')
    return sorted(path for path in directory.rglob('*') if path.suffix.lower() in IMAGE_SUFFIXES)


def discover_dataset(config: DataConfig) -> DatasetPaths:
    vehicle_paths = list_images(config.vehicle_dir)
    non_vehicle_paths = list_images(config.non_vehicle_dir)
    if config.max_samples_per_class is not None:
        limit = int(config.max_samples_per_class)
        vehicle_paths = vehicle_paths[:limit]
        non_vehicle_paths = non_vehicle_paths[:limit]
    if not vehicle_paths or not non_vehicle_paths:
        raise ValueError('Both vehicle and non-vehicle datasets must contain at least one image')
    return DatasetPaths(vehicle_paths=vehicle_paths, non_vehicle_paths=non_vehicle_paths)


def build_feature_matrix(paths: DatasetPaths, feature_config: FeatureConfig, data_config: DataConfig) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    vehicle_features = extract_features_from_paths(paths.vehicle_paths, feature_config, data_config.image_size)
    non_vehicle_features = extract_features_from_paths(paths.non_vehicle_paths, feature_config, data_config.image_size)
    x = np.vstack([vehicle_features, non_vehicle_features]).astype(np.float32)
    y = np.hstack([np.ones(len(vehicle_features), dtype=np.int64), np.zeros(len(non_vehicle_features), dtype=np.int64)])
    return x, y


def make_split(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, config: DataConfig, seed: int) -> SplitDataset:
    x_train, x_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        x,
        y,
        test_size=config.test_size,
        random_state=seed,
        stratify=y,
        shuffle=True,
    )
    return SplitDataset(x_train=x_train, x_test=x_test, y_train=y_train, y_test=y_test)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import joblib
import numpy as np
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC, SVC

from road_vehicle_detector.config import FeatureConfig, ModelConfig


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelMetadata:
    feature_config: FeatureConfig
    model_config: ModelConfig
    labels: dict[int, str]
    metrics: dict[str, float]


class Classifier(object):
    '''
    Trained classifier for road-vehicle detection.

    The object stores the estimator, scaler, and the feature extraction parameters
    required to reproduce inference. It is intentionally compatible with the
    minimal wrapper used by many classical vehicle-detection projects.
    '''

    def __init__(
        self,
        classifier: Any,
        scaler: StandardScaler,
        orient: int,
        color_space: str,
        pix_per_cell: int,
        cell_per_block: int,
        spatial_size: tuple[int, int],
        hist_bins: int,
        metadata: ModelMetadata | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.classifier = classifier
        self.scaler = scaler
        self.color_space = color_space
        self.orient = orient
        self.pix_per_cell = pix_per_cell
        self.cell_per_block = cell_per_block
        self.spatial_size = spatial_size
        self.hist_bins = hist_bins
        self.metadata = metadata

    def transform(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        if x.ndim == 1:
            x = x.reshape(1, -1)
        return self.scaler.transform(x)

    def predict(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return self.classifier.predict(self.transform(x))

    def decision_function(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        estimator = self.classifier
        transformed = self.transform(x)
        if hasattr(estimator, 'decision_function'):
            return estimator.decision_function(transformed)
        if hasattr(estimator, 'predict_proba'):
            return estimator.predict_proba(transformed)[:, 1]
        return estimator.predict(transformed)

    def predict_proba(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        estimator = self.classifier
        transformed = self.transform(x)
        if hasattr(estimator, 'predict_proba'):
            return estimator.predict_proba(transformed)
        scores = self.decision_function(x)
        probs = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-scores))
        return np.vstack([1.0 - probs, probs]).T

    def save(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        output = Path(path)
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        joblib.dump(self, output)

    @staticmethod
    def load(path: str | Path) -> 'Classifier':
        checkpoint = Path(path)
        if not checkpoint.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f'Checkpoint not found: {checkpoint}')
        obj = joblib.load(checkpoint)
        if not isinstance(obj, Classifier):
            raise TypeError(f'Checkpoint does not contain a Classifier: {checkpoint}')
        return obj

    def metadata_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self.metadata is None:
            return {}
        return {
            'feature_config': asdict(self.metadata.feature_config),
            'model_config': asdict(self.metadata.model_config),
            'labels': self.metadata.labels,
            'metrics': self.metadata.metrics,
        }


def build_estimator(config: ModelConfig) -> Any:
    if config.classifier == 'linear_svc':
        base = LinearSVC(C=config.c, class_weight=config.class_weight, max_iter=20000, dual='auto')
    elif config.classifier == 'rbf_svc':
        base = SVC(C=config.c, class_weight=config.class_weight, kernel='rbf', probability=config.probability_calibration)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported classifier: {config.classifier}')
    if config.probability_calibration and config.classifier == 'linear_svc':
        return CalibratedClassifierCV(base, cv=3)
    return base


def make_classifier(estimator: Any, scaler: StandardScaler, feature_config: FeatureConfig, model_config: ModelConfig, metrics: dict[str, float]) -> Classifier:
    return Classifier(
        classifier=estimator,
        scaler=scaler,
        orient=feature_config.orient,
        color_space=feature_config.color_space,
        pix_per_cell=feature_config.pix_per_cell,
        cell_per_block=feature_config.cell_per_block,
        spatial_size=feature_config.spatial_size,
        hist_bins=feature_config.hist_bins,
        metadata=ModelMetadata(
            feature_config=feature_config,
            model_config=model_config,
            labels={0: 'non_vehicle', 1: 'vehicle'},
            metrics=metrics,
        ),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class JsonlExperimentTracker:
    def __init__(self, path: str | Path, enabled: bool = True) -> None:
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.enabled = enabled
        if enabled:
            self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def log_event(self, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if not self.enabled:
            return
        record = {
            'timestamp': time.time(),
            'event_type': event_type,
            'payload': self._json_safe(payload),
        }
        with self.path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + '\n')

    def _json_safe(self, value: Any) -> Any:
        if is_dataclass(value):
            return self._json_safe(asdict(value))
        if isinstance(value, Path):
            return str(value)
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {str(k): self._json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            return [self._json_safe(v) for v in value]
        if hasattr(value, 'item'):
            return value.item()
        return value

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_score, recall_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig
from road_vehicle_detector.data import build_feature_matrix, discover_dataset, make_split
from road_vehicle_detector.model import build_estimator, make_classifier
from road_vehicle_detector.tracking import JsonlExperimentTracker


def train(config: AppConfig, checkpoint_path: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    artifact_dir = config.project.artifact_dir
    artifact_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    checkpoint = Path(checkpoint_path) if checkpoint_path else artifact_dir / 'model.joblib'
    tracker = JsonlExperimentTracker(config.tracking.log_path, enabled=config.tracking.enabled)
    tracker.log_event('train_started', {'config': config})

    np.random.seed(config.project.seed)
    paths = discover_dataset(config.data)
    x, y = build_feature_matrix(paths, config.features, config.data)
    split = make_split(x, y, config.data, config.project.seed)

    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(split.x_train)
    x_train_scaled = scaler.transform(split.x_train)
    estimator = build_estimator(config.model)
    estimator.fit(x_train_scaled, split.y_train)

    predictions = estimator.predict(scaler.transform(split.x_test))
    metrics = {
        'accuracy': float(accuracy_score(split.y_test, predictions)),
        'precision': float(precision_score(split.y_test, predictions, zero_division=0)),
        'recall': float(recall_score(split.y_test, predictions, zero_division=0)),
        'f1': float(f1_score(split.y_test, predictions, zero_division=0)),
        'train_samples': float(len(split.y_train)),
        'test_samples': float(len(split.y_test)),
        'feature_dim': float(split.x_train.shape[1]),
    }
    model = make_classifier(estimator, scaler, config.features, config.model, metrics)
    model.save(checkpoint)
    tracker.log_event('train_finished', {'checkpoint': checkpoint, 'metrics': metrics})
    return checkpoint

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig, FeatureConfig, SearchRegion
from road_vehicle_detector.features import convert_color, extract_image_features, read_image
from road_vehicle_detector.model import Classifier


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BoundingBox:
    x1: int
    y1: int
    x2: int
    y2: int
    score: float = 1.0

    @property
    def area(self) -> int:
        return max(0, self.x2 - self.x1) * max(0, self.y2 - self.y1)

    def as_tuple(self) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int]]:
        return (self.x1, self.y1), (self.x2, self.y2)


def _feature_config_from_classifier(model: Classifier, fallback: FeatureConfig) -> FeatureConfig:
    if model.metadata is not None:
        return model.metadata.feature_config
    return FeatureConfig(
        color_space=model.color_space,
        orient=model.orient,
        pix_per_cell=model.pix_per_cell,
        cell_per_block=model.cell_per_block,
        spatial_size=model.spatial_size,
        hist_bins=model.hist_bins,
        hog_channel=fallback.hog_channel,
        use_spatial=fallback.use_spatial,
        use_histogram=fallback.use_histogram,
        use_hog=fallback.use_hog,
    )


def find_cars(image: np.ndarray, model: Classifier, region: SearchRegion, config: AppConfig) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    feature_config = _feature_config_from_classifier(model, config.features)
    window = config.inference.window_size
    step = max(1, config.inference.cells_per_step * feature_config.pix_per_cell)
    y_start = max(0, region.y_start)
    y_stop = min(image.shape[0], region.y_stop)
    if y_stop <= y_start:
        return []

    search = image[y_start:y_stop, :, :]
    if region.scale != 1.0:
        search = cv2.resize(search, (int(search.shape[1] / region.scale), int(search.shape[0] / region.scale)))
    boxes: list[BoundingBox] = []
    for y in range(0, max(1, search.shape[0] - window + 1), step):
        for x in range(0, max(1, search.shape[1] - window + 1), step):
            patch = search[y:y + window, x:x + window]
            if patch.shape[0] != window or patch.shape[1] != window:
                continue
            features = extract_image_features(patch, feature_config)
            prediction = int(model.predict(features)[0])
            if prediction == 1:
                score = float(model.predict_proba(features)[0, 1])
                x1 = int(x * region.scale)
                y1 = int(y * region.scale) + y_start
                x2 = int((x + window) * region.scale)
                y2 = int((y + window) * region.scale) + y_start
                boxes.append(BoundingBox(x1, y1, x2, y2, score=score))
    return boxes


def add_heat(heatmap: np.ndarray, boxes: list[BoundingBox]) -> np.ndarray:
    for box in boxes:
        heatmap[box.y1:box.y2, box.x1:box.x2] += 1
    return heatmap


def threshold_heat(heatmap: np.ndarray, threshold: int) -> np.ndarray:
    result = np.copy(heatmap)
    result[result <= threshold] = 0
    return result


def labels_to_boxes(labels: tuple[np.ndarray, int], min_area: int) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    label_image, count = labels
    boxes: list[BoundingBox] = []
    for car_number in range(1, count + 1):
        ys, xs = (label_image == car_number).nonzero()
        if len(xs) == 0 or len(ys) == 0:
            continue
        box = BoundingBox(int(np.min(xs)), int(np.min(ys)), int(np.max(xs)), int(np.max(ys)))
        if box.area >= min_area:
            boxes.append(box)
    return boxes


def detect_vehicles(image: np.ndarray, model: Classifier, config: AppConfig) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    candidates: list[BoundingBox] = []
    for region in config.inference.search_regions:
        candidates.extend(find_cars(image, model, region, config))
    heat = np.zeros(image.shape[:2], dtype=np.float32)
    heat = add_heat(heat, candidates)
    heat = threshold_heat(heat, config.inference.heat_threshold)
    labels = ndimage.label(heat)
    return labels_to_boxes(labels, config.inference.min_box_area)


def draw_boxes(image: np.ndarray, boxes: list[BoundingBox], color: tuple[int, int, int] = (0, 0, 255)) -> np.ndarray:
    output = np.copy(image)
    for box in boxes:
        cv2.rectangle(output, (box.x1, box.y1), (box.x2, box.y2), color, 4)
    return output


def predict_image(input_path: str | Path, output_path: str | Path, checkpoint_path: str | Path, config: AppConfig) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    model = Classifier.load(checkpoint_path)
    image = read_image(input_path)
    boxes = detect_vehicles(image, model, config)
    annotated = draw_boxes(image, boxes)
    output_bgr = cv2.cvtColor(annotated, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    output = Path(output_path)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cv2.imwrite(str(output), output_bgr)
    return boxes

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig
from road_vehicle_detector.inference import BoundingBox, detect_vehicles, draw_boxes
from road_vehicle_detector.model import Classifier


class VideoVehicleDetector:
    def __init__(self, model: Classifier, config: AppConfig, history: int = 6) -> None:
        self.model = model
        self.config = config
        self.history: deque[list[BoundingBox]] = deque(maxlen=history)

    def process_frame(self, frame_bgr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        frame_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(frame_bgr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        boxes = detect_vehicles(frame_rgb, self.model, self.config)
        self.history.append(boxes)
        stable_boxes = [box for boxes_for_frame in self.history for box in boxes_for_frame]
        annotated_rgb = draw_boxes(frame_rgb, stable_boxes)
        return cv2.cvtColor(annotated_rgb, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)


def predict_video(input_path: str | Path, output_path: str | Path, checkpoint_path: str | Path, config: AppConfig) -> None:
    model = Classifier.load(checkpoint_path)
    detector = VideoVehicleDetector(model, config)
    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(input_path))
    if not capture.isOpened():
        raise ValueError(f'Unable to open video: {input_path}')
    fps = capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 25.0
    width = int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH))
    height = int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))
    output = Path(output_path)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    writer = cv2.VideoWriter(str(output), cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v'), fps, (width, height))
    try:
        while True:
            ok, frame = capture.read()
            if not ok:
                break
            writer.write(detector.process_frame(frame))
    finally:
        capture.release()
        writer.release()

from __future__ import annotations

import io
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from fastapi import FastAPI, File, HTTPException, UploadFile

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig, load_config
from road_vehicle_detector.inference import detect_vehicles
from road_vehicle_detector.model import Classifier


def create_app(config_path: str | Path, checkpoint_path: str | Path) -> FastAPI:
    config = load_config(config_path)
    model = Classifier.load(checkpoint_path)
    app = FastAPI(title='RoadVehicleDetector', version='0.1.0')

    @app.get('/health')
    def health() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    @app.post('/predict')
    async def predict(file: UploadFile = File(...)) -> dict[str, object]:
        payload = await file.read()
        image_array = np.frombuffer(payload, dtype=np.uint8)
        bgr = cv2.imdecode(image_array, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if bgr is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Uploaded file is not a readable image')
        rgb = cv2.cvtColor(bgr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        boxes = detect_vehicles(rgb, model, config)
        return {'boxes': [asdict(box) for box in boxes], 'count': len(boxes)}

    return app

# "RoadVehicleDetector/README.md"
# RoadVehicleDetector

RoadVehicleDetector is a research-to-production classical computer-vision pipeline for detecting vehicles in front-facing road images and dashcam video. It expands a small trained-classifier wrapper into a complete project with feature extraction, dataset loading, training, evaluation, checkpointing, inference, a CLI, and an optional HTTP serving layer.

The default model is intentionally transparent: it extracts HOG, spatial color, and color-histogram features from labeled vehicle and non-vehicle crops, scales them, and trains a linear SVM. The inference pipeline applies the classifier over multi-scale sliding windows, accumulates heat maps, thresholds unstable detections, and returns bounding boxes.

## Expected dataset layout

Place images in separate positive and negative directories:

- data/raw/vehicles
- data/raw/non_vehicles

Supported image suffixes are jpg, jpeg, png, and bmp.

## Common commands

Install locally:

python -m pip install -e .[dev]

Train:

rvehicle train --config configs/default.yaml

Evaluate an existing checkpoint:

rvehicle evaluate --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib

Run inference on an image:

rvehicle predict-image input.jpg output.jpg --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib

Serve HTTP predictions:

rvehicle serve --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080

## Notes

This project is designed for reproducible baselines and embedded-friendly deployments where a small classical model is preferable to a large neural network. It is also useful for teaching feature engineering, model evaluation, and sliding-window object detection.

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProjectConfig:
    name: str = 'RoadVehicleDetector'
    seed: int = 42
    artifact_dir: Path = Path('artifacts')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DataConfig:
    vehicle_dir: Path = Path('data/raw/vehicles')
    non_vehicle_dir: Path = Path('data/raw/non_vehicles')
    image_size: int = 64
    test_size: float = 0.2
    validation_size: float = 0.0
    max_samples_per_class: int | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FeatureConfig:
    color_space: str = 'YCrCb'
    orient: int = 9
    pix_per_cell: int = 8
    cell_per_block: int = 2
    hog_channel: int | str = 'all'
    spatial_size: tuple[int, int] = (32, 32)
    hist_bins: int = 32
    use_spatial: bool = True
    use_histogram: bool = True
    use_hog: bool = True


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelConfig:
    classifier: str = 'linear_svc'
    c: float = 1.0
    class_weight: str | None = 'balanced'
    probability_calibration: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SearchRegion:
    y_start: int
    y_stop: int
    scale: float = 1.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InferenceConfig:
    search_regions: list[SearchRegion] = field(default_factory=list)
    window_size: int = 64
    cells_per_step: int = 2
    heat_threshold: int = 2
    min_box_area: int = 900


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrackingConfig:
    enabled: bool = True
    log_path: Path = Path('artifacts/runs.jsonl')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AppConfig:
    project: ProjectConfig = field(default_factory=ProjectConfig)
    data: DataConfig = field(default_factory=DataConfig)
    features: FeatureConfig = field(default_factory=FeatureConfig)
    model: ModelConfig = field(default_factory=ModelConfig)
    inference: InferenceConfig = field(default_factory=InferenceConfig)
    tracking: TrackingConfig = field(default_factory=TrackingConfig)


def _tuple2(value: Any, field_name: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) or len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError(f'{field_name} must contain exactly two integers')
    return int(value[0]), int(value[1])


def _path(value: Any) -> Path:
    return value if isinstance(value, Path) else Path(str(value))


def load_config(path: str | Path) -> AppConfig:
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Configuration file not found: {config_path}')
    with config_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        raw = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
    return parse_config(raw)


def parse_config(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> AppConfig:
    project_raw = raw.get('project', {})
    data_raw = raw.get('data', {})
    features_raw = raw.get('features', {})
    model_raw = raw.get('model', {})
    inference_raw = raw.get('inference', {})
    tracking_raw = raw.get('tracking', {})

    regions = [SearchRegion(**region) for region in inference_raw.get('search_regions', [])]
    return AppConfig(
        project=ProjectConfig(
            name=str(project_raw.get('name', 'RoadVehicleDetector')),
            seed=int(project_raw.get('seed', 42)),
            artifact_dir=_path(project_raw.get('artifact_dir', 'artifacts')),
        ),
        data=DataConfig(
            vehicle_dir=_path(data_raw.get('vehicle_dir', 'data/raw/vehicles')),
            non_vehicle_dir=_path(data_raw.get('non_vehicle_dir', 'data/raw/non_vehicles')),
            image_size=int(data_raw.get('image_size', 64)),
            test_size=float(data_raw.get('test_size', 0.2)),
            validation_size=float(data_raw.get('validation_size', 0.0)),
            max_samples_per_class=data_raw.get('max_samples_per_class'),
        ),
        features=FeatureConfig(
            color_space=str(features_raw.get('color_space', 'YCrCb')),
            orient=int(features_raw.get('orient', 9)),
            pix_per_cell=int(features_raw.get('pix_per_cell', 8)),
            cell_per_block=int(features_raw.get('cell_per_block', 2)),
            hog_channel=features_raw.get('hog_channel', 'all'),
            spatial_size=_tuple2(features_raw.get('spatial_size', [32, 32]), 'spatial_size'),
            hist_bins=int(features_raw.get('hist_bins', 32)),
            use_spatial=bool(features_raw.get('use_spatial', True)),
            use_histogram=bool(features_raw.get('use_histogram', True)),
            use_hog=bool(features_raw.get('use_hog', True)),
        ),
        model=ModelConfig(
            classifier=str(model_raw.get('classifier', 'linear_svc')),
            c=float(model_raw.get('c', 1.0)),
            class_weight=model_raw.get('class_weight', 'balanced'),
            probability_calibration=bool(model_raw.get('probability_calibration', False)),
        ),
        inference=InferenceConfig(
            search_regions=regions,
            window_size=int(inference_raw.get('window_size', 64)),
            cells_per_step=int(inference_raw.get('cells_per_step', 2)),
            heat_threshold=int(inference_raw.get('heat_threshold', 2)),
            min_box_area=int(inference_raw.get('min_box_area', 900)),
        ),
        tracking=TrackingConfig(
            enabled=bool(tracking_raw.get('enabled', True)),
            log_path=_path(tracking_raw.get('log_path', 'artifacts/runs.jsonl')),
        ),
    )

# "RoadVehicleDetector/src/road_vehicle_detector/features.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from skimage.feature import hog

from road_vehicle_detector.config import FeatureConfig

SUPPORTED_COLOR_SPACES = {'RGB', 'HSV', 'LUV', 'HLS', 'YUV', 'YCrCb'}


def read_image(path: str | Path, size: int | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    image = cv2.imread(str(path))
    if image is None:
        raise ValueError(f'Unable to read image: {path}')
    image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    if size is not None:
        image = cv2.resize(image, (size, size), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    return image


def convert_color(image: np.ndarray, color_space: str) -> np.ndarray:
    if color_space not in SUPPORTED_COLOR_SPACES:
        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported color space: {color_space}')
    if color_space == 'RGB':
        return np.copy(image)
    code = {
        'HSV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV,
        'LUV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2LUV,
        'HLS': cv2.COLOR_RGB2HLS,
        'YUV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2YUV,
        'YCrCb': cv2.COLOR_RGB2YCrCb,
    }[color_space]
    return cv2.cvtColor(image, code)


def bin_spatial(image: np.ndarray, size: tuple[int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
    return cv2.resize(image, size, interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).ravel()


def color_hist(image: np.ndarray, nbins: int) -> np.ndarray:
    channel_features = [np.histogram(image[:, :, channel], bins=nbins, range=(0, 256))[0] for channel in range(image.shape[2])]
    return np.concatenate(channel_features).astype(np.float32)


def get_hog_features(
    channel: np.ndarray,
    orient: int,
    pix_per_cell: int,
    cell_per_block: int,
    feature_vec: bool = True,
) -> np.ndarray:
    return hog(
        channel,
        orientations=orient,
        pixels_per_cell=(pix_per_cell, pix_per_cell),
        cells_per_block=(cell_per_block, cell_per_block),
        transform_sqrt=True,
        visualize=False,
        feature_vector=feature_vec,
    )


def extract_image_features(image: np.ndarray, config: FeatureConfig) -> np.ndarray:
    feature_image = convert_color(image, config.color_space)
    features: list[np.ndarray] = []
    if config.use_spatial:
        features.append(bin_spatial(feature_image, config.spatial_size))
    if config.use_histogram:
        features.append(color_hist(feature_image, config.hist_bins))
    if config.use_hog:
        if config.hog_channel == 'all':
            hog_features = [
                get_hog_features(feature_image[:, :, channel], config.orient, config.pix_per_cell, config.cell_per_block)
                for channel in range(feature_image.shape[2])
            ]
            features.append(np.ravel(hog_features))
        else:
            channel = int(config.hog_channel)
            features.append(get_hog_features(feature_image[:, :, channel], config.orient, config.pix_per_cell, config.cell_per_block))
    if not features:
        raise ValueError('At least one feature family must be enabled')
    return np.concatenate(features).astype(np.float32)


def extract_features_from_paths(paths: Iterable[str | Path], config: FeatureConfig, image_size: int) -> np.ndarray:
    rows = []
    for path in paths:
        rows.append(extract_image_features(read_image(path, image_size), config))
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError('No images were provided for feature extraction')
    return np.vstack(rows)

# "RoadVehicleDetector/src/road_vehicle_detector/data.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

from road_vehicle_detector.config import DataConfig
from road_vehicle_detector.features import extract_features_from_paths
from road_vehicle_detector.config import FeatureConfig

IMAGE_SUFFIXES = {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.bmp'}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetPaths:
    vehicle_paths: list[Path]
    non_vehicle_paths: list[Path]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SplitDataset:
    x_train: np.ndarray
    x_test: np.ndarray
    y_train: np.ndarray
    y_test: np.ndarray


def list_images(directory: Path) -> list[Path]:
    if not directory.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Dataset directory does not exist: {directory}')
    return sorted(path for path in directory.rglob('*') if path.suffix.lower() in IMAGE_SUFFIXES)


def discover_dataset(config: DataConfig) -> DatasetPaths:
    vehicle_paths = list_images(config.vehicle_dir)
    non_vehicle_paths = list_images(config.non_vehicle_dir)
    if config.max_samples_per_class is not None:
        limit = int(config.max_samples_per_class)
        vehicle_paths = vehicle_paths[:limit]
        non_vehicle_paths = non_vehicle_paths[:limit]
    if not vehicle_paths or not non_vehicle_paths:
        raise ValueError('Both vehicle and non-vehicle datasets must contain at least one image')
    return DatasetPaths(vehicle_paths=vehicle_paths, non_vehicle_paths=non_vehicle_paths)


def build_feature_matrix(paths: DatasetPaths, feature_config: FeatureConfig, data_config: DataConfig) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    vehicle_features = extract_features_from_paths(paths.vehicle_paths, feature_config, data_config.image_size)
    non_vehicle_features = extract_features_from_paths(paths.non_vehicle_paths, feature_config, data_config.image_size)
    x = np.vstack([vehicle_features, non_vehicle_features]).astype(np.float32)
    y = np.hstack([np.ones(len(vehicle_features), dtype=np.int64), np.zeros(len(non_vehicle_features), dtype=np.int64)])
    return x, y


def make_split(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, config: DataConfig, seed: int) -> SplitDataset:
    x_train, x_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        x,
        y,
        test_size=config.test_size,
        random_state=seed,
        stratify=y,
        shuffle=True,
    )
    return SplitDataset(x_train=x_train, x_test=x_test, y_train=y_train, y_test=y_test)

# "RoadVehicleDetector/src/road_vehicle_detector/model.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import joblib
import numpy as np
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC, SVC

from road_vehicle_detector.config import FeatureConfig, ModelConfig


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelMetadata:
    feature_config: FeatureConfig
    model_config: ModelConfig
    labels: dict[int, str]
    metrics: dict[str, float]


class Classifier(object):
    '''
    Trained classifier for road-vehicle detection.

    The object stores the estimator, scaler, and the feature extraction parameters
    required to reproduce inference. It is intentionally compatible with the
    minimal wrapper used by many classical vehicle-detection projects.
    '''

    def __init__(
        self,
        classifier: Any,
        scaler: StandardScaler,
        orient: int,
        color_space: str,
        pix_per_cell: int,
        cell_per_block: int,
        spatial_size: tuple[int, int],
        hist_bins: int,
        metadata: ModelMetadata | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.classifier = classifier
        self.scaler = scaler
        self.color_space = color_space
        self.orient = orient
        self.pix_per_cell = pix_per_cell
        self.cell_per_block = cell_per_block
        self.spatial_size = spatial_size
        self.hist_bins = hist_bins
        self.metadata = metadata

    def transform(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        if x.ndim == 1:
            x = x.reshape(1, -1)
        return self.scaler.transform(x)

    def predict(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return self.classifier.predict(self.transform(x))

    def decision_function(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        estimator = self.classifier
        transformed = self.transform(x)
        if hasattr(estimator, 'decision_function'):
            return estimator.decision_function(transformed)
        if hasattr(estimator, 'predict_proba'):
            return estimator.predict_proba(transformed)[:, 1]
        return estimator.predict(transformed)

    def predict_proba(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        estimator = self.classifier
        transformed = self.transform(x)
        if hasattr(estimator, 'predict_proba'):
            return estimator.predict_proba(transformed)
        scores = self.decision_function(x)
        probs = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-scores))
        return np.vstack([1.0 - probs, probs]).T

    def save(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        output = Path(path)
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        joblib.dump(self, output)

    @staticmethod
    def load(path: str | Path) -> 'Classifier':
        checkpoint = Path(path)
        if not checkpoint.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f'Checkpoint not found: {checkpoint}')
        obj = joblib.load(checkpoint)
        if not isinstance(obj, Classifier):
            raise TypeError(f'Checkpoint does not contain a Classifier: {checkpoint}')
        return obj

    def metadata_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self.metadata is None:
            return {}
        return {
            'feature_config': asdict(self.metadata.feature_config),
            'model_config': asdict(self.metadata.model_config),
            'labels': self.metadata.labels,
            'metrics': self.metadata.metrics,
        }


def build_estimator(config: ModelConfig) -> Any:
    if config.classifier == 'linear_svc':
        base = LinearSVC(C=config.c, class_weight=config.class_weight, max_iter=20000, dual='auto')
    elif config.classifier == 'rbf_svc':
        base = SVC(C=config.c, class_weight=config.class_weight, kernel='rbf', probability=config.probability_calibration)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported classifier: {config.classifier}')
    if config.probability_calibration and config.classifier == 'linear_svc':
        return CalibratedClassifierCV(base, cv=3)
    return base


def make_classifier(estimator: Any, scaler: StandardScaler, feature_config: FeatureConfig, model_config: ModelConfig, metrics: dict[str, float]) -> Classifier:
    return Classifier(
        classifier=estimator,
        scaler=scaler,
        orient=feature_config.orient,
        color_space=feature_config.color_space,
        pix_per_cell=feature_config.pix_per_cell,
        cell_per_block=feature_config.cell_per_block,
        spatial_size=feature_config.spatial_size,
        hist_bins=feature_config.hist_bins,
        metadata=ModelMetadata(
            feature_config=feature_config,
            model_config=model_config,
            labels={0: 'non_vehicle', 1: 'vehicle'},
            metrics=metrics,
        ),
    )

# "RoadVehicleDetector/src/road_vehicle_detector/tracking.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class JsonlExperimentTracker:
    def __init__(self, path: str | Path, enabled: bool = True) -> None:
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.enabled = enabled
        if enabled:
            self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def log_event(self, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if not self.enabled:
            return
        record = {
            'timestamp': time.time(),
            'event_type': event_type,
            'payload': self._json_safe(payload),
        }
        with self.path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + '\n')

    def _json_safe(self, value: Any) -> Any:
        if is_dataclass(value):
            return self._json_safe(asdict(value))
        if isinstance(value, Path):
            return str(value)
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {str(k): self._json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            return [self._json_safe(v) for v in value]
        if hasattr(value, 'item'):
            return value.item()
        return value

# "RoadVehicleDetector/src/road_vehicle_detector/train.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_score, recall_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig
from road_vehicle_detector.data import build_feature_matrix, discover_dataset, make_split
from road_vehicle_detector.model import build_estimator, make_classifier
from road_vehicle_detector.tracking import JsonlExperimentTracker


def train(config: AppConfig, checkpoint_path: str | Path | None = None) -> Path:
    artifact_dir = config.project.artifact_dir
    artifact_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    checkpoint = Path(checkpoint_path) if checkpoint_path else artifact_dir / 'model.joblib'
    tracker = JsonlExperimentTracker(config.tracking.log_path, enabled=config.tracking.enabled)
    tracker.log_event('train_started', {'config': config})

    np.random.seed(config.project.seed)
    paths = discover_dataset(config.data)
    x, y = build_feature_matrix(paths, config.features, config.data)
    split = make_split(x, y, config.data, config.project.seed)

    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(split.x_train)
    x_train_scaled = scaler.transform(split.x_train)
    estimator = build_estimator(config.model)
    estimator.fit(x_train_scaled, split.y_train)

    predictions = estimator.predict(scaler.transform(split.x_test))
    metrics = {
        'accuracy': float(accuracy_score(split.y_test, predictions)),
        'precision': float(precision_score(split.y_test, predictions, zero_division=0)),
        'recall': float(recall_score(split.y_test, predictions, zero_division=0)),
        'f1': float(f1_score(split.y_test, predictions, zero_division=0)),
        'train_samples': float(len(split.y_train)),
        'test_samples': float(len(split.y_test)),
        'feature_dim': float(split.x_train.shape[1]),
    }
    model = make_classifier(estimator, scaler, config.features, config.model, metrics)
    model.save(checkpoint)
    tracker.log_event('train_finished', {'checkpoint': checkpoint, 'metrics': metrics})
    return checkpoint

# "RoadVehicleDetector/src/road_vehicle_detector/evaluate.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig
from road_vehicle_detector.data import build_feature_matrix, discover_dataset, make_split
from road_vehicle_detector.model import Classifier


def evaluate(config: AppConfig, checkpoint_path: str | Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    model = Classifier.load(checkpoint_path)
    paths = discover_dataset(config.data)
    x, y = build_feature_matrix(paths, config.features, config.data)
    split = make_split(x, y, config.data, config.project.seed)
    predictions = model.predict(split.x_test)
    return {
        'classification_report': classification_report(split.y_test, predictions, output_dict=True, zero_division=0),
        'confusion_matrix': confusion_matrix(split.y_test, predictions).tolist(),
        'checkpoint_metadata': model.metadata_dict(),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig, FeatureConfig, SearchRegion
from road_vehicle_detector.features import convert_color, extract_image_features, read_image
from road_vehicle_detector.model import Classifier


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BoundingBox:
    x1: int
    y1: int
    x2: int
    y2: int
    score: float = 1.0

    @property
    def area(self) -> int:
        return max(0, self.x2 - self.x1) * max(0, self.y2 - self.y1)

    def as_tuple(self) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int]]:
        return (self.x1, self.y1), (self.x2, self.y2)


def _feature_config_from_classifier(model: Classifier, fallback: FeatureConfig) -> FeatureConfig:
    if model.metadata is not None:
        return model.metadata.feature_config
    return FeatureConfig(
        color_space=model.color_space,
        orient=model.orient,
        pix_per_cell=model.pix_per_cell,
        cell_per_block=model.cell_per_block,
        spatial_size=model.spatial_size,
        hist_bins=model.hist_bins,
        hog_channel=fallback.hog_channel,
        use_spatial=fallback.use_spatial,
        use_histogram=fallback.use_histogram,
        use_hog=fallback.use_hog,
    )


def find_cars(image: np.ndarray, model: Classifier, region: SearchRegion, config: AppConfig) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    feature_config = _feature_config_from_classifier(model, config.features)
    window = config.inference.window_size
    step = max(1, config.inference.cells_per_step * feature_config.pix_per_cell)
    y_start = max(0, region.y_start)
    y_stop = min(image.shape[0], region.y_stop)
    if y_stop <= y_start:
        return []

    search = image[y_start:y_stop, :, :]
    if region.scale != 1.0:
        search = cv2.resize(search, (int(search.shape[1] / region.scale), int(search.shape[0] / region.scale)))
    boxes: list[BoundingBox] = []
    for y in range(0, max(1, search.shape[0] - window + 1), step):
        for x in range(0, max(1, search.shape[1] - window + 1), step):
            patch = search[y:y + window, x:x + window]
            if patch.shape[0] != window or patch.shape[1] != window:
                continue
            features = extract_image_features(patch, feature_config)
            prediction = int(model.predict(features)[0])
            if prediction == 1:
                score = float(model.predict_proba(features)[0, 1])
                x1 = int(x * region.scale)
                y1 = int(y * region.scale) + y_start
                x2 = int((x + window) * region.scale)
                y2 = int((y + window) * region.scale) + y_start
                boxes.append(BoundingBox(x1, y1, x2, y2, score=score))
    return boxes


def add_heat(heatmap: np.ndarray, boxes: list[BoundingBox]) -> np.ndarray:
    for box in boxes:
        heatmap[box.y1:box.y2, box.x1:box.x2] += 1
    return heatmap


def threshold_heat(heatmap: np.ndarray, threshold: int) -> np.ndarray:
    result = np.copy(heatmap)
    result[result <= threshold] = 0
    return result


def labels_to_boxes(labels: tuple[np.ndarray, int], min_area: int) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    label_image, count = labels
    boxes: list[BoundingBox] = []
    for car_number in range(1, count + 1):
        ys, xs = (label_image == car_number).nonzero()
        if len(xs) == 0 or len(ys) == 0:
            continue
        box = BoundingBox(int(np.min(xs)), int(np.min(ys)), int(np.max(xs)), int(np.max(ys)))
        if box.area >= min_area:
            boxes.append(box)
    return boxes


def detect_vehicles(image: np.ndarray, model: Classifier, config: AppConfig) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    candidates: list[BoundingBox] = []
    for region in config.inference.search_regions:
        candidates.extend(find_cars(image, model, region, config))
    heat = np.zeros(image.shape[:2], dtype=np.float32)
    heat = add_heat(heat, candidates)
    heat = threshold_heat(heat, config.inference.heat_threshold)
    labels = ndimage.label(heat)
    return labels_to_boxes(labels, config.inference.min_box_area)


def draw_boxes(image: np.ndarray, boxes: list[BoundingBox], color: tuple[int, int, int] = (0, 0, 255)) -> np.ndarray:
    output = np.copy(image)
    for box in boxes:
        cv2.rectangle(output, (box.x1, box.y1), (box.x2, box.y2), color, 4)
    return output


def predict_image(input_path: str | Path, output_path: str | Path, checkpoint_path: str | Path, config: AppConfig) -> list[BoundingBox]:
    model = Classifier.load(checkpoint_path)
    image = read_image(input_path)
    boxes = detect_vehicles(image, model, config)
    annotated = draw_boxes(image, boxes)
    output_bgr = cv2.cvtColor(annotated, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    output = Path(output_path)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cv2.imwrite(str(output), output_bgr)
    return boxes

# "RoadVehicleDetector/src/road_vehicle_detector/video.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig
from road_vehicle_detector.inference import BoundingBox, detect_vehicles, draw_boxes
from road_vehicle_detector.model import Classifier


class VideoVehicleDetector:
    def __init__(self, model: Classifier, config: AppConfig, history: int = 6) -> None:
        self.model = model
        self.config = config
        self.history: deque[list[BoundingBox]] = deque(maxlen=history)

    def process_frame(self, frame_bgr: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        frame_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(frame_bgr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        boxes = detect_vehicles(frame_rgb, self.model, self.config)
        self.history.append(boxes)
        stable_boxes = [box for boxes_for_frame in self.history for box in boxes_for_frame]
        annotated_rgb = draw_boxes(frame_rgb, stable_boxes)
        return cv2.cvtColor(annotated_rgb, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)


def predict_video(input_path: str | Path, output_path: str | Path, checkpoint_path: str | Path, config: AppConfig) -> None:
    model = Classifier.load(checkpoint_path)
    detector = VideoVehicleDetector(model, config)
    capture = cv2.VideoCapture(str(input_path))
    if not capture.isOpened():
        raise ValueError(f'Unable to open video: {input_path}')
    fps = capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 25.0
    width = int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH))
    height = int(capture.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))
    output = Path(output_path)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    writer = cv2.VideoWriter(str(output), cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v'), fps, (width, height))
    try:
        while True:
            ok, frame = capture.read()
            if not ok:
                break
            writer.write(detector.process_frame(frame))
    finally:
        capture.release()
        writer.release()

from __future__ import annotations

import io
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from fastapi import FastAPI, File, HTTPException, UploadFile

from road_vehicle_detector.config import AppConfig, load_config
from road_vehicle_detector.inference import detect_vehicles
from road_vehicle_detector.model import Classifier


def create_app(config_path: str | Path, checkpoint_path: str | Path) -> FastAPI:
    config = load_config(config_path)
    model = Classifier.load(checkpoint_path)
    app = FastAPI(title='RoadVehicleDetector', version='0.1.0')

    @app.get('/health')
    def health() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    @app.post('/predict')
    async def predict(file: UploadFile = File(...)) -> dict[str, object]:
        payload = await file.read()
        image_array = np.frombuffer(payload, dtype=np.uint8)
        bgr = cv2.imdecode(image_array, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if bgr is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='Uploaded file is not a readable image')
        rgb = cv2.cvtColor(bgr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        boxes = detect_vehicles(rgb, model, config)
        return {'boxes': [asdict(box) for box in boxes], 'count': len(boxes)}

    return app

# "RoadVehicleDetector/README.md"
# RoadVehicleDetector

RoadVehicleDetector is a research-to-production classical computer-vision pipeline for detecting vehicles in front-facing road images and dashcam video. It expands a small trained-classifier wrapper into a complete project with feature extraction, dataset loading, training, evaluation, checkpointing, inference, a CLI, and an optional HTTP serving layer.

The default model is intentionally transparent: it extracts HOG, spatial color, and color-histogram features from labeled vehicle and non-vehicle crops, scales them, and trains a linear SVM. The inference pipeline applies the classifier over multi-scale sliding windows, accumulates heat maps, thresholds unstable detections, and returns bounding boxes.

## Expected dataset layout

Place images in separate positive and negative directories:

- data/raw/vehicles
- data/raw/non_vehicles

Supported image suffixes are jpg, jpeg, png, and bmp.

## Common commands

Install locally:

python -m pip install -e .[dev]

Train:

rvehicle train --config configs/default.yaml

Evaluate an existing checkpoint:

rvehicle evaluate --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib

Run inference on an image:

rvehicle predict-image input.jpg output.jpg --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib

Serve HTTP predictions:

rvehicle serve --config configs/default.yaml --checkpoint artifacts/model.joblib --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080

## Notes

This project is designed for reproducible baselines and embedded-friendly deployments where a small classical model is preferable to a large neural network. It is also useful for teaching feature engineering, model evaluation, and sliding-window object detection.

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProjectConfig:
    name: str = 'RoadVehicleDetector'
    seed: int = 42
    artifact_dir: Path = Path('artifacts')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DataConfig:
    vehicle_dir: Path = Path('data/raw/vehicles')
    non_vehicle_dir: Path = Path('data/raw/non_vehicles')
    image_size: int = 64
    test_size: float = 0.2
    validation_size: float = 0.0
    max_samples_per_class: int | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FeatureConfig:
    color_space: str = 'YCrCb'
    orient: int = 9
    pix_per_cell: int = 8
    cell_per_block: int = 2
    hog_channel: int | str = 'all'
    spatial_size: tuple[int, int] = (32, 32)
    hist_bins: int = 32
    use_spatial: bool = True
    use_histogram: bool = True
    use_hog: bool = True


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelConfig:
    classifier: str = 'linear_svc'
    c: float = 1.0
    class_weight: str | None = 'balanced'
    probability_calibration: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SearchRegion:
    y_start: int
    y_stop: int
    scale: float = 1.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InferenceConfig:
    search_regions: list[SearchRegion] = field(default_factory=list)
    window_size: int = 64
    cells_per_step: int = 2
    heat_threshold: int = 2
    min_box_area: int = 900


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrackingConfig:
    enabled: bool = True
    log_path: Path = Path('artifacts/runs.jsonl')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AppConfig:
    project: ProjectConfig = field(default_factory=ProjectConfig)
    data: DataConfig = field(default_factory=DataConfig)
    features: FeatureConfig = field(default_factory=FeatureConfig)
    model: ModelConfig = field(default_factory=ModelConfig)
    inference: InferenceConfig = field(default_factory=InferenceConfig)
    tracking: TrackingConfig = field(default_factory=TrackingConfig)


def _tuple2(value: Any, field_name: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) or len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError(f'{field_name} must contain exactly two integers')
    return int(value[0]), int(value[1])


def _path(value: Any) -> Path:
    return value if isinstance(value, Path) else Path(str(value))


def load_config(path: str | Path) -> AppConfig:
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Configuration file not found: {config_path}')
    with config_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        raw = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
    return parse_config(raw)


def parse_config(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> AppConfig:
    project_raw = raw.get('project', {})
    data_raw = raw.get('data', {})
    features_raw = raw.get('features', {})
    model_raw = raw.get('model', {})
    inference_raw = raw.get('inference', {})
    tracking_raw = raw.get('tracking', {})

    regions = [SearchRegion(**region) for region in inference_raw.get('search_regions', [])]
    return AppConfig(
        project=ProjectConfig(
            name=str(project_raw.get('name', 'RoadVehicleDetector')),
            seed=int(project_raw.get('seed', 42)),
            artifact_dir=_path(project_raw.get('artifact_dir', 'artifacts')),
        ),
        data=DataConfig(
            vehicle_dir=_path(data_raw.get('vehicle_dir', 'data/raw/vehicles')),
            non_vehicle_dir=_path(data_raw.get('non_vehicle_dir', 'data/raw/non_vehicles')),
            image_size=int(data_raw.get('image_size', 64)),
            test_size=float(data_raw.get('test_size', 0.2)),
            validation_size=float(data_raw.get('validation_size', 0.0)),
            max_samples_per_class=data_raw.get('max_samples_per_class'),
        ),
        features=FeatureConfig(
            color_space=str(features_raw.get('color_space', 'YCrCb')),
            orient=int(features_raw.get('orient', 9)),
            pix_per_cell=int(features_raw.get('pix_per_cell', 8)),
            cell_per_block=int(features_raw.get('cell_per_block', 2)),
            hog_channel=features_raw.get('hog_channel', 'all'),
            spatial_size=_tuple2(features_raw.get('spatial_size', [32, 32]), 'spatial_size'),
            hist_bins=int(features_raw.get('hist_bins', 32)),
            use_spatial=bool(features_raw.get('use_spatial', True)),
            use_histogram=bool(features_raw.get('use_histogram', True)),
            use_hog=bool(features_raw.get('use_hog', True)),
        ),
        model=ModelConfig(
            classifier=str(model_raw.get('classifier', 'linear_svc')),
            c=float(model_raw.get('c', 1.0)),
            class_weight=model_raw.get('class_weight', 'balanced'),
            probability_calibration=bool(model_raw.get('probability_calibration', False)),
        ),
        inference=InferenceConfig(
            search_regions=regions,
            window_size=int(inference_raw.get('window_size', 64)),
            cells_per_step=int(inference_raw.get('cells_per_step', 2)),
            heat_threshold=int(inference_raw.get('heat_threshold', 2)),
            min_box_area=int(inference_raw.get('min_box_area', 900)),
        ),
        tracking=TrackingConfig(
            enabled=bool(tracking_raw.get('enabled', True)),
            log_path=_path(tracking_raw.get('log_path', 'artifacts/runs.jsonl')),
        ),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from skimage.feature import hog

from road_vehicle_detector.config import FeatureConfig

SUPPORTED_COLOR_SPACES = {'RGB', 'HSV', 'LUV', 'HLS', 'YUV', 'YCrCb'}


def read_image(path: str | Path, size: int | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    image = cv2.imread(str(path))
    if image is None:
        raise ValueError(f'Unable to read image: {path}')
    image = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    if size is not None:
        image = cv2.resize(image, (size, size), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    return image


def convert_color(image: np.ndarray, color_space: str) -> np.ndarray:
    if color_space not in SUPPORTED_COLOR_SPACES:
        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported color space: {color_space}')
    if color_space == 'RGB':
        return np.copy(image)
    code = {
        'HSV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV,
        'LUV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2LUV,
        'HLS': cv2.COLOR_RGB2HLS,
        'YUV': cv2.COLOR_RGB2YUV,
        'YCrCb': cv2.COLOR_RGB2YCrCb,
    }[color_space]
    return cv2.cvtColor(image, code)


def bin_spatial(image: np.ndarray, size: tuple[int, int]) -> np.ndarray:
    return cv2.resize(image, size, interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).ravel()


def color_hist(image: np.ndarray, nbins: int) -> np.ndarray:
    channel_features = [np.histogram(image[:, :, channel], bins=nbins, range=(0, 256))[0] for channel in range(image.shape[2])]
    return np.concatenate(channel_features).astype(np.float32)


def get_hog_features(
    channel: np.ndarray,
    orient: int,
    pix_per_cell: int,
    cell_per_block: int,
    feature_vec: bool = True,
) -> np.ndarray:
    return hog(
        channel,
        orientations=orient,
        pixels_per_cell=(pix_per_cell, pix_per_cell),
        cells_per_block=(cell_per_block, cell_per_block),
        transform_sqrt=True,
        visualize=False,
        feature_vector=feature_vec,
    )


def extract_image_features(image: np.ndarray, config: FeatureConfig) -> np.ndarray:
    feature_image = convert_color(image, config.color_space)
    features: list[np.ndarray] = []
    if config.use_spatial:
        features.append(bin_spatial(feature_image, config.spatial_size))
    if config.use_histogram:
        features.append(color_hist(feature_image, config.hist_bins))
    if config.use_hog:
        if config.hog_channel == 'all':
            hog_features = [
                get_hog_features(feature_image[:, :, channel], config.orient, config.pix_per_cell, config.cell_per_block)
                for channel in range(feature_image.shape[2])
            ]
            features.append(np.ravel(hog_features))
        else:
            channel = int(config.hog_channel)
            features.append(get_hog_features(feature_image[:, :, channel], config.orient, config.pix_per_cell, config.cell_per_block))
    if not features:
        raise ValueError('At least one feature family must be enabled')
    return np.concatenate(features).astype(np.float32)


def extract_features_from_paths(paths: Iterable[str | Path], config: FeatureConfig, image_size: int) -> np.ndarray:
    rows = []
    for path in paths:
        rows.append(extract_image_features(read_image(path, image_size), config))
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError('No images were provided for feature extraction')
    return np.vstack(rows)
