'''oslo.vmware session factory.'''

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from vcenter_inventory.config import VCenterConfig
from vcenter_inventory.exceptions import VCenterConnectionError

LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class VCenterSession:
    '''Small wrapper that owns an oslo.vmware api.VMwareAPISession.'''

    def __init__(self, config: VCenterConfig) -> None:
        self.config = config
        self._session: Any | None = None

    def connect(self) -> Any:
        if self._session is not None:
            return self._session
        try:
            from oslo_vmware import api
            self._session = api.VMwareAPISession(
                self.config.host,
                self.config.username,
                self.config.password,
                self.config.api_retry_count,
                self.config.task_poll_interval,
                port=self.config.port,
                scheme='https',
                create_session=True,
                insecure=self.config.insecure,
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - depends on external endpoint
            raise VCenterConnectionError(f'failed to connect to vCenter {self.config.host}: {exc}') from exc
        LOG.info('connected to vCenter %s', self.config.host)
        return self._session

    @property
    def vim(self) -> Any:
        session = self.connect()
        return session.vim

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._session is None:
            return
        logout = getattr(self._session, 'logout', None)
        if callable(logout):
            logout()
        self._session = None

    def __enter__(self) -> 'VCenterSession':
        self.connect()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, tb: object) -> None:
        self.close()

# "VCenter_Inventory_Collector/src/vcenter_inventory/vmware/property_collector.py"
'''PropertyCollector and traversal helpers for vSphere inventory queries.'''

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Iterable

try:
    from oslo_vmware import vim_util as oslo_vim_util
except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - optional until a real vCenter environment is installed
    oslo_vim_util = None


def _create_selection_spec(client_factory: Any, name: str) -> Any:
    spec = client_factory.create('ns0:SelectionSpec')
    spec.name = name
    return spec


def _create_traversal_spec(
    client_factory: Any,
    name: str,
    type_: str,
    path: str,
    select_names: Iterable[str] = (),
) -> Any:
    spec = client_factory.create('ns0:TraversalSpec')
    spec.name = name
    spec.type = type_
    spec.path = path
    spec.skip = False
    names = list(select_names)
    if names:
        spec.selectSet = [_create_selection_spec(client_factory, item) for item in names]
    return spec


def build_recursive_traversal_spec(client_factory: Any) -> list[Any]:
    '''Build traversal specs that recursively visit folders, datacenters, hosts, datastores and resource pools.'''
    rp_to_rp = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'rpToRp', 'ResourcePool', 'resourcePool', ['rpToRp', 'rpToVm'])
    rp_to_vm = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'rpToVm', 'ResourcePool', 'vm')
    cr_to_rp = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'crToRp', 'ComputeResource', 'resourcePool', ['rpToRp', 'rpToVm'])
    cr_to_h = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'crToH', 'ComputeResource', 'host')
    dc_to_hf = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'dcToHf', 'Datacenter', 'hostFolder', ['visitFolders'])
    dc_to_vmf = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'dcToVmf', 'Datacenter', 'vmFolder', ['visitFolders'])
    dc_to_ds = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'dcToDs', 'Datacenter', 'datastore', ['visitFolders'])
    h_to_vm = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'hToVm', 'HostSystem', 'vm', ['visitFolders'])
    ds_to_vm = _create_traversal_spec(client_factory, 'dsToVm', 'Datastore', 'vm', ['visitFolders'])
    visit_folders = _create_traversal_spec(
        client_factory,
        'visitFolders',
        'Folder',
        'childEntity',
        ['visitFolders', 'dcToHf', 'dcToVmf', 'crToH', 'crToRp', 'dcToDs', 'hToVm', 'dsToVm', 'rpToVm'],
    )
    return [visit_folders, dc_to_vmf, dc_to_ds, dc_to_hf, cr_to_h, cr_to_rp, rp_to_rp, h_to_vm, ds_to_vm, rp_to_vm]


def build_object_spec(client_factory: Any, obj: Any, select_set: list[Any] | None = None) -> Any:
    obj_spec = client_factory.create('ns0:ObjectSpec')
    obj_spec.obj = obj
    obj_spec.skip = False
    if select_set is not None:
        obj_spec.selectSet = select_set
    return obj_spec


def build_property_spec(client_factory: Any, type_: str, properties_to_collect: list[str] | None = None, all_properties: bool = False) -> Any:
    prop_spec = client_factory.create('ns0:PropertySpec')
    prop_spec.type = type_
    prop_spec.all = all_properties or not properties_to_collect
    prop_spec.pathSet = properties_to_collect or []
    return prop_spec


def build_property_filter_spec(client_factory: Any, property_specs: list[Any], object_specs: list[Any]) -> Any:
    prop_filter_spec = client_factory.create('ns0:PropertyFilterSpec')
    prop_filter_spec.propSet = property_specs
    prop_filter_spec.objectSet = object_specs
    return prop_filter_spec


def retrieve_properties_ex(vim: Any, prop_coll: Any, spec_set: list[Any], max_count: int = 500) -> list[Any]:
    '''Retrieve all pages from RetrievePropertiesEx.'''
    objects: list[Any] = []
    client_factory = vim.client.factory
    opts = client_factory.create('ns0:RetrieveOptions')
    opts.maxObjects = max_count
    result = vim.RetrievePropertiesEx(prop_coll, specSet=spec_set, options=opts)
    while True:
        if result and getattr(result, 'objects', None):
            objects.extend(result.objects)
        token = getattr(result, 'token', None) if result else None
        if token:
            result = vim.ContinueRetrievePropertiesEx(prop_coll, token=token)
            continue
        return objects


def get_object_properties(vim: Any, collector: Any, mobj: Any, type_: str, properties: list[str] | None) -> list[Any] | None:
    if mobj is None:
        return None
    client_factory = vim.client.factory
    property_spec = build_property_spec(client_factory, type_, properties, all_properties=not properties)
    object_spec = build_object_spec(client_factory, mobj)
    filter_spec = build_property_filter_spec(client_factory, [property_spec], [object_spec])
    return retrieve_properties_ex(vim, collector or vim.service_content.propertyCollector, [filter_spec])


def get_dynamic_properties(vim: Any, mobj: Any, property_names: list[str], obj_type: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    obj_type = obj_type or getattr(mobj, '_type')
    content = get_object_properties(vim, None, mobj, obj_type, property_names)
    properties: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if not content:
        return properties
    for dynamic_property in getattr(content[0], 'propSet', []) or []:
        properties[dynamic_property.name] = dynamic_property.val
    return properties


def get_dynamic_property(vim: Any, mobj: Any, type_: str, property_name: str) -> Any:
    return get_dynamic_properties(vim, mobj, [property_name], type_).get(property_name)


def get_objects(vim: Any, type_: str, properties_to_collect: list[str] | None = None, all_properties: bool = False) -> list[Any]:
    properties_to_collect = properties_to_collect or ['name']
    client_factory = vim.client.factory
    traversal = build_recursive_traversal_spec(client_factory)
    object_spec = build_object_spec(client_factory, vim.service_content.rootFolder, traversal)
    property_spec = build_property_spec(client_factory, type_, properties_to_collect, all_properties)
    filter_spec = build_property_filter_spec(client_factory, [property_spec], [object_spec])
    return retrieve_properties_ex(vim, vim.service_content.propertyCollector, [filter_spec])


def get_property_filter_specs(vim: Any, property_dict: dict[str, list[str]], objects: list[Any] | None = None) -> Any:
    client_factory = vim.client.factory
    roots = objects or [vim.service_content.rootFolder]
    object_specs = [build_object_spec(client_factory, obj, build_recursive_traversal_spec(client_factory)) for obj in roots]
    property_specs = [build_property_spec(client_factory, obj_type, props) for obj_type, props in property_dict.items()]
    return build_property_filter_spec(client_factory, property_specs, object_specs)


def create_filter(vim: Any, prop_filter_spec: Any, collector: Any | None = None) -> Any:
    return vim.CreateFilter(collector or vim.service_content.propertyCollector, spec=prop_filter_spec, partialUpdates=False)


def create_property_collector(vim: Any, collector: Any | None = None) -> Any:
    return vim.CreatePropertyCollector(collector or vim.service_content.propertyCollector)


def destroy_property_collector(vim: Any, collector: Any) -> Any:
    if collector:
        return vim.DestroyPropertyCollector(collector)
    return None


def wait_for_updates_ex(vim: Any, version: str, collector: Any | None = None, max_wait: int = 85, max_update_count: int = -1) -> Any:
    waitopts = vim.client.factory.create('ns0:WaitOptions')
    waitopts.maxWaitSeconds = max_wait
    if max_update_count > 0:
        waitopts.maxObjectUpdates = max_update_count
    return vim.WaitForUpdatesEx(collector or vim.service_content.propertyCollector, version=version, options=waitopts)


def cancel_wait_for_updates(vim: Any, collector: Any | None = None) -> Any:
    return vim.CancelWaitForUpdates(collector or vim.service_content.propertyCollector)


def get_properties_for_a_collection_of_objects(vim: Any, type_: str, obj_list: list[Any], properties: list[str]) -> list[Any]:
    if not obj_list:
        return []
    client_factory = vim.client.factory
    prop_spec = build_property_spec(client_factory, type_, properties)
    object_specs = [build_object_spec(client_factory, obj) for obj in obj_list]
    filter_spec = build_property_filter_spec(client_factory, [prop_spec], object_specs)
    return retrieve_properties_ex(vim, vim.service_content.propertyCollector, [filter_spec])


def get_search_index(vim: Any) -> Any:
    return vim.service_content.searchIndex


def find_by_inventory_path(vim: Any, search_index: Any, path: str) -> Any:
    return vim.FindByInventoryPath(search_index, inventoryPath=path)


def get_root_folder_id(vim: Any) -> str:
    return str(vim.service_content.rootFolder.value)


def get_dv_switch_manager(vim: Any) -> Any:
    return vim.service_content.dvSwitchManager


def get_dvs_mor_by_uuid(vim: Any, uuid: str) -> Any:
    return vim.QueryDvsByUuid(get_dv_switch_manager(vim), uuid=uuid)

'''High-level inventory collection and normalization.'''

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from vcenter_inventory.models import InventoryObject, InventorySnapshot, ManagedObjectRef
from vcenter_inventory.vmware import property_collector as pc

LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEFAULT_PROPERTY_MAP: dict[str, list[str]] = {
    'VirtualMachine': ['name', 'runtime.powerState', 'config.uuid', 'guest.guestFullName', 'summary.storage.committed'],
    'HostSystem': ['name', 'summary.hardware.cpuModel', 'summary.hardware.memorySize', 'runtime.connectionState'],
    'Datastore': ['name', 'summary.capacity', 'summary.freeSpace', 'summary.type'],
    'ClusterComputeResource': ['name', 'summary.numHosts', 'summary.numCpuCores', 'summary.totalMemory'],
    'ResourcePool': ['name', 'runtime.cpu.maxUsage', 'runtime.memory.maxUsage'],
    'Network': ['name'],
    'DistributedVirtualSwitch': ['name', 'uuid'],
}


def _safe_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_safe_value(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): _safe_value(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if hasattr(value, 'value') and hasattr(value, '_type'):
        return {'type': str(value._type), 'value': str(value.value)}
    return str(value)


def normalize_object_content(content: Any, kind: str) -> InventoryObject:
    mor = ManagedObjectRef.from_soap(content.obj)
    properties: dict[str, Any] = {}
    name: str | None = None
    for prop in getattr(content, 'propSet', []) or []:
        properties[prop.name] = _safe_value(prop.val)
        if prop.name == 'name':
            name = str(prop.val)
    return InventoryObject(mor=mor, name=name, kind=kind, properties=properties)


class InventoryCollector:
    '''Collects complete snapshots from vCenter.'''

    def __init__(self, vim: Any, property_map: dict[str, list[str]] | None = None) -> None:
        self.vim = vim
        self.property_map = property_map or DEFAULT_PROPERTY_MAP

    def collect_objects(self) -> list[InventoryObject]:
        collected: list[InventoryObject] = []
        for kind, properties in self.property_map.items():
            LOG.info('collecting %s properties=%s', kind, properties)
            for content in pc.get_objects(self.vim, kind, properties):
                collected.append(normalize_object_content(content, kind))
        return collected

    def collect_snapshot(self, source: str) -> InventorySnapshot:
        objects = self.collect_objects()
        LOG.info('collected %d inventory objects from %s', len(objects), source)
        return InventorySnapshot.create(source=source, objects=objects)

def write_snapshot(snapshot: InventorySnapshot, path: Path) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    return InventorySnapshot.from_dict(payload)

'''Incremental PropertyCollector watcher utilities.'''

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Iterator

from vcenter_inventory.vmware import property_collector as pc

LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class InventoryWatcher:
    '''Polls WaitForUpdatesEx for a configured set of managed object properties.'''

    def __init__(self, vim: Any, property_map: dict[str, list[str]]) -> None:
        self.vim = vim
        self.property_map = property_map

    def updates(self, max_wait: int = 30) -> Iterator[Any]:
        collector = pc.create_property_collector(self.vim)
        version = ''
        try:
            spec = pc.get_property_filter_specs(self.vim, self.property_map)
            pc.create_filter(self.vim, spec, collector)
            while True:
                update_set = pc.wait_for_updates_ex(self.vim, version, collector, max_wait=max_wait)
                if update_set is None:
                    continue
                version = getattr(update_set, 'version', version)
                yield update_set
        finally:
            LOG.info('destroying watcher property collector')
            pc.destroy_property_collector(self.vim, collector)

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

from vcenter_inventory.storage import read_snapshot


def create_app(snapshot_path: Path) -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(title='vCenter Inventory Collector', version='0.1.0')

    @app.get('/healthz')
    def healthz() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    @app.get('/snapshot')
    def snapshot() -> dict[str, object]:
        if not snapshot_path.exists():
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='snapshot not found')
        return read_snapshot(snapshot_path).to_dict()

    @app.get('/objects/{kind}')
    def objects_by_kind(kind: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        if not snapshot_path.exists():
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='snapshot not found')
        return [obj.to_dict() for obj in read_snapshot(snapshot_path).by_kind(kind)]

    return app

'''Command line interface.'''

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import typer
from rich.console import Console
from rich.table import Table

from vcenter_inventory.config import AppConfig
from vcenter_inventory.inventory import InventoryCollector
from vcenter_inventory.logging import configure_logging
from vcenter_inventory.storage import read_snapshot, write_snapshot
from vcenter_inventory.vmware.session import VCenterSession

app = typer.Typer(help='Collect and serve VMware vCenter inventory snapshots.')
console = Console()


@app.command()
def collect(out: Path = typer.Option(Path('snapshots/latest.json'), help='Output snapshot JSON path.')) -> None:
    config = AppConfig.from_env()
    configure_logging(config.log_level)
    with VCenterSession(config.vcenter) as session:
        snapshot = InventoryCollector(session.vim).collect_snapshot(source=config.vcenter.host)
    write_snapshot(snapshot, out)
    console.print(f'wrote {len(snapshot.objects)} objects to {out}')


@app.command()
def summarize(snapshot: Path = typer.Argument(..., help='Snapshot JSON path.')) -> None:
    data = read_snapshot(snapshot)
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for obj in data.objects:
        counts[obj.kind] = counts.get(obj.kind, 0) + 1
    table = Table(title=f'Inventory summary for {data.source}')
    table.add_column('Kind')
    table.add_column('Count', justify='right')
    for kind, count in sorted(counts.items()):
        table.add_row(kind, str(count))
    console.print(table)


@app.command()
def serve(
    snapshot: Path = typer.Option(Path('snapshots/latest.json'), help='Snapshot JSON path to expose.'),
    host: str = typer.Option('127.0.0.1'),
    port: int = typer.Option(8080),
) -> None:
    import uvicorn
    from vcenter_inventory.server import create_app

    uvicorn.run(create_app(snapshot), host=host, port=port)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app()

# "MorningBriefCN/README.md"
# MorningBriefCN

MorningBriefCN is a Python 3.12 service for generating Chinese daily morning briefings. It combines Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendar information with multiple news providers and exposes the result through a CLI, a small HTTP API, and reusable application services.

The project is designed as a realistic evolution of a small script that fetched TianAPI bulletins, scraped the Chinese New York Times, and formatted a text message.

## Features

- Chinese lunar date conversion using `sxtwl` when available, with a graceful fallback.
- TianAPI bulletin client with validation and retries.
- Chinese New York Times scraper using `requests` and `lxml`.
- Provider abstraction for adding more news sources.
- Deterministic text formatting for messaging apps.
- Optional JSON cache to reduce network calls.
- CLI commands for generating, saving, and serving briefings.
- FastAPI application for production deployment.
- Unit tests with mocked network responses.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev,server]'
```

Generate a briefing:

```bash
morningbrief generate --sources tianapi,nytimes --nytimes-page 1
```

Run the HTTP API:

```bash
morningbrief serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

or:

```bash
uvicorn morningbrief.api:app --reload
```

## Configuration

Configuration can be provided through environment variables:

- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY`: TianAPI key.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_CACHE_DIR`: cache directory, default `.cache/morningbrief`.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`: HTTP timeout.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_USER_AGENT`: scraper user agent.

A `.env` file can also be used when `pydantic-settings` is installed.

## Example output

```text
【早间新闻】 2026-05-29 农历:四月十三

一、国内要闻
1. Example headline
   来源：TianAPI
   链接：https://example.com

二、纽约时报中文网
1. Example NYT headline
   概要：Article summary
   链接：https://cn.nytimes.com/...
```

## Development

```bash
ruff check .
pytest
```

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, HttpUrl, field_validator


class SourceName(StrEnum):
    TIANAPI = 'tianapi'
    NYTIMES = 'nytimes'


class NewsItem(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
    source: SourceName | str
    summary: str | None = None
    url: HttpUrl | str | None = None
    image_url: HttpUrl | str | None = None
    published_at: datetime | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    @field_validator('title')
    @classmethod
    def normalize_title(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return ' '.join(value.split())

    @field_validator('summary')
    @classmethod
    def normalize_summary(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return None
        value = ' '.join(value.split())
        return value or None


class LunarDate(BaseModel):
    solar_date: date
    lunar_text: str
    is_leap_month: bool = False

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from morningbrief.exceptions import CalendarError
from morningbrief.models import LunarDate

LUNAR_MONTHS = ['十一', '十二', '正', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']
LUNAR_DAYS = [
    '初一', '初二', '初三', '初四', '初五', '初六', '初七', '初八', '初九', '初十',
    '十一', '十二', '十三', '十四', '十五', '十六', '十七', '十八', '十九', '二十',
    '廿一', '廿二', '廿三', '廿四', '廿五', '廿六', '廿七', '廿八', '廿九', '三十', '卅一',
]


def get_lunar_date(day: date | None = None) -> LunarDate:
    target = day or date.today()
    try:
        import sxtwl  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    except ImportError:
        return LunarDate(solar_date=target, lunar_text='农历:未知', is_leap_month=False)

    try:
        lunar = sxtwl.Lunar()
        lunar_day = lunar.getDayBySolar(target.year, target.month, target.day)
        month = LUNAR_MONTHS[lunar_day.Lmc]
        day_text = LUNAR_DAYS[lunar_day.Ldi]
        leap_prefix = '闰' if bool(lunar_day.Lleap) else ''
        return LunarDate(
            solar_date=target,
            lunar_text=f'农历:{leap_prefix}{month}月{day_text}',
            is_leap_month=bool(lunar_day.Lleap),
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CalendarError(f'Unable to convert solar date {target} to lunar date') from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError


def build_session(settings: Settings) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(
        total=3,
        connect=3,
        read=3,
        backoff_factor=0.3,
        status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
        allowed_methods=frozenset({'GET'}),
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry, pool_connections=8, pool_maxsize=16)
    session.mount('http://', adapter)
    session.mount('https://', adapter)
    session.headers.update({'User-Agent': settings.user_agent})
    return session


def get_json(
    session: requests.Session,
    url: str,
    *,
    timeout: float,
    params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        payload = response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'Invalid JSON response from {url}') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ProviderError(f'Expected object JSON response from {url}')
    return payload


def get_text(session: requests.Session, url: str, *, timeout: float) -> str:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        response.encoding = response.encoding or 'utf-8'
        return response.text
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import requests

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ConfigurationError, ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_json
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class TianApiBulletinProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.TIANAPI.value
    section_title = '国内要闻'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        if not self.settings.tianapi_key:
            raise ConfigurationError('MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY is required for TianAPI provider')
        payload = get_json(
            self.session,
            str(self.settings.tianapi_endpoint),
            timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds,
            params={'key': self.settings.tianapi_key},
        )
        code = payload.get('code')
        if code not in (200, '200', None):
            raise ProviderError(f'TianAPI returned non-success code: {code}; message={payload.get("msg")}')
        raw_items = payload.get('newslist', [])
        if not isinstance(raw_items, list):
            raise ProviderError('TianAPI response field newslist must be a list')
        return [self._parse_item(item) for item in raw_items[:limit] if isinstance(item, dict)]

    def _parse_item(self, item: dict[str, Any]) -> NewsItem:
        url = item.get('url') or item.get('link') or None
        image_url = item.get('imgsrc') or item.get('picUrl') or None
        return NewsItem(
            title=str(item.get('title') or '').strip(),
            source=SourceName.TIANAPI,
            summary=item.get('digest') or item.get('description'),
            url=url,
            image_url=image_url,
            metadata={'raw_source': 'tianapi'},
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from urllib.parse import urljoin

import requests
from lxml import etree, html

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_text
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.NYTIMES.value
    section_title = '纽约时报中文网'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session, *, page: int = 1) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session
        self.page = max(page, 1)

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        url = f'{str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url).rstrip("/")}/society/{self.page}/'
        document_text = get_text(self.session, url, timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds)
        try:
            tree = html.fromstring(document_text)
        except etree.ParserError as exc:
            raise ProviderError('Unable to parse New York Times Chinese HTML') from exc
        articles = tree.xpath('//*[@id="sectionWrapper"]/div[1]/div/div/ul/li')
        if not articles:
            articles = tree.xpath('//article|//li[.//h3]')
        items: list[NewsItem] = []
        for article in articles:
            title_nodes = article.xpath('.//h3/a|.//h2/a|.//a[contains(@class, "headline")]')
            if not title_nodes:
                continue
            title = self._text(title_nodes[0])
            if not title:
                continue
            summary_nodes = article.xpath('.//p')
            href = title_nodes[0].get('href')
            items.append(
                NewsItem(
                    title=title,
                    source=SourceName.NYTIMES,
                    summary=self._text(summary_nodes[0]) if summary_nodes else None,
                    url=urljoin(str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url), href) if href else None,
                    metadata={'page': self.page},
                )
            )
            if len(items) >= limit:
                break
        return items

    @staticmethod
    def _text(node: object) -> str:
        if hasattr(node, 'text_content'):
            return ' '.join(node.text_content().split())
        return ''

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from morningbrief.models import NewsItem

_NEWS_ITEMS = TypeAdapter(list[NewsItem])


class JsonCache:
    def __init__(self, directory: Path, ttl_seconds: int) -> None:
        self.directory = directory
        self.ttl = timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, key: str) -> Path:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        return self.directory / f'{digest}.json'

    def get_items(self, key: str) -> list[NewsItem] | None:
        path = self._path(key)
        if not path.exists() or self.ttl.total_seconds() <= 0:
            return None
        try:
            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(payload['created_at'])
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc) - created_at > self.ttl:
                return None
            return _NEWS_ITEMS.validate_python(payload['items'])
        except Exception:
            return None

    def set_items(self, key: str, items: list[NewsItem]) -> None:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            'created_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'items': [item.model_dump(mode='json') for item in items],
        }
        self._path(key).write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

from __future__ import annotations

from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem

CHINESE_NUMBERS = ['一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']


def format_briefing_text(briefing: Briefing) -> str:
    lines = [f'【早间新闻】 {briefing.solar_date.isoformat()} {briefing.lunar_text}', '']
    for section_index, (section, items) in enumerate(briefing.sections.items(), start=1):
        section_label = CHINESE_NUMBERS[section_index - 1] if section_index <= len(CHINESE_NUMBERS) else str(section_index)
        lines.append(f'{section_label}、{section}')
        if not items:
            lines.append('暂无内容')
        for index, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
            lines.extend(_format_item(index, item))
        lines.append('')
    return '\n'.join(lines).strip() + '\n'


def _format_item(index: int, item: NewsItem) -> list[str]:
    lines = [f'{index}. {item.title}']
    if item.summary:
        lines.append(f'   概要：{item.summary}')
    lines.append(f'   来源：{item.source}')
    if item.url:
        lines.append(f'   链接：{item.url}')
    elif item.image_url:
        lines.append(f'   图片：{item.image_url}')
    return lines

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from datetime import date

from morningbrief.config import Settings, get_settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import MorningBriefError
from morningbrief.http import build_session
from morningbrief.lunar import get_lunar_date
from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers import NewYorkTimesChineseProvider, NewsProvider, TianApiBulletinProvider
from morningbrief.storage import JsonCache


class BriefingService:
    def __init__(self, settings: Settings | None = None) -> None:
        self.settings = settings or get_settings()
        self.session = build_session(self.settings)
        self.cache = JsonCache(self.settings.cache_dir, self.settings.cache_ttl_seconds)

    def build_providers(self, source_names: Iterable[str], *, nytimes_page: int = 1) -> list[NewsProvider]:
        providers: list[NewsProvider] = []
        for source in source_names:
            normalized = source.strip().lower()
            if normalized == SourceName.TIANAPI.value:
                providers.append(TianApiBulletinProvider(self.settings, self.session))
            elif normalized == SourceName.NYTIMES.value:
                providers.append(NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(self.settings, self.session, page=nytimes_page))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f'Unknown news source: {source}')
        return providers

    def generate(
        self,
        *,
        sources: Iterable[str] = (SourceName.TIANAPI.value, SourceName.NYTIMES.value),
        briefing_date: date | None = None,
        nytimes_page: int = 1,
        fail_soft: bool = True,
    ) -> Briefing:
        lunar = get_lunar_date(briefing_date)
        sections: dict[str, list[NewsItem]] = {}
        for provider in self.build_providers(sources, nytimes_page=nytimes_page):
            cache_key = f'{provider.name}:{briefing_date or date.today()}:{nytimes_page}'
            cached = self.cache.get_items(cache_key)
            if cached is not None:
                sections[provider.section_title] = cached
                continue
            try:
                items = provider.fetch(limit=self.settings.max_items_per_source)
            except MorningBriefError:
                if not fail_soft:
                    raise
                items = []
            self.cache.set_items(cache_key, items)
            sections[provider.section_title] = items
        return Briefing(solar_date=lunar.solar_date, lunar_text=lunar.lunar_text, sections=sections)

    output: Annotated[Path | None, typer.Option(help='Write briefing text to a file')] = None,

) -> None:

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from morningbrief.formatter import format_briefing_text
from morningbrief.service import BriefingService


def run_daily_file_writer(
    *,
    output_dir: Path,
    hour: int = 7,
    minute: int = 30,
    stop_after_runs: int | None = None,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
) -> None:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    runs = 0
    while stop_after_runs is None or runs < stop_after_runs:
        now = datetime.now()
        target = now.replace(hour=hour, minute=minute, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if target <= now:
            target += timedelta(days=1)
        sleep(max((target - now).total_seconds(), 0))
        service = BriefingService()
        briefing = service.generate()
        path = output_dir / f'{briefing.solar_date.isoformat()}.txt'
        path.write_text(format_briefing_text(briefing), encoding='utf-8')
        runs += 1

# "MorningBriefCN/README.md"
# MorningBriefCN

MorningBriefCN is a Python 3.12 service for generating Chinese daily morning briefings. It combines Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendar information with multiple news providers and exposes the result through a CLI, a small HTTP API, and reusable application services.

The project is designed as a realistic evolution of a small script that fetched TianAPI bulletins, scraped the Chinese New York Times, and formatted a text message.

## Features

- Chinese lunar date conversion using `sxtwl` when available, with a graceful fallback.
- TianAPI bulletin client with validation and retries.
- Chinese New York Times scraper using `requests` and `lxml`.
- Provider abstraction for adding more news sources.
- Deterministic text formatting for messaging apps.
- Optional JSON cache to reduce network calls.
- CLI commands for generating, saving, and serving briefings.
- FastAPI application for production deployment.
- Unit tests with mocked network responses.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev,server]'
```

Generate a briefing:

```bash
morningbrief generate --sources tianapi,nytimes --nytimes-page 1
```

Run the HTTP API:

```bash
morningbrief serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

or:

```bash
uvicorn morningbrief.api:app --reload
```

## Configuration

Configuration can be provided through environment variables:

- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY`: TianAPI key.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_CACHE_DIR`: cache directory, default `.cache/morningbrief`.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`: HTTP timeout.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_USER_AGENT`: scraper user agent.

A `.env` file can also be used when `pydantic-settings` is installed.

## Example output

```text
【早间新闻】 2026-05-29 农历:四月十三

一、国内要闻
1. Example headline
   来源：TianAPI
   链接：https://example.com

二、纽约时报中文网
1. Example NYT headline
   概要：Article summary
   链接：https://cn.nytimes.com/...
```

## Development

```bash
ruff check .
pytest
```

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic import Field, HttpUrl, PositiveFloat
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_prefix='MORNINGBRIEF_',
        env_file='.env',
        extra='ignore',
    )

    tianapi_key: str | None = Field(default=None, description='TianAPI key for bulletin news')
    tianapi_endpoint: HttpUrl = Field(default='https://api.tianapi.com/bulletin/index')
    nytimes_base_url: HttpUrl = Field(default='https://cn.nytimes.com')
    timeout_seconds: PositiveFloat = 8.0
    max_items_per_source: int = Field(default=10, ge=1, le=50)
    cache_dir: Path = Path('.cache/morningbrief')
    cache_ttl_seconds: int = Field(default=900, ge=0)
    user_agent: str = (
        'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) '
        'AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120 Safari/537.36'
    )
    include_empty_links: bool = False


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    settings = Settings()
    settings.cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return settings

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, HttpUrl, field_validator


class SourceName(StrEnum):
    TIANAPI = 'tianapi'
    NYTIMES = 'nytimes'


class NewsItem(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
    source: SourceName | str
    summary: str | None = None
    url: HttpUrl | str | None = None
    image_url: HttpUrl | str | None = None
    published_at: datetime | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    @field_validator('title')
    @classmethod
    def normalize_title(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return ' '.join(value.split())

    @field_validator('summary')
    @classmethod
    def normalize_summary(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return None
        value = ' '.join(value.split())
        return value or None


class LunarDate(BaseModel):
    solar_date: date
    lunar_text: str
    is_leap_month: bool = False


class Briefing(BaseModel):
    generated_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    solar_date: date
    lunar_text: str
    sections: dict[str, list[NewsItem]]

    @property
    def item_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(items) for items in self.sections.values())

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/lunar.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from morningbrief.exceptions import CalendarError
from morningbrief.models import LunarDate

LUNAR_MONTHS = ['十一', '十二', '正', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']
LUNAR_DAYS = [
    '初一', '初二', '初三', '初四', '初五', '初六', '初七', '初八', '初九', '初十',
    '十一', '十二', '十三', '十四', '十五', '十六', '十七', '十八', '十九', '二十',
    '廿一', '廿二', '廿三', '廿四', '廿五', '廿六', '廿七', '廿八', '廿九', '三十', '卅一',
]


def get_lunar_date(day: date | None = None) -> LunarDate:
    target = day or date.today()
    try:
        import sxtwl  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    except ImportError:
        return LunarDate(solar_date=target, lunar_text='农历:未知', is_leap_month=False)

    try:
        lunar = sxtwl.Lunar()
        lunar_day = lunar.getDayBySolar(target.year, target.month, target.day)
        month = LUNAR_MONTHS[lunar_day.Lmc]
        day_text = LUNAR_DAYS[lunar_day.Ldi]
        leap_prefix = '闰' if bool(lunar_day.Lleap) else ''
        return LunarDate(
            solar_date=target,
            lunar_text=f'农历:{leap_prefix}{month}月{day_text}',
            is_leap_month=bool(lunar_day.Lleap),
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CalendarError(f'Unable to convert solar date {target} to lunar date') from exc

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/http.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError


def build_session(settings: Settings) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(
        total=3,
        connect=3,
        read=3,
        backoff_factor=0.3,
        status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
        allowed_methods=frozenset({'GET'}),
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry, pool_connections=8, pool_maxsize=16)
    session.mount('http://', adapter)
    session.mount('https://', adapter)
    session.headers.update({'User-Agent': settings.user_agent})
    return session


def get_json(
    session: requests.Session,
    url: str,
    *,
    timeout: float,
    params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        payload = response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'Invalid JSON response from {url}') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ProviderError(f'Expected object JSON response from {url}')
    return payload


def get_text(session: requests.Session, url: str, *, timeout: float) -> str:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        response.encoding = response.encoding or 'utf-8'
        return response.text
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/providers/tianapi.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import requests

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ConfigurationError, ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_json
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class TianApiBulletinProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.TIANAPI.value
    section_title = '国内要闻'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        if not self.settings.tianapi_key:
            raise ConfigurationError('MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY is required for TianAPI provider')
        payload = get_json(
            self.session,
            str(self.settings.tianapi_endpoint),
            timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds,
            params={'key': self.settings.tianapi_key},
        )
        code = payload.get('code')
        if code not in (200, '200', None):
            raise ProviderError(f'TianAPI returned non-success code: {code}; message={payload.get("msg")}')
        raw_items = payload.get('newslist', [])
        if not isinstance(raw_items, list):
            raise ProviderError('TianAPI response field newslist must be a list')
        return [self._parse_item(item) for item in raw_items[:limit] if isinstance(item, dict)]

    def _parse_item(self, item: dict[str, Any]) -> NewsItem:
        url = item.get('url') or item.get('link') or None
        image_url = item.get('imgsrc') or item.get('picUrl') or None
        return NewsItem(
            title=str(item.get('title') or '').strip(),
            source=SourceName.TIANAPI,
            summary=item.get('digest') or item.get('description'),
            url=url,
            image_url=image_url,
            metadata={'raw_source': 'tianapi'},
        )

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/providers/nytimes.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from urllib.parse import urljoin

import requests
from lxml import etree, html

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_text
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.NYTIMES.value
    section_title = '纽约时报中文网'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session, *, page: int = 1) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session
        self.page = max(page, 1)

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        url = f'{str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url).rstrip("/")}/society/{self.page}/'
        document_text = get_text(self.session, url, timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds)
        try:
            tree = html.fromstring(document_text)
        except etree.ParserError as exc:
            raise ProviderError('Unable to parse New York Times Chinese HTML') from exc
        articles = tree.xpath('//*[@id="sectionWrapper"]/div[1]/div/div/ul/li')
        if not articles:
            articles = tree.xpath('//article|//li[.//h3]')
        items: list[NewsItem] = []
        for article in articles:
            title_nodes = article.xpath('.//h3/a|.//h2/a|.//a[contains(@class, "headline")]')
            if not title_nodes:
                continue
            title = self._text(title_nodes[0])
            if not title:
                continue
            summary_nodes = article.xpath('.//p')
            href = title_nodes[0].get('href')
            items.append(
                NewsItem(
                    title=title,
                    source=SourceName.NYTIMES,
                    summary=self._text(summary_nodes[0]) if summary_nodes else None,
                    url=urljoin(str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url), href) if href else None,
                    metadata={'page': self.page},
                )
            )
            if len(items) >= limit:
                break
        return items

    @staticmethod
    def _text(node: object) -> str:
        if hasattr(node, 'text_content'):
            return ' '.join(node.text_content().split())
        return ''

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/storage.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from morningbrief.models import NewsItem

_NEWS_ITEMS = TypeAdapter(list[NewsItem])


class JsonCache:
    def __init__(self, directory: Path, ttl_seconds: int) -> None:
        self.directory = directory
        self.ttl = timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, key: str) -> Path:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        return self.directory / f'{digest}.json'

    def get_items(self, key: str) -> list[NewsItem] | None:
        path = self._path(key)
        if not path.exists() or self.ttl.total_seconds() <= 0:
            return None
        try:
            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(payload['created_at'])
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc) - created_at > self.ttl:
                return None
            return _NEWS_ITEMS.validate_python(payload['items'])
        except Exception:
            return None

    def set_items(self, key: str, items: list[NewsItem]) -> None:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            'created_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'items': [item.model_dump(mode='json') for item in items],
        }
        self._path(key).write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/formatter.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem

CHINESE_NUMBERS = ['一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']


def format_briefing_text(briefing: Briefing) -> str:
    lines = [f'【早间新闻】 {briefing.solar_date.isoformat()} {briefing.lunar_text}', '']
    for section_index, (section, items) in enumerate(briefing.sections.items(), start=1):
        section_label = CHINESE_NUMBERS[section_index - 1] if section_index <= len(CHINESE_NUMBERS) else str(section_index)
        lines.append(f'{section_label}、{section}')
        if not items:
            lines.append('暂无内容')
        for index, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
            lines.extend(_format_item(index, item))
        lines.append('')
    return '\n'.join(lines).strip() + '\n'


def _format_item(index: int, item: NewsItem) -> list[str]:
    lines = [f'{index}. {item.title}']
    if item.summary:
        lines.append(f'   概要：{item.summary}')
    lines.append(f'   来源：{item.source}')
    if item.url:
        lines.append(f'   链接：{item.url}')
    elif item.image_url:
        lines.append(f'   图片：{item.image_url}')
    return lines

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/service.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from datetime import date

from morningbrief.config import Settings, get_settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import MorningBriefError
from morningbrief.http import build_session
from morningbrief.lunar import get_lunar_date
from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers import NewYorkTimesChineseProvider, NewsProvider, TianApiBulletinProvider
from morningbrief.storage import JsonCache


class BriefingService:
    def __init__(self, settings: Settings | None = None) -> None:
        self.settings = settings or get_settings()
        self.session = build_session(self.settings)
        self.cache = JsonCache(self.settings.cache_dir, self.settings.cache_ttl_seconds)

    def build_providers(self, source_names: Iterable[str], *, nytimes_page: int = 1) -> list[NewsProvider]:
        providers: list[NewsProvider] = []
        for source in source_names:
            normalized = source.strip().lower()
            if normalized == SourceName.TIANAPI.value:
                providers.append(TianApiBulletinProvider(self.settings, self.session))
            elif normalized == SourceName.NYTIMES.value:
                providers.append(NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(self.settings, self.session, page=nytimes_page))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f'Unknown news source: {source}')
        return providers

    def generate(
        self,
        *,
        sources: Iterable[str] = (SourceName.TIANAPI.value, SourceName.NYTIMES.value),
        briefing_date: date | None = None,
        nytimes_page: int = 1,
        fail_soft: bool = True,
    ) -> Briefing:
        lunar = get_lunar_date(briefing_date)
        sections: dict[str, list[NewsItem]] = {}
        for provider in self.build_providers(sources, nytimes_page=nytimes_page):
            cache_key = f'{provider.name}:{briefing_date or date.today()}:{nytimes_page}'
            cached = self.cache.get_items(cache_key)
            if cached is not None:
                sections[provider.section_title] = cached
                continue
            try:
                items = provider.fetch(limit=self.settings.max_items_per_source)
            except MorningBriefError:
                if not fail_soft:
                    raise
                items = []
            self.cache.set_items(cache_key, items)
            sections[provider.section_title] = items
        return Briefing(solar_date=lunar.solar_date, lunar_text=lunar.lunar_text, sections=sections)

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/cli.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Annotated

import typer
from rich.console import Console

from morningbrief.formatter import format_briefing_text
from morningbrief.service import BriefingService

app = typer.Typer(help='Generate Chinese morning news briefings.')
console = Console()


@app.command()
def generate(
    sources: Annotated[str, typer.Option(help='Comma-separated sources: tianapi,nytimes')] = 'tianapi,nytimes',
    nytimes_page: Annotated[int, typer.Option(help='NYTimes Chinese society page number')] = 1,
    output: Annotated[Path | None, typer.Option(help='Write briefing text to a file')] = None,
    json_output: Annotated[bool, typer.Option('--json', help='Print JSON instead of text')] = False,
    strict: Annotated[bool, typer.Option(help='Fail if a provider fails')] = False,
) -> None:
    service = BriefingService()
    briefing = service.generate(
        sources=[source.strip() for source in sources.split(',') if source.strip()],
        nytimes_page=nytimes_page,
        fail_soft=not strict,
    )
    if json_output:
        content = json.dumps(briefing.model_dump(mode='json'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    else:
        content = format_briefing_text(briefing)
    if output:
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
    console.print(content)


@app.command()
def serve(
    host: Annotated[str, typer.Option()] = '127.0.0.1',
    port: Annotated[int, typer.Option()] = 8000,
) -> None:
    import uvicorn

    uvicorn.run('morningbrief.api:app', host=host, port=port, reload=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    app()

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/scheduler.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from morningbrief.formatter import format_briefing_text
from morningbrief.service import BriefingService


def run_daily_file_writer(
    *,
    output_dir: Path,
    hour: int = 7,
    minute: int = 30,
    stop_after_runs: int | None = None,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
) -> None:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    runs = 0
    while stop_after_runs is None or runs < stop_after_runs:
        now = datetime.now()
        target = now.replace(hour=hour, minute=minute, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if target <= now:
            target += timedelta(days=1)
        sleep(max((target - now).total_seconds(), 0))
        service = BriefingService()
        briefing = service.generate()
        path = output_dir / f'{briefing.solar_date.isoformat()}.txt'
        path.write_text(format_briefing_text(briefing), encoding='utf-8')
        runs += 1

# "MorningBriefCN/README.md"
# MorningBriefCN

MorningBriefCN is a Python 3.12 service for generating Chinese daily morning briefings. It combines Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendar information with multiple news providers and exposes the result through a CLI, a small HTTP API, and reusable application services.

The project is designed as a realistic evolution of a small script that fetched TianAPI bulletins, scraped the Chinese New York Times, and formatted a text message.

## Features

- Chinese lunar date conversion using `sxtwl` when available, with a graceful fallback.
- TianAPI bulletin client with validation and retries.
- Chinese New York Times scraper using `requests` and `lxml`.
- Provider abstraction for adding more news sources.
- Deterministic text formatting for messaging apps.
- Optional JSON cache to reduce network calls.
- CLI commands for generating, saving, and serving briefings.
- FastAPI application for production deployment.
- Unit tests with mocked network responses.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev,server]'
```

Generate a briefing:

```bash
morningbrief generate --sources tianapi,nytimes --nytimes-page 1
```

Run the HTTP API:

```bash
morningbrief serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

or:

```bash
uvicorn morningbrief.api:app --reload
```

## Configuration

Configuration can be provided through environment variables:

- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY`: TianAPI key.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_CACHE_DIR`: cache directory, default `.cache/morningbrief`.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`: HTTP timeout.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_USER_AGENT`: scraper user agent.

A `.env` file can also be used when `pydantic-settings` is installed.

## Example output

```text
【早间新闻】 2026-05-29 农历:四月十三

一、国内要闻
1. Example headline
   来源：TianAPI
   链接：https://example.com

二、纽约时报中文网
1. Example NYT headline
   概要：Article summary
   链接：https://cn.nytimes.com/...
```

## Development

```bash
ruff check .
pytest
```

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from morningbrief.exceptions import CalendarError
from morningbrief.models import LunarDate

LUNAR_MONTHS = ['十一', '十二', '正', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']
LUNAR_DAYS = [
    '初一', '初二', '初三', '初四', '初五', '初六', '初七', '初八', '初九', '初十',
    '十一', '十二', '十三', '十四', '十五', '十六', '十七', '十八', '十九', '二十',
    '廿一', '廿二', '廿三', '廿四', '廿五', '廿六', '廿七', '廿八', '廿九', '三十', '卅一',
]


def get_lunar_date(day: date | None = None) -> LunarDate:
    target = day or date.today()
    try:
        import sxtwl  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    except ImportError:
        return LunarDate(solar_date=target, lunar_text='农历:未知', is_leap_month=False)

    try:
        lunar = sxtwl.Lunar()
        lunar_day = lunar.getDayBySolar(target.year, target.month, target.day)
        month = LUNAR_MONTHS[lunar_day.Lmc]
        day_text = LUNAR_DAYS[lunar_day.Ldi]
        leap_prefix = '闰' if bool(lunar_day.Lleap) else ''
        return LunarDate(
            solar_date=target,
            lunar_text=f'农历:{leap_prefix}{month}月{day_text}',
            is_leap_month=bool(lunar_day.Lleap),
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CalendarError(f'Unable to convert solar date {target} to lunar date') from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError


def build_session(settings: Settings) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(
        total=3,
        connect=3,
        read=3,
        backoff_factor=0.3,
        status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
        allowed_methods=frozenset({'GET'}),
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry, pool_connections=8, pool_maxsize=16)
    session.mount('http://', adapter)
    session.mount('https://', adapter)
    session.headers.update({'User-Agent': settings.user_agent})
    return session


def get_json(
    session: requests.Session,
    url: str,
    *,
    timeout: float,
    params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        payload = response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'Invalid JSON response from {url}') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ProviderError(f'Expected object JSON response from {url}')
    return payload


def get_text(session: requests.Session, url: str, *, timeout: float) -> str:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        response.encoding = response.encoding or 'utf-8'
        return response.text
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import requests

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ConfigurationError, ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_json
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class TianApiBulletinProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.TIANAPI.value
    section_title = '国内要闻'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        if not self.settings.tianapi_key:
            raise ConfigurationError('MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY is required for TianAPI provider')
        payload = get_json(
            self.session,
            str(self.settings.tianapi_endpoint),
            timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds,
            params={'key': self.settings.tianapi_key},
        )
        code = payload.get('code')
        if code not in (200, '200', None):
            raise ProviderError(f'TianAPI returned non-success code: {code}; message={payload.get("msg")}')
        raw_items = payload.get('newslist', [])
        if not isinstance(raw_items, list):
            raise ProviderError('TianAPI response field newslist must be a list')
        return [self._parse_item(item) for item in raw_items[:limit] if isinstance(item, dict)]

    def _parse_item(self, item: dict[str, Any]) -> NewsItem:
        url = item.get('url') or item.get('link') or None
        image_url = item.get('imgsrc') or item.get('picUrl') or None
        return NewsItem(
            title=str(item.get('title') or '').strip(),
            source=SourceName.TIANAPI,
            summary=item.get('digest') or item.get('description'),
            url=url,
            image_url=image_url,
            metadata={'raw_source': 'tianapi'},
        )

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/providers/nytimes.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from urllib.parse import urljoin

import requests
from lxml import etree, html

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_text
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.NYTIMES.value
    section_title = '纽约时报中文网'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session, *, page: int = 1) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session
        self.page = max(page, 1)

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        url = f'{str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url).rstrip("/")}/society/{self.page}/'
        document_text = get_text(self.session, url, timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds)
        try:
            tree = html.fromstring(document_text)
        except etree.ParserError as exc:
            raise ProviderError('Unable to parse New York Times Chinese HTML') from exc
        articles = tree.xpath('//*[@id="sectionWrapper"]/div[1]/div/div/ul/li')
        if not articles:
            articles = tree.xpath('//article|//li[.//h3]')
        items: list[NewsItem] = []
        for article in articles:
            title_nodes = article.xpath('.//h3/a|.//h2/a|.//a[contains(@class, "headline")]')
            if not title_nodes:
                continue
            title = self._text(title_nodes[0])
            if not title:
                continue
            summary_nodes = article.xpath('.//p')
            href = title_nodes[0].get('href')
            items.append(
                NewsItem(
                    title=title,
                    source=SourceName.NYTIMES,
                    summary=self._text(summary_nodes[0]) if summary_nodes else None,
                    url=urljoin(str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url), href) if href else None,
                    metadata={'page': self.page},
                )
            )
            if len(items) >= limit:
                break
        return items

    @staticmethod
    def _text(node: object) -> str:
        if hasattr(node, 'text_content'):
            return ' '.join(node.text_content().split())
        return ''

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from morningbrief.models import NewsItem

_NEWS_ITEMS = TypeAdapter(list[NewsItem])


class JsonCache:
    def __init__(self, directory: Path, ttl_seconds: int) -> None:
        self.directory = directory
        self.ttl = timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, key: str) -> Path:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        return self.directory / f'{digest}.json'

    def get_items(self, key: str) -> list[NewsItem] | None:
        path = self._path(key)
        if not path.exists() or self.ttl.total_seconds() <= 0:
            return None
        try:
            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(payload['created_at'])
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc) - created_at > self.ttl:
                return None
            return _NEWS_ITEMS.validate_python(payload['items'])
        except Exception:
            return None

    def set_items(self, key: str, items: list[NewsItem]) -> None:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            'created_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'items': [item.model_dump(mode='json') for item in items],
        }
        self._path(key).write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/formatter.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem

CHINESE_NUMBERS = ['一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']


def format_briefing_text(briefing: Briefing) -> str:
    lines = [f'【早间新闻】 {briefing.solar_date.isoformat()} {briefing.lunar_text}', '']
    for section_index, (section, items) in enumerate(briefing.sections.items(), start=1):
        section_label = CHINESE_NUMBERS[section_index - 1] if section_index <= len(CHINESE_NUMBERS) else str(section_index)
        lines.append(f'{section_label}、{section}')
        if not items:
            lines.append('暂无内容')
        for index, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
            lines.extend(_format_item(index, item))
        lines.append('')
    return '\n'.join(lines).strip() + '\n'


def _format_item(index: int, item: NewsItem) -> list[str]:
    lines = [f'{index}. {item.title}']
    if item.summary:
        lines.append(f'   概要：{item.summary}')
    lines.append(f'   来源：{item.source}')
    if item.url:
        lines.append(f'   链接：{item.url}')
    elif item.image_url:
        lines.append(f'   图片：{item.image_url}')
    return lines

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/service.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from datetime import date

from morningbrief.config import Settings, get_settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import MorningBriefError
from morningbrief.http import build_session
from morningbrief.lunar import get_lunar_date
from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers import NewYorkTimesChineseProvider, NewsProvider, TianApiBulletinProvider
from morningbrief.storage import JsonCache


class BriefingService:
    def __init__(self, settings: Settings | None = None) -> None:
        self.settings = settings or get_settings()
        self.session = build_session(self.settings)
        self.cache = JsonCache(self.settings.cache_dir, self.settings.cache_ttl_seconds)

    def build_providers(self, source_names: Iterable[str], *, nytimes_page: int = 1) -> list[NewsProvider]:
        providers: list[NewsProvider] = []
        for source in source_names:
            normalized = source.strip().lower()
            if normalized == SourceName.TIANAPI.value:
                providers.append(TianApiBulletinProvider(self.settings, self.session))
            elif normalized == SourceName.NYTIMES.value:
                providers.append(NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(self.settings, self.session, page=nytimes_page))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f'Unknown news source: {source}')
        return providers

    def generate(
        self,
        *,
        sources: Iterable[str] = (SourceName.TIANAPI.value, SourceName.NYTIMES.value),
        briefing_date: date | None = None,
        nytimes_page: int = 1,
        fail_soft: bool = True,
    ) -> Briefing:
        lunar = get_lunar_date(briefing_date)
        sections: dict[str, list[NewsItem]] = {}
        for provider in self.build_providers(sources, nytimes_page=nytimes_page):
            cache_key = f'{provider.name}:{briefing_date or date.today()}:{nytimes_page}'
            cached = self.cache.get_items(cache_key)
            if cached is not None:
                sections[provider.section_title] = cached
                continue
            try:
                items = provider.fetch(limit=self.settings.max_items_per_source)
            except MorningBriefError:
                if not fail_soft:
                    raise
                items = []
            self.cache.set_items(cache_key, items)
            sections[provider.section_title] = items
        return Briefing(solar_date=lunar.solar_date, lunar_text=lunar.lunar_text, sections=sections)

def generate(

    nytimes_page: Annotated[int, typer.Option(help='NYTimes Chinese society page number')] = 1,
    output: Annotated[Path | None, typer.Option(help='Write briefing text to a file')] = None,
    json_output: Annotated[bool, typer.Option('--json', help='Print JSON instead of text')] = False,
    strict: Annotated[bool, typer.Option(help='Fail if a provider fails')] = False,
) -> None:

        sources=[source.strip() for source in sources.split(',') if source.strip()],
        nytimes_page=nytimes_page,
        fail_soft=not strict,
    )
    if json_output:
        content = json.dumps(briefing.model_dump(mode='json'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    host: Annotated[str, typer.Option()] = '127.0.0.1',
    port: Annotated[int, typer.Option()] = 8000,
) -> None:

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from morningbrief.formatter import format_briefing_text
from morningbrief.service import BriefingService


def run_daily_file_writer(
    *,
    output_dir: Path,
    hour: int = 7,
    minute: int = 30,
    stop_after_runs: int | None = None,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
) -> None:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    runs = 0
    while stop_after_runs is None or runs < stop_after_runs:
        now = datetime.now()
        target = now.replace(hour=hour, minute=minute, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if target <= now:
            target += timedelta(days=1)
        sleep(max((target - now).total_seconds(), 0))
        service = BriefingService()
        briefing = service.generate()
        path = output_dir / f'{briefing.solar_date.isoformat()}.txt'
        path.write_text(format_briefing_text(briefing), encoding='utf-8')
        runs += 1

# "MorningBriefCN/README.md"
# MorningBriefCN

MorningBriefCN is a Python 3.12 service for generating Chinese daily morning briefings. It combines Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendar information with multiple news providers and exposes the result through a CLI, a small HTTP API, and reusable application services.

The project is designed as a realistic evolution of a small script that fetched TianAPI bulletins, scraped the Chinese New York Times, and formatted a text message.

## Features

- Chinese lunar date conversion using `sxtwl` when available, with a graceful fallback.
- TianAPI bulletin client with validation and retries.
- Chinese New York Times scraper using `requests` and `lxml`.
- Provider abstraction for adding more news sources.
- Deterministic text formatting for messaging apps.
- Optional JSON cache to reduce network calls.
- CLI commands for generating, saving, and serving briefings.
- FastAPI application for production deployment.
- Unit tests with mocked network responses.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev,server]'
```

Generate a briefing:

```bash
morningbrief generate --sources tianapi,nytimes --nytimes-page 1
```

Run the HTTP API:

```bash
morningbrief serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

or:

```bash
uvicorn morningbrief.api:app --reload
```

## Configuration

Configuration can be provided through environment variables:

- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY`: TianAPI key.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_CACHE_DIR`: cache directory, default `.cache/morningbrief`.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`: HTTP timeout.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_USER_AGENT`: scraper user agent.

A `.env` file can also be used when `pydantic-settings` is installed.

## Example output

```text
【早间新闻】 2026-05-29 农历:四月十三

一、国内要闻
1. Example headline
   来源：TianAPI
   链接：https://example.com

二、纽约时报中文网
1. Example NYT headline
   概要：Article summary
   链接：https://cn.nytimes.com/...
```

## Development

```bash
ruff check .
pytest
```

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from morningbrief.exceptions import CalendarError
from morningbrief.models import LunarDate

LUNAR_MONTHS = ['十一', '十二', '正', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']
LUNAR_DAYS = [
    '初一', '初二', '初三', '初四', '初五', '初六', '初七', '初八', '初九', '初十',
    '十一', '十二', '十三', '十四', '十五', '十六', '十七', '十八', '十九', '二十',
    '廿一', '廿二', '廿三', '廿四', '廿五', '廿六', '廿七', '廿八', '廿九', '三十', '卅一',
]


def get_lunar_date(day: date | None = None) -> LunarDate:
    target = day or date.today()
    try:
        import sxtwl  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    except ImportError:
        return LunarDate(solar_date=target, lunar_text='农历:未知', is_leap_month=False)

    try:
        lunar = sxtwl.Lunar()
        lunar_day = lunar.getDayBySolar(target.year, target.month, target.day)
        month = LUNAR_MONTHS[lunar_day.Lmc]
        day_text = LUNAR_DAYS[lunar_day.Ldi]
        leap_prefix = '闰' if bool(lunar_day.Lleap) else ''
        return LunarDate(
            solar_date=target,
            lunar_text=f'农历:{leap_prefix}{month}月{day_text}',
            is_leap_month=bool(lunar_day.Lleap),
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CalendarError(f'Unable to convert solar date {target} to lunar date') from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError


def build_session(settings: Settings) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(
        total=3,
        connect=3,
        read=3,
        backoff_factor=0.3,
        status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
        allowed_methods=frozenset({'GET'}),
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry, pool_connections=8, pool_maxsize=16)
    session.mount('http://', adapter)
    session.mount('https://', adapter)
    session.headers.update({'User-Agent': settings.user_agent})
    return session


def get_json(
    session: requests.Session,
    url: str,
    *,
    timeout: float,
    params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        payload = response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'Invalid JSON response from {url}') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ProviderError(f'Expected object JSON response from {url}')
    return payload


def get_text(session: requests.Session, url: str, *, timeout: float) -> str:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        response.encoding = response.encoding or 'utf-8'
        return response.text
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/providers/tianapi.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import requests

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ConfigurationError, ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_json
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class TianApiBulletinProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.TIANAPI.value
    section_title = '国内要闻'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        if not self.settings.tianapi_key:
            raise ConfigurationError('MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY is required for TianAPI provider')
        payload = get_json(
            self.session,
            str(self.settings.tianapi_endpoint),
            timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds,
            params={'key': self.settings.tianapi_key},
        )
        code = payload.get('code')
        if code not in (200, '200', None):
            raise ProviderError(f'TianAPI returned non-success code: {code}; message={payload.get("msg")}')
        raw_items = payload.get('newslist', [])
        if not isinstance(raw_items, list):
            raise ProviderError('TianAPI response field newslist must be a list')
        return [self._parse_item(item) for item in raw_items[:limit] if isinstance(item, dict)]

    def _parse_item(self, item: dict[str, Any]) -> NewsItem:
        url = item.get('url') or item.get('link') or None
        image_url = item.get('imgsrc') or item.get('picUrl') or None
        return NewsItem(
            title=str(item.get('title') or '').strip(),
            source=SourceName.TIANAPI,
            summary=item.get('digest') or item.get('description'),
            url=url,
            image_url=image_url,
            metadata={'raw_source': 'tianapi'},
        )
