from __future__ import annotations

from urllib.parse import urljoin

import requests
from lxml import etree, html

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_text
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.NYTIMES.value
    section_title = '纽约时报中文网'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session, *, page: int = 1) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session
        self.page = max(page, 1)

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        url = f'{str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url).rstrip("/")}/society/{self.page}/'
        document_text = get_text(self.session, url, timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds)
        try:
            tree = html.fromstring(document_text)
        except etree.ParserError as exc:
            raise ProviderError('Unable to parse New York Times Chinese HTML') from exc
        articles = tree.xpath('//*[@id="sectionWrapper"]/div[1]/div/div/ul/li')
        if not articles:
            articles = tree.xpath('//article|//li[.//h3]')
        items: list[NewsItem] = []
        for article in articles:
            title_nodes = article.xpath('.//h3/a|.//h2/a|.//a[contains(@class, "headline")]')
            if not title_nodes:
                continue
            title = self._text(title_nodes[0])
            if not title:
                continue
            summary_nodes = article.xpath('.//p')
            href = title_nodes[0].get('href')
            items.append(
                NewsItem(
                    title=title,
                    source=SourceName.NYTIMES,
                    summary=self._text(summary_nodes[0]) if summary_nodes else None,
                    url=urljoin(str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url), href) if href else None,
                    metadata={'page': self.page},
                )
            )
            if len(items) >= limit:
                break
        return items

    @staticmethod
    def _text(node: object) -> str:
        if hasattr(node, 'text_content'):
            return ' '.join(node.text_content().split())
        return ''

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/storage.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from morningbrief.models import NewsItem

_NEWS_ITEMS = TypeAdapter(list[NewsItem])


class JsonCache:
    def __init__(self, directory: Path, ttl_seconds: int) -> None:
        self.directory = directory
        self.ttl = timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, key: str) -> Path:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        return self.directory / f'{digest}.json'

    def get_items(self, key: str) -> list[NewsItem] | None:
        path = self._path(key)
        if not path.exists() or self.ttl.total_seconds() <= 0:
            return None
        try:
            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(payload['created_at'])
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc) - created_at > self.ttl:
                return None
            return _NEWS_ITEMS.validate_python(payload['items'])
        except Exception:
            return None

    def set_items(self, key: str, items: list[NewsItem]) -> None:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            'created_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'items': [item.model_dump(mode='json') for item in items],
        }
        self._path(key).write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/formatter.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem

CHINESE_NUMBERS = ['一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']


def format_briefing_text(briefing: Briefing) -> str:
    lines = [f'【早间新闻】 {briefing.solar_date.isoformat()} {briefing.lunar_text}', '']
    for section_index, (section, items) in enumerate(briefing.sections.items(), start=1):
        section_label = CHINESE_NUMBERS[section_index - 1] if section_index <= len(CHINESE_NUMBERS) else str(section_index)
        lines.append(f'{section_label}、{section}')
        if not items:
            lines.append('暂无内容')
        for index, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
            lines.extend(_format_item(index, item))
        lines.append('')
    return '\n'.join(lines).strip() + '\n'


def _format_item(index: int, item: NewsItem) -> list[str]:
    lines = [f'{index}. {item.title}']
    if item.summary:
        lines.append(f'   概要：{item.summary}')
    lines.append(f'   来源：{item.source}')
    if item.url:
        lines.append(f'   链接：{item.url}')
    elif item.image_url:
        lines.append(f'   图片：{item.image_url}')
    return lines

from collections.abc import Iterable
from datetime import date

from morningbrief.config import Settings, get_settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import MorningBriefError
from morningbrief.http import build_session
from morningbrief.lunar import get_lunar_date
from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers import NewYorkTimesChineseProvider, NewsProvider, TianApiBulletinProvider
from morningbrief.storage import JsonCache


class BriefingService:
    def __init__(self, settings: Settings | None = None) -> None:
        self.settings = settings or get_settings()
        self.session = build_session(self.settings)
        self.cache = JsonCache(self.settings.cache_dir, self.settings.cache_ttl_seconds)

    def build_providers(self, source_names: Iterable[str], *, nytimes_page: int = 1) -> list[NewsProvider]:
        providers: list[NewsProvider] = []
        for source in source_names:
            normalized = source.strip().lower()
            if normalized == SourceName.TIANAPI.value:
                providers.append(TianApiBulletinProvider(self.settings, self.session))
            elif normalized == SourceName.NYTIMES.value:
                providers.append(NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(self.settings, self.session, page=nytimes_page))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f'Unknown news source: {source}')
        return providers

    def generate(
        self,
        *,
        sources: Iterable[str] = (SourceName.TIANAPI.value, SourceName.NYTIMES.value),
        briefing_date: date | None = None,
        nytimes_page: int = 1,
        fail_soft: bool = True,
    ) -> Briefing:
        lunar = get_lunar_date(briefing_date)
        sections: dict[str, list[NewsItem]] = {}
        for provider in self.build_providers(sources, nytimes_page=nytimes_page):
            cache_key = f'{provider.name}:{briefing_date or date.today()}:{nytimes_page}'
            cached = self.cache.get_items(cache_key)
            if cached is not None:
                sections[provider.section_title] = cached
                continue
            try:
                items = provider.fetch(limit=self.settings.max_items_per_source)
            except MorningBriefError:
                if not fail_soft:
                    raise
                items = []
            self.cache.set_items(cache_key, items)
            sections[provider.section_title] = items
        return Briefing(solar_date=lunar.solar_date, lunar_text=lunar.lunar_text, sections=sections)

@app.command()
def generate(
    sources: Annotated[str, typer.Option(help='Comma-separated sources: tianapi,nytimes')] = 'tianapi,nytimes',
    nytimes_page: Annotated[int, typer.Option(help='NYTimes Chinese society page number')] = 1,
    output: Annotated[Path | None, typer.Option(help='Write briefing text to a file')] = None,
    json_output: Annotated[bool, typer.Option('--json', help='Print JSON instead of text')] = False,
    strict: Annotated[bool, typer.Option(help='Fail if a provider fails')] = False,
) -> None:

    briefing = service.generate(
        sources=[source.strip() for source in sources.split(',') if source.strip()],
        nytimes_page=nytimes_page,
        fail_soft=not strict,
    )
    if json_output:
        content = json.dumps(briefing.model_dump(mode='json'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from morningbrief.formatter import format_briefing_text
from morningbrief.service import BriefingService


def run_daily_file_writer(
    *,
    output_dir: Path,
    hour: int = 7,
    minute: int = 30,
    stop_after_runs: int | None = None,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
) -> None:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    runs = 0
    while stop_after_runs is None or runs < stop_after_runs:
        now = datetime.now()
        target = now.replace(hour=hour, minute=minute, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if target <= now:
            target += timedelta(days=1)
        sleep(max((target - now).total_seconds(), 0))
        service = BriefingService()
        briefing = service.generate()
        path = output_dir / f'{briefing.solar_date.isoformat()}.txt'
        path.write_text(format_briefing_text(briefing), encoding='utf-8')
        runs += 1

# "MorningBriefCN/README.md"
# MorningBriefCN

MorningBriefCN is a Python 3.12 service for generating Chinese daily morning briefings. It combines Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendar information with multiple news providers and exposes the result through a CLI, a small HTTP API, and reusable application services.

The project is designed as a realistic evolution of a small script that fetched TianAPI bulletins, scraped the Chinese New York Times, and formatted a text message.

## Features

- Chinese lunar date conversion using `sxtwl` when available, with a graceful fallback.
- TianAPI bulletin client with validation and retries.
- Chinese New York Times scraper using `requests` and `lxml`.
- Provider abstraction for adding more news sources.
- Deterministic text formatting for messaging apps.
- Optional JSON cache to reduce network calls.
- CLI commands for generating, saving, and serving briefings.
- FastAPI application for production deployment.
- Unit tests with mocked network responses.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev,server]'
```

Generate a briefing:

```bash
morningbrief generate --sources tianapi,nytimes --nytimes-page 1
```

Run the HTTP API:

```bash
morningbrief serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

or:

```bash
uvicorn morningbrief.api:app --reload
```

## Configuration

Configuration can be provided through environment variables:

- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY`: TianAPI key.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_CACHE_DIR`: cache directory, default `.cache/morningbrief`.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`: HTTP timeout.
- `MORNINGBRIEF_USER_AGENT`: scraper user agent.

A `.env` file can also be used when `pydantic-settings` is installed.

## Example output

```text
【早间新闻】 2026-05-29 农历:四月十三

一、国内要闻
1. Example headline
   来源：TianAPI
   链接：https://example.com

二、纽约时报中文网
1. Example NYT headline
   概要：Article summary
   链接：https://cn.nytimes.com/...
```

## Development

```bash
ruff check .
pytest
```

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from morningbrief.exceptions import CalendarError
from morningbrief.models import LunarDate

LUNAR_MONTHS = ['十一', '十二', '正', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']
LUNAR_DAYS = [
    '初一', '初二', '初三', '初四', '初五', '初六', '初七', '初八', '初九', '初十',
    '十一', '十二', '十三', '十四', '十五', '十六', '十七', '十八', '十九', '二十',
    '廿一', '廿二', '廿三', '廿四', '廿五', '廿六', '廿七', '廿八', '廿九', '三十', '卅一',
]


def get_lunar_date(day: date | None = None) -> LunarDate:
    target = day or date.today()
    try:
        import sxtwl  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    except ImportError:
        return LunarDate(solar_date=target, lunar_text='农历:未知', is_leap_month=False)

    try:
        lunar = sxtwl.Lunar()
        lunar_day = lunar.getDayBySolar(target.year, target.month, target.day)
        month = LUNAR_MONTHS[lunar_day.Lmc]
        day_text = LUNAR_DAYS[lunar_day.Ldi]
        leap_prefix = '闰' if bool(lunar_day.Lleap) else ''
        return LunarDate(
            solar_date=target,
            lunar_text=f'农历:{leap_prefix}{month}月{day_text}',
            is_leap_month=bool(lunar_day.Lleap),
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CalendarError(f'Unable to convert solar date {target} to lunar date') from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError


def build_session(settings: Settings) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(
        total=3,
        connect=3,
        read=3,
        backoff_factor=0.3,
        status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
        allowed_methods=frozenset({'GET'}),
    )
    adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry, pool_connections=8, pool_maxsize=16)
    session.mount('http://', adapter)
    session.mount('https://', adapter)
    session.headers.update({'User-Agent': settings.user_agent})
    return session


def get_json(
    session: requests.Session,
    url: str,
    *,
    timeout: float,
    params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        payload = response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'Invalid JSON response from {url}') from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ProviderError(f'Expected object JSON response from {url}')
    return payload


def get_text(session: requests.Session, url: str, *, timeout: float) -> str:
    try:
        response = session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
        response.raise_for_status()
        response.encoding = response.encoding or 'utf-8'
        return response.text
    except requests.RequestException as exc:
        raise ProviderError(f'HTTP request failed for {url}: {exc}') from exc

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/providers/tianapi.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import requests

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ConfigurationError, ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_json
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class TianApiBulletinProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.TIANAPI.value
    section_title = '国内要闻'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        if not self.settings.tianapi_key:
            raise ConfigurationError('MORNINGBRIEF_TIANAPI_KEY is required for TianAPI provider')
        payload = get_json(
            self.session,
            str(self.settings.tianapi_endpoint),
            timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds,
            params={'key': self.settings.tianapi_key},
        )
        code = payload.get('code')
        if code not in (200, '200', None):
            raise ProviderError(f'TianAPI returned non-success code: {code}; message={payload.get("msg")}')
        raw_items = payload.get('newslist', [])
        if not isinstance(raw_items, list):
            raise ProviderError('TianAPI response field newslist must be a list')
        return [self._parse_item(item) for item in raw_items[:limit] if isinstance(item, dict)]

    def _parse_item(self, item: dict[str, Any]) -> NewsItem:
        url = item.get('url') or item.get('link') or None
        image_url = item.get('imgsrc') or item.get('picUrl') or None
        return NewsItem(
            title=str(item.get('title') or '').strip(),
            source=SourceName.TIANAPI,
            summary=item.get('digest') or item.get('description'),
            url=url,
            image_url=image_url,
            metadata={'raw_source': 'tianapi'},
        )

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/providers/nytimes.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from urllib.parse import urljoin

import requests
from lxml import etree, html

from morningbrief.config import Settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import ProviderError
from morningbrief.http import get_text
from morningbrief.models import NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers.base import NewsProvider


class NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(NewsProvider):
    name = SourceName.NYTIMES.value
    section_title = '纽约时报中文网'

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, session: requests.Session, *, page: int = 1) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.session = session
        self.page = max(page, 1)

    def fetch(self, *, limit: int) -> list[NewsItem]:
        url = f'{str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url).rstrip("/")}/society/{self.page}/'
        document_text = get_text(self.session, url, timeout=self.settings.timeout_seconds)
        try:
            tree = html.fromstring(document_text)
        except etree.ParserError as exc:
            raise ProviderError('Unable to parse New York Times Chinese HTML') from exc
        articles = tree.xpath('//*[@id="sectionWrapper"]/div[1]/div/div/ul/li')
        if not articles:
            articles = tree.xpath('//article|//li[.//h3]')
        items: list[NewsItem] = []
        for article in articles:
            title_nodes = article.xpath('.//h3/a|.//h2/a|.//a[contains(@class, "headline")]')
            if not title_nodes:
                continue
            title = self._text(title_nodes[0])
            if not title:
                continue
            summary_nodes = article.xpath('.//p')
            href = title_nodes[0].get('href')
            items.append(
                NewsItem(
                    title=title,
                    source=SourceName.NYTIMES,
                    summary=self._text(summary_nodes[0]) if summary_nodes else None,
                    url=urljoin(str(self.settings.nytimes_base_url), href) if href else None,
                    metadata={'page': self.page},
                )
            )
            if len(items) >= limit:
                break
        return items

    @staticmethod
    def _text(node: object) -> str:
        if hasattr(node, 'text_content'):
            return ' '.join(node.text_content().split())
        return ''

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from morningbrief.models import NewsItem

_NEWS_ITEMS = TypeAdapter(list[NewsItem])


class JsonCache:
    def __init__(self, directory: Path, ttl_seconds: int) -> None:
        self.directory = directory
        self.ttl = timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, key: str) -> Path:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        return self.directory / f'{digest}.json'

    def get_items(self, key: str) -> list[NewsItem] | None:
        path = self._path(key)
        if not path.exists() or self.ttl.total_seconds() <= 0:
            return None
        try:
            payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(payload['created_at'])
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc) - created_at > self.ttl:
                return None
            return _NEWS_ITEMS.validate_python(payload['items'])
        except Exception:
            return None

    def set_items(self, key: str, items: list[NewsItem]) -> None:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            'created_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'items': [item.model_dump(mode='json') for item in items],
        }
        self._path(key).write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')

# "MorningBriefCN/src/morningbrief/formatter.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem

CHINESE_NUMBERS = ['一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六', '七', '八', '九', '十']


def format_briefing_text(briefing: Briefing) -> str:
    lines = [f'【早间新闻】 {briefing.solar_date.isoformat()} {briefing.lunar_text}', '']
    for section_index, (section, items) in enumerate(briefing.sections.items(), start=1):
        section_label = CHINESE_NUMBERS[section_index - 1] if section_index <= len(CHINESE_NUMBERS) else str(section_index)
        lines.append(f'{section_label}、{section}')
        if not items:
            lines.append('暂无内容')
        for index, item in enumerate(items, start=1):
            lines.extend(_format_item(index, item))
        lines.append('')
    return '\n'.join(lines).strip() + '\n'


def _format_item(index: int, item: NewsItem) -> list[str]:
    lines = [f'{index}. {item.title}']
    if item.summary:
        lines.append(f'   概要：{item.summary}')
    lines.append(f'   来源：{item.source}')
    if item.url:
        lines.append(f'   链接：{item.url}')
    elif item.image_url:
        lines.append(f'   图片：{item.image_url}')
    return lines

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from datetime import date

from morningbrief.config import Settings, get_settings
from morningbrief.exceptions import MorningBriefError
from morningbrief.http import build_session
from morningbrief.lunar import get_lunar_date
from morningbrief.models import Briefing, NewsItem, SourceName
from morningbrief.providers import NewYorkTimesChineseProvider, NewsProvider, TianApiBulletinProvider
from morningbrief.storage import JsonCache


class BriefingService:
    def __init__(self, settings: Settings | None = None) -> None:
        self.settings = settings or get_settings()
        self.session = build_session(self.settings)
        self.cache = JsonCache(self.settings.cache_dir, self.settings.cache_ttl_seconds)

    def build_providers(self, source_names: Iterable[str], *, nytimes_page: int = 1) -> list[NewsProvider]:
        providers: list[NewsProvider] = []
        for source in source_names:
            normalized = source.strip().lower()
            if normalized == SourceName.TIANAPI.value:
                providers.append(TianApiBulletinProvider(self.settings, self.session))
            elif normalized == SourceName.NYTIMES.value:
                providers.append(NewYorkTimesChineseProvider(self.settings, self.session, page=nytimes_page))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f'Unknown news source: {source}')
        return providers

    def generate(
        self,
        *,
        sources: Iterable[str] = (SourceName.TIANAPI.value, SourceName.NYTIMES.value),
        briefing_date: date | None = None,
        nytimes_page: int = 1,
        fail_soft: bool = True,
    ) -> Briefing:
        lunar = get_lunar_date(briefing_date)
        sections: dict[str, list[NewsItem]] = {}
        for provider in self.build_providers(sources, nytimes_page=nytimes_page):
            cache_key = f'{provider.name}:{briefing_date or date.today()}:{nytimes_page}'
            cached = self.cache.get_items(cache_key)
            if cached is not None:
                sections[provider.section_title] = cached
                continue
            try:
                items = provider.fetch(limit=self.settings.max_items_per_source)
            except MorningBriefError:
                if not fail_soft:
                    raise
                items = []
            self.cache.set_items(cache_key, items)
            sections[provider.section_title] = items
        return Briefing(solar_date=lunar.solar_date, lunar_text=lunar.lunar_text, sections=sections)

    output: Annotated[Path | None, typer.Option(help='Write briefing text to a file')] = None,
    json_output: Annotated[bool, typer.Option('--json', help='Print JSON instead of text')] = False,

) -> None:

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from morningbrief.formatter import format_briefing_text
from morningbrief.service import BriefingService


def run_daily_file_writer(
    *,
    output_dir: Path,
    hour: int = 7,
    minute: int = 30,
    stop_after_runs: int | None = None,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
) -> None:
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    runs = 0
    while stop_after_runs is None or runs < stop_after_runs:
        now = datetime.now()
        target = now.replace(hour=hour, minute=minute, second=0, microsecond=0)
        if target <= now:
            target += timedelta(days=1)
        sleep(max((target - now).total_seconds(), 0))
        service = BriefingService()
        briefing = service.generate()
        path = output_dir / f'{briefing.solar_date.isoformat()}.txt'
        path.write_text(format_briefing_text(briefing), encoding='utf-8')
        runs += 1

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/README.md"
# TensorFlow Optimizer Lab

TensorFlow Optimizer Lab is a compact research and production codebase for studying classic TensorFlow optimizers under a consistent graph-mode training pipeline. It modernizes TensorFlow 1.x ideas such as `tf.train.GradientDescentOptimizer`, placeholders, sessions, trainable variables, and checkpoints through `tf.compat.v1` while remaining installable on current Python and TensorFlow versions.

The project supports synthetic classification data and MNIST, configurable multilayer perceptrons, local JSONL experiment tracking, TensorBoard summaries, checkpointing, evaluation, batch prediction, and an optional FastAPI serving endpoint.

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

`python -m pip install -e .[dev]`

Train a synthetic experiment:

`tf-optimizer-lab train --config configs/default_synthetic.json`

Evaluate a saved run:

`tf-optimizer-lab evaluate --config configs/default_synthetic.json --checkpoint-dir runs/synthetic_adam/checkpoints`

Serve predictions:

`tf-optimizer-lab serve --config configs/default_synthetic.json --checkpoint-dir runs/synthetic_adam/checkpoints --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`

## Optimizers

Supported optimizer names are `sgd`, `adagrad`, `momentum`, `adam`, `proximal_gradient_descent`, `proximal_adagrad`, and `rmsprop`. They map to TensorFlow graph optimizers under `tf.compat.v1.train`.

## Configuration

Experiments are JSON files with sections for data, model, optimizer, and training. A run directory contains the copied configuration, checkpoints, TensorBoard summaries, metrics, and a JSONL event stream suitable for downstream analysis.

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import json


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DataConfig:
    name: str = 'synthetic'
    num_samples: int = 5000
    num_features: int = 32
    num_classes: int = 4
    validation_fraction: float = 0.15
    test_fraction: float = 0.15
    noise: float = 0.45


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelConfig:
    hidden_units: list[int] = field(default_factory=lambda: [128, 64])
    activation: str = 'relu'
    dropout_rate: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class OptimizerConfig:
    name: str = 'adam'
    learning_rate: float = 0.001
    momentum: float = 0.9
    rho: float = 0.9
    epsilon: float = 1e-7
    l1_regularization_strength: float = 0.0
    l2_regularization_strength: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrainingConfig:
    epochs: int = 10
    batch_size: int = 64
    eval_every_steps: int = 100
    checkpoint_every_steps: int = 500
    max_checkpoints: int = 5
    early_stopping_patience: int = 10


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExperimentConfig:
    experiment_name: str = 'optimizer_experiment'
    seed: int = 1337
    run_root: str = 'runs'
    data: DataConfig = field(default_factory=DataConfig)
    model: ModelConfig = field(default_factory=ModelConfig)
    optimizer: OptimizerConfig = field(default_factory=OptimizerConfig)
    training: TrainingConfig = field(default_factory=TrainingConfig)

    @property
    def run_dir(self) -> Path:
        return Path(self.run_root) / self.experiment_name

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    def save(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        target = Path(path)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding='utf-8')


def _section(data: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = data.get(key, {})
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f'Configuration section {key} must be an object')
    return value


def load_config(path: str | Path) -> ExperimentConfig:
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Config file not found: {config_path}')
    raw = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ValueError('Configuration root must be a JSON object')
    return ExperimentConfig(
        experiment_name=str(raw.get('experiment_name', 'optimizer_experiment')),
        seed=int(raw.get('seed', 1337)),
        run_root=str(raw.get('run_root', 'runs')),
        data=DataConfig(**_section(raw, 'data')),
        model=ModelConfig(**_section(raw, 'model')),
        optimizer=OptimizerConfig(**_section(raw, 'optimizer')),
        training=TrainingConfig(**_section(raw, 'training')),
    )

        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.shuffle = shuffle
        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]:
        indices = np.arange(self.dataset.num_examples)
        if self.shuffle:
            self.rng.shuffle(indices)
        for start in range(0, self.dataset.num_examples, self.batch_size):
            batch_idx = indices[start:start + self.batch_size]
            yield self.dataset.x[batch_idx], self.dataset.y[batch_idx]


def one_hot(labels: np.ndarray, num_classes: int) -> np.ndarray:
    result = np.zeros((labels.shape[0], num_classes), dtype=np.float32)
    result[np.arange(labels.shape[0]), labels.astype(np.int64)] = 1.0
    return result


def _split(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    order = np.arange(x.shape[0])
    rng.shuffle(order)
    x = x[order].astype(np.float32)
    y = y[order].astype(np.float32)
    n = x.shape[0]
    n_test = int(n * cfg.test_fraction)
    n_val = int(n * cfg.validation_fraction)
    test = ArrayDataset(x[:n_test], y[:n_test]) if n_test else ArrayDataset(x[:0], y[:0])
    val = ArrayDataset(x[n_test:n_test + n_val], y[n_test:n_test + n_val])
    train = ArrayDataset(x[n_test + n_val:], y[n_test + n_val:])
    return DatasetBundle(train=train, validation=val, test=test, num_features=x.shape[1], num_classes=y.shape[1])


def load_synthetic(cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    labels = rng.integers(0, cfg.num_classes, size=cfg.num_samples)
    prototypes = rng.normal(0.0, 2.0, size=(cfg.num_classes, cfg.num_features))
    x = prototypes[labels] + rng.normal(0.0, cfg.noise, size=(cfg.num_samples, cfg.num_features))
    scale = np.maximum(x.std(axis=0, keepdims=True), 1e-6)
    x = (x - x.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)) / scale
    return _split(x.astype(np.float32), one_hot(labels, cfg.num_classes), cfg, seed)


def load_mnist(cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    (x_train, y_train), (x_test, y_test) = tf.keras.datasets.mnist.load_data()
    x_train = x_train.reshape(x_train.shape[0], -1).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
    x_test = x_test.reshape(x_test.shape[0], -1).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
    y_train = one_hot(y_train, 10)
    y_test = one_hot(y_test, 10)
    train_bundle = _split(x_train, y_train, cfg, seed)
    test = ArrayDataset(x_test, y_test)
    return DatasetBundle(
        train=train_bundle.train,
        validation=train_bundle.validation,
        test=test,
        num_features=784,
        num_classes=10,
    )


def load_dataset(cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    if cfg.name == 'synthetic':
        return load_synthetic(cfg, seed)
    if cfg.name == 'mnist':
        return load_mnist(cfg, seed)
    raise ValueError(f'Unsupported dataset: {cfg.name}')

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/metrics.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def accuracy_from_logits(logits: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> float:
    if logits.size == 0:
        return 0.0
    pred = np.argmax(logits, axis=1)
    truth = np.argmax(labels, axis=1)
    return float(np.mean(pred == truth))


def cross_entropy_from_logits(logits: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> float:
    if logits.size == 0:
        return 0.0
    shifted = logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    log_probs = shifted - np.log(np.exp(shifted).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    return float(-np.sum(labels * log_probs) / labels.shape[0])


def classification_report_dict(logits: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
    return {
        'accuracy': accuracy_from_logits(logits, labels),
        'cross_entropy': cross_entropy_from_logits(logits, labels),
    }

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/optimizers.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import OptimizerConfig


def create_optimizer(cfg: OptimizerConfig) -> tf.compat.v1.train.Optimizer:
    name = cfg.name.lower().strip()
    if name in {'sgd', 'gradient_descent', 'gradientdescent'}:
        return tf.compat.v1.train.GradientDescentOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate)
    if name == 'adagrad':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.AdagradOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate)
    if name == 'momentum':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.MomentumOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate, momentum=cfg.momentum)
    if name == 'adam':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.AdamOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate, epsilon=cfg.epsilon)
    if name == 'proximal_gradient_descent':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.ProximalGradientDescentOptimizer(
            cfg.learning_rate,
            l1_regularization_strength=cfg.l1_regularization_strength,
            l2_regularization_strength=cfg.l2_regularization_strength,
        )
    if name == 'proximal_adagrad':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.ProximalAdagradOptimizer(
            cfg.learning_rate,
            l1_regularization_strength=cfg.l1_regularization_strength,
            l2_regularization_strength=cfg.l2_regularization_strength,
        )
    if name == 'rmsprop':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.RMSPropOptimizer(
            cfg.learning_rate,
            decay=cfg.rho,
            momentum=cfg.momentum,
            epsilon=cfg.epsilon,
        )
    raise ValueError(f'Unsupported optimizer: {cfg.name}')


def supported_optimizers() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        'sgd',
        'adagrad',
        'momentum',
        'adam',
        'proximal_gradient_descent',
        'proximal_adagrad',
        'rmsprop',
    )

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/models.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import ModelConfig, OptimizerConfig
from tf_optimizer_lab.optimizers import create_optimizer


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GraphHandles:
    x: tf.Tensor
    y: tf.Tensor
    is_training: tf.Tensor
    logits: tf.Tensor
    probabilities: tf.Tensor
    loss: tf.Tensor
    accuracy: tf.Tensor
    train_op: tf.Operation
    global_step: tf.Variable
    summary_op: tf.Tensor


def _activation(name: str):
    normalized = name.lower().strip()
    if normalized == 'relu':
        return tf.nn.relu
    if normalized == 'tanh':
        return tf.nn.tanh
    if normalized in {'linear', 'none'}:
        return None
    raise ValueError(f'Unsupported activation: {name}')


def build_classifier_graph(
    num_features: int,
    num_classes: int,
    model_cfg: ModelConfig,
    optimizer_cfg: OptimizerConfig,
) -> GraphHandles:
    x = tf.compat.v1.placeholder(tf.float32, shape=[None, num_features], name='features')
    y = tf.compat.v1.placeholder(tf.float32, shape=[None, num_classes], name='labels')
    is_training = tf.compat.v1.placeholder_with_default(False, shape=(), name='is_training')
    net = x
    activation = _activation(model_cfg.activation)
    with tf.compat.v1.variable_scope('classifier'):
        for idx, units in enumerate(model_cfg.hidden_units):
            net = tf.keras.layers.Dense(units, activation=activation, name=f'dense_{idx}')(net)
            if model_cfg.dropout_rate > 0:
                net = tf.cond(
                    is_training,
                    lambda n=net: tf.nn.dropout(n, rate=model_cfg.dropout_rate),
                    lambda n=net: tf.identity(n),
                )
        logits = tf.keras.layers.Dense(num_classes, activation=None, name='logits')(net)
    probabilities = tf.nn.softmax(logits, axis=1, name='probabilities')
    per_example_loss = tf.nn.softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=y, logits=logits)
    loss = tf.reduce_mean(per_example_loss, name='loss')
    predictions = tf.argmax(logits, axis=1)
    targets = tf.argmax(y, axis=1)
    accuracy = tf.reduce_mean(tf.cast(tf.equal(predictions, targets), tf.float32), name='accuracy')
    global_step = tf.compat.v1.train.get_or_create_global_step()
    optimizer = create_optimizer(optimizer_cfg)
    train_op = optimizer.minimize(loss, global_step=global_step)
    tf.compat.v1.summary.scalar('loss', loss)
    tf.compat.v1.summary.scalar('accuracy', accuracy)
    summary_op = tf.compat.v1.summary.merge_all()
    return GraphHandles(
        x=x,
        y=y,
        is_training=is_training,
        logits=logits,
        probabilities=probabilities,
        loss=loss,
        accuracy=accuracy,
        train_op=train_op,
        global_step=global_step,
        summary_op=summary_op,
    )

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/tracking.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import json
import time


class JsonlTracker:
    def __init__(self, run_dir: str | Path) -> None:
        self.path = Path(run_dir) / 'events.jsonl'
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def log(self, event: str, **payload: Any) -> None:
        record = {'time': time.time(), 'event': event, **payload}
        with self.path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + '\n')

    def log_metrics(self, split: str, step: int, metrics: dict[str, float]) -> None:
        self.log('metrics', split=split, step=int(step), metrics={k: float(v) for k, v in metrics.items()})

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/trainer.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import json
import logging
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import ExperimentConfig
from tf_optimizer_lab.data import ArrayDataset, BatchIterator, load_dataset
from tf_optimizer_lab.metrics import classification_report_dict
from tf_optimizer_lab.models import GraphHandles, build_classifier_graph
from tf_optimizer_lab.tracking import JsonlTracker
from tf_optimizer_lab.utils import set_global_determinism

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrainResult:
    run_dir: Path
    checkpoint_path: Path
    best_validation_accuracy: float
    final_step: int


def _evaluate(sess: tf.compat.v1.Session, graph: GraphHandles, dataset: ArrayDataset, batch_size: int) -> dict[str, float]:
    if dataset.num_examples == 0:
        return {'accuracy': 0.0, 'cross_entropy': 0.0}
    logits_batches: list[np.ndarray] = []
    label_batches: list[np.ndarray] = []
    iterator = BatchIterator(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, seed=0, shuffle=False)
    for xb, yb in iterator:
        logits = sess.run(graph.logits, feed_dict={graph.x: xb, graph.y: yb, graph.is_training: False})
        logits_batches.append(logits)
        label_batches.append(yb)
    return classification_report_dict(np.vstack(logits_batches), np.vstack(label_batches))


def train(config: ExperimentConfig) -> TrainResult:
    tf.compat.v1.disable_eager_execution()
    set_global_determinism(config.seed)
    dataset = load_dataset(config.data, config.seed)
    run_dir = config.run_dir
    checkpoint_dir = run_dir / 'checkpoints'
    summary_dir = run_dir / 'summaries'
    checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    summary_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    config.save(run_dir / 'config.json')
    metadata = {'num_features': dataset.num_features, 'num_classes': dataset.num_classes}
    (run_dir / 'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    tracker = JsonlTracker(run_dir)
    tracker.log('run_started', experiment_name=config.experiment_name, optimizer=config.optimizer.name)

    tf.compat.v1.reset_default_graph()
    graph = build_classifier_graph(dataset.num_features, dataset.num_classes, config.model, config.optimizer)
    saver = tf.compat.v1.train.Saver(max_to_keep=config.training.max_checkpoints)
    best_accuracy = -1.0
    best_checkpoint = checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'
    stale_evals = 0

    with tf.compat.v1.Session() as sess:
        sess.run(tf.compat.v1.global_variables_initializer())
        writer = tf.compat.v1.summary.FileWriter(str(summary_dir), sess.graph)
        step = 0
        stop = False
        for epoch in range(config.training.epochs):
            iterator = BatchIterator(dataset.train, config.training.batch_size, config.seed + epoch, shuffle=True)
            for xb, yb in iterator:
                feed = {graph.x: xb, graph.y: yb, graph.is_training: True}
                _, loss_value, acc_value, step, summary = sess.run(
                    [graph.train_op, graph.loss, graph.accuracy, graph.global_step, graph.summary_op],
                    feed_dict=feed,
                )
                writer.add_summary(summary, step)
                if step % config.training.eval_every_steps == 0:
                    train_metrics = {'loss': float(loss_value), 'accuracy': float(acc_value)}
                    validation_metrics = _evaluate(sess, graph, dataset.validation, config.training.batch_size)
                    tracker.log_metrics('train_batch', step, train_metrics)
                    tracker.log_metrics('validation', step, validation_metrics)
                    LOGGER.info('step=%s train=%s validation=%s', step, train_metrics, validation_metrics)
                    if validation_metrics['accuracy'] > best_accuracy:
                        best_accuracy = validation_metrics['accuracy']
                        best_checkpoint = Path(saver.save(sess, str(checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'), global_step=step))
                        stale_evals = 0
                    else:
                        stale_evals += 1
                    if stale_evals >= config.training.early_stopping_patience:
                        stop = True
                        break
                elif step % config.training.checkpoint_every_steps == 0:
                    saver.save(sess, str(checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'), global_step=step)
            if stop:
                break
        if best_accuracy < 0:
            validation_metrics = _evaluate(sess, graph, dataset.validation, config.training.batch_size)
            best_accuracy = validation_metrics['accuracy']
            best_checkpoint = Path(saver.save(sess, str(checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'), global_step=step))
            tracker.log_metrics('validation', step, validation_metrics)
        test_metrics = _evaluate(sess, graph, dataset.test, config.training.batch_size)
        tracker.log_metrics('test', step, test_metrics)
        writer.close()
    tracker.log('run_finished', best_checkpoint=str(best_checkpoint), best_validation_accuracy=best_accuracy)
    return TrainResult(run_dir=run_dir, checkpoint_path=best_checkpoint, best_validation_accuracy=best_accuracy, final_step=int(step))

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/inference.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import ExperimentConfig, load_config
from tf_optimizer_lab.models import build_classifier_graph


class Predictor:
    def __init__(self, config: ExperimentConfig, checkpoint_dir: str | Path) -> None:
        tf.compat.v1.disable_eager_execution()
        self.config = config
        self.checkpoint_dir = Path(checkpoint_dir)
        metadata_path = config.run_dir / 'metadata.json'
        if metadata_path.exists():
            metadata = json.loads(metadata_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            self.num_features = int(metadata['num_features'])
            self.num_classes = int(metadata['num_classes'])
        else:
            self.num_features = config.data.num_features
            self.num_classes = config.data.num_classes
        tf.compat.v1.reset_default_graph()
        self.graph = build_classifier_graph(self.num_features, self.num_classes, config.model, config.optimizer)
        self.saver = tf.compat.v1.train.Saver()
        self.session = tf.compat.v1.Session()
        checkpoint = tf.train.latest_checkpoint(str(self.checkpoint_dir))
        if checkpoint is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f'No checkpoint found in {self.checkpoint_dir}')
        self.saver.restore(self.session, checkpoint)

    @classmethod
    def from_paths(cls, config_path: str | Path, checkpoint_dir: str | Path) -> 'Predictor':
        return cls(load_config(config_path), checkpoint_dir)

    def predict_proba(self, features: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        array = np.asarray(features, dtype=np.float32)
        if array.ndim == 1:
            array = array.reshape(1, -1)
        if array.shape[1] != self.num_features:
            raise ValueError(f'Expected {self.num_features} features, received {array.shape[1]}')
        return self.session.run(
            self.graph.probabilities,
            feed_dict={self.graph.x: array, self.graph.is_training: False},
        )

    def predict(self, features: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.argmax(self.predict_proba(features), axis=1)

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.session.close()

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/serving.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import numpy as np
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from tf_optimizer_lab.inference import Predictor


class PredictionRequest(BaseModel):
    instances: list[list[float]] = Field(min_length=1)


class PredictionResponse(BaseModel):
    classes: list[int]
    probabilities: list[list[float]]


def create_app(config_path: str | Path, checkpoint_dir: str | Path) -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(title='TensorFlow Optimizer Lab')
    predictor = Predictor.from_paths(config_path, checkpoint_dir)

    @app.get('/health')
    def health() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    @app.post('/predict', response_model=PredictionResponse)
    def predict(request: PredictionRequest) -> Any:
        try:
            probabilities = predictor.predict_proba(np.asarray(request.instances, dtype=np.float32))
            classes = np.argmax(probabilities, axis=1).astype(int).tolist()
            return PredictionResponse(classes=classes, probabilities=probabilities.tolist())
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    @app.on_event('shutdown')
    def shutdown() -> None:
        predictor.close()

    return app

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/cli.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import uvicorn

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import load_config
from tf_optimizer_lab.inference import Predictor
from tf_optimizer_lab.serving import create_app
from tf_optimizer_lab.trainer import train
from tf_optimizer_lab.utils import configure_logging


def _train(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    result = train(load_config(args.config))
    print(json.dumps({
        'run_dir': str(result.run_dir),
        'checkpoint_path': str(result.checkpoint_path),
        'best_validation_accuracy': result.best_validation_accuracy,
        'final_step': result.final_step,
    }, indent=2))


def _evaluate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    from tf_optimizer_lab.data import load_dataset
    from tf_optimizer_lab.metrics import classification_report_dict
    cfg = load_config(args.config)
    predictor = Predictor(cfg, args.checkpoint_dir)
    dataset = load_dataset(cfg.data, cfg.seed)
    probabilities = predictor.predict_proba(dataset.test.x if dataset.test.num_examples else dataset.validation.x)
    labels = dataset.test.y if dataset.test.num_examples else dataset.validation.y
    report = classification_report_dict(probabilities, labels)
    predictor.close()
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True))


def _predict(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    values = [float(item) for item in args.features.split(',') if item.strip()]
    predictor = Predictor.from_paths(args.config, args.checkpoint_dir)
    probabilities = predictor.predict_proba(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float32))
    predictor.close()
    print(json.dumps({'class': int(np.argmax(probabilities[0])), 'probabilities': probabilities[0].tolist()}, indent=2))


def _serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    app = create_app(args.config, args.checkpoint_dir)
    uvicorn.run(app, host=args.host, port=args.port)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='tf-optimizer-lab')
    parser.add_argument('--log-level', default='INFO')
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    train_parser = sub.add_parser('train')
    train_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    train_parser.set_defaults(func=_train)
    eval_parser = sub.add_parser('evaluate')
    eval_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    eval_parser.add_argument('--checkpoint-dir', required=True)
    eval_parser.set_defaults(func=_evaluate)
    predict_parser = sub.add_parser('predict')
    predict_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    predict_parser.add_argument('--checkpoint-dir', required=True)
    predict_parser.add_argument('--features', required=True, help='Comma separated feature vector')
    predict_parser.set_defaults(func=_predict)
    serve_parser = sub.add_parser('serve')
    serve_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    serve_parser.add_argument('--checkpoint-dir', required=True)
    serve_parser.add_argument('--host', default='127.0.0.1')
    serve_parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=8080)
    serve_parser.set_defaults(func=_serve)
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    configure_logging(args.log_level)
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/README.md"
# TensorFlow Optimizer Lab

TensorFlow Optimizer Lab is a compact research and production codebase for studying classic TensorFlow optimizers under a consistent graph-mode training pipeline. It modernizes TensorFlow 1.x ideas such as `tf.train.GradientDescentOptimizer`, placeholders, sessions, trainable variables, and checkpoints through `tf.compat.v1` while remaining installable on current Python and TensorFlow versions.

The project supports synthetic classification data and MNIST, configurable multilayer perceptrons, local JSONL experiment tracking, TensorBoard summaries, checkpointing, evaluation, batch prediction, and an optional FastAPI serving endpoint.

## Quick start

Install in editable mode:

`python -m pip install -e .[dev]`

Train a synthetic experiment:

`tf-optimizer-lab train --config configs/default_synthetic.json`

Evaluate a saved run:

`tf-optimizer-lab evaluate --config configs/default_synthetic.json --checkpoint-dir runs/synthetic_adam/checkpoints`

Serve predictions:

`tf-optimizer-lab serve --config configs/default_synthetic.json --checkpoint-dir runs/synthetic_adam/checkpoints --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080`

## Optimizers

Supported optimizer names are `sgd`, `adagrad`, `momentum`, `adam`, `proximal_gradient_descent`, `proximal_adagrad`, and `rmsprop`. They map to TensorFlow graph optimizers under `tf.compat.v1.train`.

## Configuration

Experiments are JSON files with sections for data, model, optimizer, and training. A run directory contains the copied configuration, checkpoints, TensorBoard summaries, metrics, and a JSONL event stream suitable for downstream analysis.

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import json


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DataConfig:
    name: str = 'synthetic'
    num_samples: int = 5000
    num_features: int = 32
    num_classes: int = 4
    validation_fraction: float = 0.15
    test_fraction: float = 0.15
    noise: float = 0.45


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ModelConfig:
    hidden_units: list[int] = field(default_factory=lambda: [128, 64])
    activation: str = 'relu'
    dropout_rate: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class OptimizerConfig:
    name: str = 'adam'
    learning_rate: float = 0.001
    momentum: float = 0.9
    rho: float = 0.9
    epsilon: float = 1e-7
    l1_regularization_strength: float = 0.0
    l2_regularization_strength: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrainingConfig:
    epochs: int = 10
    batch_size: int = 64
    eval_every_steps: int = 100
    checkpoint_every_steps: int = 500
    max_checkpoints: int = 5
    early_stopping_patience: int = 10


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExperimentConfig:
    experiment_name: str = 'optimizer_experiment'
    seed: int = 1337
    run_root: str = 'runs'
    data: DataConfig = field(default_factory=DataConfig)
    model: ModelConfig = field(default_factory=ModelConfig)
    optimizer: OptimizerConfig = field(default_factory=OptimizerConfig)
    training: TrainingConfig = field(default_factory=TrainingConfig)

    @property
    def run_dir(self) -> Path:
        return Path(self.run_root) / self.experiment_name

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    def save(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        target = Path(path)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding='utf-8')


def _section(data: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = data.get(key, {})
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f'Configuration section {key} must be an object')
    return value


def load_config(path: str | Path) -> ExperimentConfig:
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Config file not found: {config_path}')
    raw = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ValueError('Configuration root must be a JSON object')
    return ExperimentConfig(
        experiment_name=str(raw.get('experiment_name', 'optimizer_experiment')),
        seed=int(raw.get('seed', 1337)),
        run_root=str(raw.get('run_root', 'runs')),
        data=DataConfig(**_section(raw, 'data')),
        model=ModelConfig(**_section(raw, 'model')),
        optimizer=OptimizerConfig(**_section(raw, 'optimizer')),
        training=TrainingConfig(**_section(raw, 'training')),
    )

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/data.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterator
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import DataConfig


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ArrayDataset:
    x: np.ndarray
    y: np.ndarray

    @property
    def num_examples(self) -> int:
        return int(self.x.shape[0])


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetBundle:
    train: ArrayDataset
    validation: ArrayDataset
    test: ArrayDataset
    num_features: int
    num_classes: int


class BatchIterator:
    def __init__(self, dataset: ArrayDataset, batch_size: int, seed: int, shuffle: bool = True) -> None:
        if batch_size <= 0:
            raise ValueError('batch_size must be positive')
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.shuffle = shuffle
        self.rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]:
        indices = np.arange(self.dataset.num_examples)
        if self.shuffle:
            self.rng.shuffle(indices)
        for start in range(0, self.dataset.num_examples, self.batch_size):
            batch_idx = indices[start:start + self.batch_size]
            yield self.dataset.x[batch_idx], self.dataset.y[batch_idx]


def one_hot(labels: np.ndarray, num_classes: int) -> np.ndarray:
    result = np.zeros((labels.shape[0], num_classes), dtype=np.float32)
    result[np.arange(labels.shape[0]), labels.astype(np.int64)] = 1.0
    return result


def _split(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    order = np.arange(x.shape[0])
    rng.shuffle(order)
    x = x[order].astype(np.float32)
    y = y[order].astype(np.float32)
    n = x.shape[0]
    n_test = int(n * cfg.test_fraction)
    n_val = int(n * cfg.validation_fraction)
    test = ArrayDataset(x[:n_test], y[:n_test]) if n_test else ArrayDataset(x[:0], y[:0])
    val = ArrayDataset(x[n_test:n_test + n_val], y[n_test:n_test + n_val])
    train = ArrayDataset(x[n_test + n_val:], y[n_test + n_val:])
    return DatasetBundle(train=train, validation=val, test=test, num_features=x.shape[1], num_classes=y.shape[1])


def load_synthetic(cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    labels = rng.integers(0, cfg.num_classes, size=cfg.num_samples)
    prototypes = rng.normal(0.0, 2.0, size=(cfg.num_classes, cfg.num_features))
    x = prototypes[labels] + rng.normal(0.0, cfg.noise, size=(cfg.num_samples, cfg.num_features))
    scale = np.maximum(x.std(axis=0, keepdims=True), 1e-6)
    x = (x - x.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)) / scale
    return _split(x.astype(np.float32), one_hot(labels, cfg.num_classes), cfg, seed)


def load_mnist(cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    (x_train, y_train), (x_test, y_test) = tf.keras.datasets.mnist.load_data()
    x_train = x_train.reshape(x_train.shape[0], -1).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
    x_test = x_test.reshape(x_test.shape[0], -1).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
    y_train = one_hot(y_train, 10)
    y_test = one_hot(y_test, 10)
    train_bundle = _split(x_train, y_train, cfg, seed)
    test = ArrayDataset(x_test, y_test)
    return DatasetBundle(
        train=train_bundle.train,
        validation=train_bundle.validation,
        test=test,
        num_features=784,
        num_classes=10,
    )


def load_dataset(cfg: DataConfig, seed: int) -> DatasetBundle:
    if cfg.name == 'synthetic':
        return load_synthetic(cfg, seed)
    if cfg.name == 'mnist':
        return load_mnist(cfg, seed)
    raise ValueError(f'Unsupported dataset: {cfg.name}')

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/metrics.py"
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def accuracy_from_logits(logits: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> float:
    if logits.size == 0:
        return 0.0
    pred = np.argmax(logits, axis=1)
    truth = np.argmax(labels, axis=1)
    return float(np.mean(pred == truth))


def cross_entropy_from_logits(logits: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> float:
    if logits.size == 0:
        return 0.0
    shifted = logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    log_probs = shifted - np.log(np.exp(shifted).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True))
    return float(-np.sum(labels * log_probs) / labels.shape[0])


def classification_report_dict(logits: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
    return {
        'accuracy': accuracy_from_logits(logits, labels),
        'cross_entropy': cross_entropy_from_logits(logits, labels),
    }

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/optimizers.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import OptimizerConfig


def create_optimizer(cfg: OptimizerConfig) -> tf.compat.v1.train.Optimizer:
    name = cfg.name.lower().strip()
    if name in {'sgd', 'gradient_descent', 'gradientdescent'}:
        return tf.compat.v1.train.GradientDescentOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate)
    if name == 'adagrad':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.AdagradOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate)
    if name == 'momentum':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.MomentumOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate, momentum=cfg.momentum)
    if name == 'adam':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.AdamOptimizer(cfg.learning_rate, epsilon=cfg.epsilon)
    if name == 'proximal_gradient_descent':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.ProximalGradientDescentOptimizer(
            cfg.learning_rate,
            l1_regularization_strength=cfg.l1_regularization_strength,
            l2_regularization_strength=cfg.l2_regularization_strength,
        )
    if name == 'proximal_adagrad':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.ProximalAdagradOptimizer(
            cfg.learning_rate,
            l1_regularization_strength=cfg.l1_regularization_strength,
            l2_regularization_strength=cfg.l2_regularization_strength,
        )
    if name == 'rmsprop':
        return tf.compat.v1.train.RMSPropOptimizer(
            cfg.learning_rate,
            decay=cfg.rho,
            momentum=cfg.momentum,
            epsilon=cfg.epsilon,
        )
    raise ValueError(f'Unsupported optimizer: {cfg.name}')


def supported_optimizers() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return (
        'sgd',
        'adagrad',
        'momentum',
        'adam',
        'proximal_gradient_descent',
        'proximal_adagrad',
        'rmsprop',
    )

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/models.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import ModelConfig, OptimizerConfig
from tf_optimizer_lab.optimizers import create_optimizer


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GraphHandles:
    x: tf.Tensor
    y: tf.Tensor
    is_training: tf.Tensor
    logits: tf.Tensor
    probabilities: tf.Tensor
    loss: tf.Tensor
    accuracy: tf.Tensor
    train_op: tf.Operation
    global_step: tf.Variable
    summary_op: tf.Tensor


def _activation(name: str):
    normalized = name.lower().strip()
    if normalized == 'relu':
        return tf.nn.relu
    if normalized == 'tanh':
        return tf.nn.tanh
    if normalized in {'linear', 'none'}:
        return None
    raise ValueError(f'Unsupported activation: {name}')


def build_classifier_graph(
    num_features: int,
    num_classes: int,
    model_cfg: ModelConfig,
    optimizer_cfg: OptimizerConfig,
) -> GraphHandles:
    x = tf.compat.v1.placeholder(tf.float32, shape=[None, num_features], name='features')
    y = tf.compat.v1.placeholder(tf.float32, shape=[None, num_classes], name='labels')
    is_training = tf.compat.v1.placeholder_with_default(False, shape=(), name='is_training')
    net = x
    activation = _activation(model_cfg.activation)
    with tf.compat.v1.variable_scope('classifier'):
        for idx, units in enumerate(model_cfg.hidden_units):
            net = tf.keras.layers.Dense(units, activation=activation, name=f'dense_{idx}')(net)
            if model_cfg.dropout_rate > 0:
                net = tf.cond(
                    is_training,
                    lambda n=net: tf.nn.dropout(n, rate=model_cfg.dropout_rate),
                    lambda n=net: tf.identity(n),
                )
        logits = tf.keras.layers.Dense(num_classes, activation=None, name='logits')(net)
    probabilities = tf.nn.softmax(logits, axis=1, name='probabilities')
    per_example_loss = tf.nn.softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=y, logits=logits)
    loss = tf.reduce_mean(per_example_loss, name='loss')
    predictions = tf.argmax(logits, axis=1)
    targets = tf.argmax(y, axis=1)
    accuracy = tf.reduce_mean(tf.cast(tf.equal(predictions, targets), tf.float32), name='accuracy')
    global_step = tf.compat.v1.train.get_or_create_global_step()
    optimizer = create_optimizer(optimizer_cfg)
    train_op = optimizer.minimize(loss, global_step=global_step)
    tf.compat.v1.summary.scalar('loss', loss)
    tf.compat.v1.summary.scalar('accuracy', accuracy)
    summary_op = tf.compat.v1.summary.merge_all()
    return GraphHandles(
        x=x,
        y=y,
        is_training=is_training,
        logits=logits,
        probabilities=probabilities,
        loss=loss,
        accuracy=accuracy,
        train_op=train_op,
        global_step=global_step,
        summary_op=summary_op,
    )

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/tracking.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import json
import time


class JsonlTracker:
    def __init__(self, run_dir: str | Path) -> None:
        self.path = Path(run_dir) / 'events.jsonl'
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def log(self, event: str, **payload: Any) -> None:
        record = {'time': time.time(), 'event': event, **payload}
        with self.path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + '\n')

    def log_metrics(self, split: str, step: int, metrics: dict[str, float]) -> None:
        self.log('metrics', split=split, step=int(step), metrics={k: float(v) for k, v in metrics.items()})

# "TensorFlow_Optimizer_Lab/src/tf_optimizer_lab/trainer.py"
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import json
import logging
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import ExperimentConfig
from tf_optimizer_lab.data import ArrayDataset, BatchIterator, load_dataset
from tf_optimizer_lab.metrics import classification_report_dict
from tf_optimizer_lab.models import GraphHandles, build_classifier_graph
from tf_optimizer_lab.tracking import JsonlTracker
from tf_optimizer_lab.utils import set_global_determinism

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TrainResult:
    run_dir: Path
    checkpoint_path: Path
    best_validation_accuracy: float
    final_step: int


def _evaluate(sess: tf.compat.v1.Session, graph: GraphHandles, dataset: ArrayDataset, batch_size: int) -> dict[str, float]:
    if dataset.num_examples == 0:
        return {'accuracy': 0.0, 'cross_entropy': 0.0}
    logits_batches: list[np.ndarray] = []
    label_batches: list[np.ndarray] = []
    iterator = BatchIterator(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, seed=0, shuffle=False)
    for xb, yb in iterator:
        logits = sess.run(graph.logits, feed_dict={graph.x: xb, graph.y: yb, graph.is_training: False})
        logits_batches.append(logits)
        label_batches.append(yb)
    return classification_report_dict(np.vstack(logits_batches), np.vstack(label_batches))


def train(config: ExperimentConfig) -> TrainResult:
    tf.compat.v1.disable_eager_execution()
    set_global_determinism(config.seed)
    dataset = load_dataset(config.data, config.seed)
    run_dir = config.run_dir
    checkpoint_dir = run_dir / 'checkpoints'
    summary_dir = run_dir / 'summaries'
    checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    summary_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    config.save(run_dir / 'config.json')
    metadata = {'num_features': dataset.num_features, 'num_classes': dataset.num_classes}
    (run_dir / 'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    tracker = JsonlTracker(run_dir)
    tracker.log('run_started', experiment_name=config.experiment_name, optimizer=config.optimizer.name)

    tf.compat.v1.reset_default_graph()
    graph = build_classifier_graph(dataset.num_features, dataset.num_classes, config.model, config.optimizer)
    saver = tf.compat.v1.train.Saver(max_to_keep=config.training.max_checkpoints)
    best_accuracy = -1.0
    best_checkpoint = checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'
    stale_evals = 0

    with tf.compat.v1.Session() as sess:
        sess.run(tf.compat.v1.global_variables_initializer())
        writer = tf.compat.v1.summary.FileWriter(str(summary_dir), sess.graph)
        step = 0
        stop = False
        for epoch in range(config.training.epochs):
            iterator = BatchIterator(dataset.train, config.training.batch_size, config.seed + epoch, shuffle=True)
            for xb, yb in iterator:
                feed = {graph.x: xb, graph.y: yb, graph.is_training: True}
                _, loss_value, acc_value, step, summary = sess.run(
                    [graph.train_op, graph.loss, graph.accuracy, graph.global_step, graph.summary_op],
                    feed_dict=feed,
                )
                writer.add_summary(summary, step)
                if step % config.training.eval_every_steps == 0:
                    train_metrics = {'loss': float(loss_value), 'accuracy': float(acc_value)}
                    validation_metrics = _evaluate(sess, graph, dataset.validation, config.training.batch_size)
                    tracker.log_metrics('train_batch', step, train_metrics)
                    tracker.log_metrics('validation', step, validation_metrics)
                    LOGGER.info('step=%s train=%s validation=%s', step, train_metrics, validation_metrics)
                    if validation_metrics['accuracy'] > best_accuracy:
                        best_accuracy = validation_metrics['accuracy']
                        best_checkpoint = Path(saver.save(sess, str(checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'), global_step=step))
                        stale_evals = 0
                    else:
                        stale_evals += 1
                    if stale_evals >= config.training.early_stopping_patience:
                        stop = True
                        break
                elif step % config.training.checkpoint_every_steps == 0:
                    saver.save(sess, str(checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'), global_step=step)
            if stop:
                break
        if best_accuracy < 0:
            validation_metrics = _evaluate(sess, graph, dataset.validation, config.training.batch_size)
            best_accuracy = validation_metrics['accuracy']
            best_checkpoint = Path(saver.save(sess, str(checkpoint_dir / 'model.ckpt'), global_step=step))
            tracker.log_metrics('validation', step, validation_metrics)
        test_metrics = _evaluate(sess, graph, dataset.test, config.training.batch_size)
        tracker.log_metrics('test', step, test_metrics)
        writer.close()
    tracker.log('run_finished', best_checkpoint=str(best_checkpoint), best_validation_accuracy=best_accuracy)
    return TrainResult(run_dir=run_dir, checkpoint_path=best_checkpoint, best_validation_accuracy=best_accuracy, final_step=int(step))

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import ExperimentConfig, load_config
from tf_optimizer_lab.models import build_classifier_graph


class Predictor:
    def __init__(self, config: ExperimentConfig, checkpoint_dir: str | Path) -> None:
        tf.compat.v1.disable_eager_execution()
        self.config = config
        self.checkpoint_dir = Path(checkpoint_dir)
        metadata_path = config.run_dir / 'metadata.json'
        if metadata_path.exists():
            metadata = json.loads(metadata_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            self.num_features = int(metadata['num_features'])
            self.num_classes = int(metadata['num_classes'])
        else:
            self.num_features = config.data.num_features
            self.num_classes = config.data.num_classes
        tf.compat.v1.reset_default_graph()
        self.graph = build_classifier_graph(self.num_features, self.num_classes, config.model, config.optimizer)
        self.saver = tf.compat.v1.train.Saver()
        self.session = tf.compat.v1.Session()
        checkpoint = tf.train.latest_checkpoint(str(self.checkpoint_dir))
        if checkpoint is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f'No checkpoint found in {self.checkpoint_dir}')
        self.saver.restore(self.session, checkpoint)

    @classmethod
    def from_paths(cls, config_path: str | Path, checkpoint_dir: str | Path) -> 'Predictor':
        return cls(load_config(config_path), checkpoint_dir)

    def predict_proba(self, features: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        array = np.asarray(features, dtype=np.float32)
        if array.ndim == 1:
            array = array.reshape(1, -1)
        if array.shape[1] != self.num_features:
            raise ValueError(f'Expected {self.num_features} features, received {array.shape[1]}')
        return self.session.run(
            self.graph.probabilities,
            feed_dict={self.graph.x: array, self.graph.is_training: False},
        )

    def predict(self, features: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.argmax(self.predict_proba(features), axis=1)

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.session.close()

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import numpy as np
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from tf_optimizer_lab.inference import Predictor


class PredictionRequest(BaseModel):
    instances: list[list[float]] = Field(min_length=1)


class PredictionResponse(BaseModel):
    classes: list[int]
    probabilities: list[list[float]]


def create_app(config_path: str | Path, checkpoint_dir: str | Path) -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(title='TensorFlow Optimizer Lab')
    predictor = Predictor.from_paths(config_path, checkpoint_dir)

    @app.get('/health')
    def health() -> dict[str, str]:
        return {'status': 'ok'}

    @app.post('/predict', response_model=PredictionResponse)
    def predict(request: PredictionRequest) -> Any:
        try:
            probabilities = predictor.predict_proba(np.asarray(request.instances, dtype=np.float32))
            classes = np.argmax(probabilities, axis=1).astype(int).tolist()
            return PredictionResponse(classes=classes, probabilities=probabilities.tolist())
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    @app.on_event('shutdown')
    def shutdown() -> None:
        predictor.close()

    return app

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import uvicorn

from tf_optimizer_lab.config import load_config
from tf_optimizer_lab.inference import Predictor
from tf_optimizer_lab.serving import create_app
from tf_optimizer_lab.trainer import train
from tf_optimizer_lab.utils import configure_logging


def _train(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    result = train(load_config(args.config))
    print(json.dumps({
        'run_dir': str(result.run_dir),
        'checkpoint_path': str(result.checkpoint_path),
        'best_validation_accuracy': result.best_validation_accuracy,
        'final_step': result.final_step,
    }, indent=2))


def _evaluate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    from tf_optimizer_lab.data import load_dataset
    from tf_optimizer_lab.metrics import classification_report_dict
    cfg = load_config(args.config)
    predictor = Predictor(cfg, args.checkpoint_dir)
    dataset = load_dataset(cfg.data, cfg.seed)
    probabilities = predictor.predict_proba(dataset.test.x if dataset.test.num_examples else dataset.validation.x)
    labels = dataset.test.y if dataset.test.num_examples else dataset.validation.y
    report = classification_report_dict(probabilities, labels)
    predictor.close()
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True))


def _predict(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    values = [float(item) for item in args.features.split(',') if item.strip()]
    predictor = Predictor.from_paths(args.config, args.checkpoint_dir)
    probabilities = predictor.predict_proba(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float32))
    predictor.close()
    print(json.dumps({'class': int(np.argmax(probabilities[0])), 'probabilities': probabilities[0].tolist()}, indent=2))


def _serve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    app = create_app(args.config, args.checkpoint_dir)
    uvicorn.run(app, host=args.host, port=args.port)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='tf-optimizer-lab')
    parser.add_argument('--log-level', default='INFO')
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    train_parser = sub.add_parser('train')
    train_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    train_parser.set_defaults(func=_train)
    eval_parser = sub.add_parser('evaluate')
    eval_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    eval_parser.add_argument('--checkpoint-dir', required=True)
    eval_parser.set_defaults(func=_evaluate)
    predict_parser = sub.add_parser('predict')
    predict_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    predict_parser.add_argument('--checkpoint-dir', required=True)
    predict_parser.add_argument('--features', required=True, help='Comma separated feature vector')
    predict_parser.set_defaults(func=_predict)
    serve_parser = sub.add_parser('serve')
    serve_parser.add_argument('--config', required=True)
    serve_parser.add_argument('--checkpoint-dir', required=True)
    serve_parser.add_argument('--host', default='127.0.0.1')
    serve_parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=8080)
    serve_parser.set_defaults(func=_serve)
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    configure_logging(args.log_level)
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
